Add meat and cook 2 minutes.
Break in egg.
Stir until mixed.
Chill.
To mold, dip in cracker meal, seasoned beaten eggs, then cracker meal again. Chill.
Roll in melted butter; cook on baking sheet at 350°
for one-half hour.
Serve with tomato or mushroom sauce.
Makes 6 regular size.

recipes.t: Nadine Krall'S Pork Chops And Rice
d: Brown chops in frypan.
Pour onion soup mix and enough water over chops to keep chops covered.
Cook for 1/2 hour.
Add Minute rice and simmer.
For two people, use 1/2 cup rice.
Place all ingredients into bread machine pan in the order listed. Use "dough" setting to make dough. Remove when dough setting is done. Use margarine to coat hands for easy removal and roll shaping.
Blend Eagle Brand, Cool Whip, lemon juice, crushed pineapple, cherry jello and almond flavoring. Add bananas, cherry pie filling and pecans. Fold in. Chill.
Spoon vanilla ice cream by tablespoons into a large punch bowl. Add juices, stirring to muddle ice cream.
Slowly pour in 7-Up or Sprite. Stir to mix.
Heat pear juice to boiling.
Pour over jello and dissolve. While hot, pour jello over cream cheese.
Mix well with mixer until blended.
Place mixture in refrigerator or freezer until it starts to set.
Add whipped cream with mixer until well blended. Add nuts and pears; pour into serving bowl.
Chill until firm.
Mix together in large bowl.
May freeze if wanted.
In large saucepan combine ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered 10 minutes.
Remove spices.
Serve warm.
In 12-inch nonstick skillet, heat margarine until bubbly; add bell peppers, onions and garlic.
Saute until vegetables are softened.
Stir in water, broth mix and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low.
Add potatoes, cover and let simmer, stirring occasionally, until tender.
(Add more water if necessary to prevent sticking.)
Mix together in order given.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Watch carefully, they brown quickly.
You can make these any size you like.

recipes.t: Corn Salad With Mesquite Turkey Breast
d: Toss together corn, celery, bell pepper, olives and cilantro in large bowl. Combine dressing and cumin in measuring cup and pour over corn mixture. Toss to coat. Line 4 plates with spinach leaves and place 1 cup corn salad in center of each plate. Fold 4 to 5 slices turkey into fourths and tuck around corn salad or cut turkey into strips and arrange strips around corn.
This dip is put in layers; either on a glass plate or in a glass bowl.
Cook chicken until tender.
Chop in bite-size pieces.
Slice water chestnuts.
Crush crackers.
Sprinkle 1/2 crackers in bottom of baking dish.
Mix chicken soup, water chestnuts, sour cream and onions together.
Pour in baking dish.
Top with remaining crumbs and sprinkle butter over crackers.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Heat oven to 400°.
Grease pie plate (10 x 1 1/2-inch).
Cook and stir beef and onions until brown; drain.
Stir in seasoning mix; spread into plate.
Top with chillies.
Beat milk, baking mix and eggs until smooth, 15 seconds, in blender or 1 minute with mixer.
Pour into plate.
Bake 25 minutes.
Top with sliced tomatoes and cheese, then bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean, 8 to 10 minutes or longer.
Cool 5 minutes. Serve with sour cream, chopped tomatoes, shredded lettuce and Cheddar cheese.
Mix juice from pineapple, lemon juice and enough orange juice to make 1 cup.
Add sweetener.
Dissolve cornstarch in water and add to juice.
Boil and stir until thick.
Cool.
Combine canned fruit and fresh fruit.
Mix in fruit dressing; allow to stand to let flavors blend.
Makes 1 cup dressing.
Leftover will keep or double recipe.
Cook sausage and drain well.
Mix flour, corn meal, egg, milk and oil.
Add sausage.
Place in greased muffin pan and bake at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Cool potatoes completely. To make mustard dressing, in a large serving bowl, combine white wine vinegar, Dijon mustard and salt. Whisk in olive oil until well blended.
Add sliced red potatoes, scallions and roasted red peppers.
Toss to coat well with mustard-oil dressing.
Place
cup
sugar in heavy skillet; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until sugar melts and forms a light brown syrup.
Reduce heat to low;
gradually add boiling water in
a slow
stream,
stirring
constantly
with a wire whisk. Remove from heat.
Wash spinach - mix all ingredients - Serve immediately.
Mix ingredients; beat well.
Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake in 350° oven.
Cake is done when it falls in middle.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Melt butter and marshmallows.
Allow to melt gradually over low heat.
Stir until creamy.
Add food coloring; mix good.
Add corn flakes.
Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet.
Press hole in middle to form a wreath shape.
Press cinnamon candy on to appear as berries.
Allow to harden.
Place layers of wax paper between layers of wreath.
Mix dry ingredients.
Pour melted butter over and stir.
Add beaten egg and vanilla.
Drop by 1/4 teaspoon onto aluminum foil on cookie sheet, leaving lots of room in between.
Bake in a 350° oven for 8 minutes.
Let cookies cool on foil before peeling off. Use new foil for each sheet of cookies.
Makes 7 dozen.
Beat sugar, Pet milk and egg yolks until sugar is dissolved. Beat egg whites until stiff; fold in with vanilla.
Pour in freezer.
If not enough to fill to line, fill with milk.
Any fruit you desire can be added to this.
Cook squash in small amount of water until done and drain. Mix all ingredients together.
Place in casserole dish.
Sprinkle top with buttered crumbs.
Bake 45 minutes or until set at 350°.
Heat 4 cups water to 110°; use 3/4 cup of the water and dissolve yeast and 3/4 teaspoon regular sugar.
Stir in flour, Sweet 'N Low, salt, pepper and Crisco.
Combine ingredients.
Microwave until melted. Serve with corn chips.
Cut hard-boiled eggs in half and remove yolks.
Mix with mayonnaise, salt, pepper and crumbled bacon.
Put mixture back into eggs and serve.
Kids love them.
Serve for breakfast with toast.
Mix all ingredients except the pie shell.
Pour into shell and bake at 350° until set, 35 to 40 minutes.
Cook celery in small amount of salt water until tender, but crisp.
Drain; add remaining ingredients except crumbs.
Put in shallow 2-quart dish; sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Dip fish in dressing.
Melt margarine in flat pan.
Pour part off to be used later.
Roll fish in cracker crumbs and put single layer in pan.
Sprinkle with lemon juice and then chopped onion. Pour remaining margarine over fish.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. (May be placed under broiler very briefly after baked for a crisper coating.)
Cook the sweet potatoes in boiling water 20 to 25 minutes or until tender.
Drain and cool.
Peel the potatoes and mash. Combine mashed sweet potatoes, frosting, vanilla and cinnamon; mix well. Spoon into a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 18 minutes.
Sprinkle with marshmallows. Continue baking 5 minutes or until thoroughly heated.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.
Mix all ingredients until sugar is dissolved.
Combine all ingredients and bring to a boil.
The sauce can then be sealed in a jar and stored in the refrigerator or used at once.
Yield:
Enough sauce for three chickens, halved, or for 5 to 6 pounds of ribs.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Cut each biscuit into half.
In saucepan, put chicken or turkey, gravy, beans, seasoning and pepper.
Cook and stir until bubbly.
This can be baked in a casserole or individual baking cups.
Spoon into dishes and top with three biscuit pieces on each casserole.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes until biscuits are golden.
This is a fun recipe for kids to do.
Sift flour, measure, add salt and sift again.
Cream butter, gradually add confectioners sugar and beat until light.
Combine dry ingredients and creamed mixture.
Blend thoroughly.
Put dough in 8 x 8-inch pan and bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cut in squares before completely cool.
Mix together in saucepan.
Cook and stir over medium heat until comes to boil.
Pour in bowl; cool mixture by putting bowl in cold water with ice cubes in it.
Stir while cooling until thickens. Add 1 1/2 cups whipped cream or Dream Whip.
Mix well.
Pour in 9-inch cold pie shell.
Refrigerate about 2 hours before serving. Serve with more Cool Whip or strawberries.
In small saucepan, combine apple juice and cornstarch.
Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
Cook and stir 2 minutes more.
Remove from heat and stir in butter, Equal, maple flavoring and vanilla.
Serve over pancakes, waffles or French toast.
Makes 1 cup.
Mix grape jelly and chili sauce.
Warm in microwave.
Place meatballs in crock-pot.
Pour jelly sauce mix over meatballs. Simmer on low for 1 hour or until heated through.
Sift cocoa and powdered sugar into bowl.
Stir in liquor which has been combined with syrup; mix well.
Add vanilla wafers and nuts; mix well.
Form into 3/4-inch balls and roll in powdered sugar.
Dry several hours.
Freezes well.
Yields 3 dozen.
Soak yeast in water until dissolved.
Mix dry ingredients and shortening as for pie crust.
Combine everything as for pie crust. Combine everything just until blended and chill for several hours or overnight.
Roll on sugared board 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick.
Cut in squares.
Put spoon of jam on center of square and fold three cornered.
Press edges together.
Place on pans and let raise 30 minutes.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Place 1/2 head of lettuce on bottom of bowl.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper and sugar.
Layer eggs atop lettuce in bowl.
Add more salt.
Layer as follows:
Peas, remaining lettuce, bacon and Swiss cheese.
Spread mayonnaise over top, sealing to edge of bowl.
Cover and chill 24 hours.
Toss before serving.
Cook, covered, for about 1 hour at 250° in a 2-quart casserole.
May add ripened bananas.
Serves 7 to 8.
Cook sausage until brown; drain.
Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles.
Place in an ungreased 12-inch pizza pan with points toward the center.
Press over bottom and up sides to form a crust; seal perforations.
Spoon sausage over crust; sprinkle with potatoes.
Top with Cheddar cheese.
Beat eggs together with milk, salt and pepper.
Pour into crust.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over all.
Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
*Put small amount into blender until it turns to powder. Measure first, then blend.
Mix buttermilk baking mix, milk, sugar and eggs together and spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Arrange apple slices evenly over the top.
Drizzle apples with melted butter.
Stir sugar and cinnamon together and sprinkle over all.
Drizzle with cream.
Bake in preheated 350°
oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Wonderful served still warm.
Scoop out with a large spoon to serve.
Wash and core apples.
Pare apples 1/3 of the way down or slit the skin around the apple about halfway down.
Place apples in baking dish.
Put sugar and butter in center of each apple. Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Pour water around apples to prevent sticking.
Brown ground beef in skillet and set aside.
Boil noodles until cooked and rinse with water.	Blend cheeses together and set aside.
Add browned ground meat with sauce and seasoning in a pan and simmer.
Spread cheeses onto noodle on one side.
Roll noodles, curly side out.
Cut in half.
Do so with remainder of noodles.
Pour sauce into baking dish and place noodles with non-curly side down into sauce.
Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour.
Serve warm.
Low-fat sour cream and mayonnaise may be used.
Mix well.
Store in jar.
Use 1/3 cup mixture to 1 cup boiling water.
Delicious!!
Crumble bread together in a pan and bake at 300° until dry and golden brown.
Stir often.
Once dry, add butter, eggs, baking powder, salt, pepper, celery and onion.
Add sage to taste.
Add hot broth and mix well.
Bake in greased pan at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Drain juices from pineapple and mandarin oranges into large bowl.
Add instant pudding and Tang.
Stir until smooth.
Add bananas, kiwi fruit, pineapple, oranges, grapes and strawberries. Mix well and chill.
Will keep up to 2 weeks in refrigerator.
Dissolve
jello
in water and cool until partially set. Fold in remaining ingredients.
Pour into 5-cup mold and chill until firm.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
Combine beef, salt, pepper, egg and cream.
Shape into 1/4-inch balls.
In skillet, brown meatballs in butter, turning carefully to avoid piercing.
Combine remaining ingredients; add to brown meatballs.
Cover; reduce temperature and simmer about 30 minutes.
Serve warm.
Makes about 4 or 5 dozen.
In large skillet, melt butter.
Add chicken, onion and garlic; cook until chicken and onion are tender.

Stir in spaghetti sauce. Reduce heat; simmer, covered, stirring frequently, 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions; drain. Serve sauce over hot pasta; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
Mix cocoa, sugar, flour, salt and milk in top of double boiler.
Cook until mixture begins to thicken.
Add a little of the mixture to egg yolks.
Then add to mixture and cook about 3 minutes longer.
Remove from heat.
Add butter and vanilla.
Pour into baked pie shell.
Top with meringue.
Heap sliced apples in pie plate; add lemon juice and sugar. Add cinnamon as desired.
Crumble brown sugar, butter, flour and salt on top.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Brown
ground beef.
Cook noodles until not quite done; drain. Put
in
greased casserole.
Put 1 layer hamburg and 1 layer noodles.
Cover
with mushroom soup.
Repeat layers and cover with
celery
soup.
Bake in 350° oven until bubbly and lightly browned on top.
Mix together oil and sugar.
Add eggs.
Sift dry ingredients. Blend into first mixture.
Add carrots and nuts.
Grease and flour 2 (10-inch) pans.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
When cool, ice with cream cheese frosting.
Mix together all ingredients, except chocolate chips.
Place chocolate chips on top before baking.
Bake in cake pan for 20 minutes at 350°.
Boil water and oil together.
Add matzoh meal, sugar and salt. Mix off of the heat.
Beat very well.
Add eggs, 2 at a time, beating very well.
Bake in muffin tin at 350° for 1 hour.
Dissolve Jell-Os in hot water.
Mix together and when thickened, pour over mixture.
Prepare macaroni according to package directions.
Drain and set aside.
Take sausage out of casing and crumble.
Brown and drain off grease.
Stir in tomato puree, sauce, water, mushrooms and seasonings.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Add cooked macaroni and stir well.
Put 1/3 of meat and macaroni mixture into a greased 3-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with 1/3 Mozzarella cheese.
Repeat with remaining 2/3.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°.
Serves 8 to 10.
Combine first 6 ingredients in deep Dutch oven pan. Cook until soft. (Boil at 232°.) Add pecans and stir until coated. Spread and separate with fork; cool completely. Store in tin box.
Grease large casserole dish, 9 x 13-inch.
Unroll crescent rolls.
Lay out on bottom of dish.
Press together.
Cook sausage and drain.
Pour over rolls.
Beat eggs and add milk together. Pour over sausage.
Mix grated cheese.
Pour over top.
Cook at 350° for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Put butter or oleo in hot mashed potatoes; stir until butter is melted.
Add sugar, slightly beaten egg and flavoring.
Pour into unbaked 9-inch crust.
Sprinkle 1/4 sugar over top of pie.
Wait until sugar becomes moist, then put into oven.
Bake at 350° until done and glaze has formed.
Cream butter and sugar; then mix with applesauce.
Add sifted dry ingredients, raisins and nuts.
Beat and pour into buttered, floured loaf pan.
Bake slowly 1 1/4 hours at 325°.
Serve with whipped cream.
Mix all ingredients (except Sprite) and freeze 2 days.
Beat eggs well.
Add sugar and beat.
Add melted shortening and juice.
Mix well.
Add salt, baking powder, flour and mix until smooth and easy to handle.
Make into different shapes. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Decorate with colored sugar or frosting.
Place meat in heavy kettle or skillet and cook slowly until meat changes color.
Add onions and cook for 10 to 15 minutes. Add other ingredients, except soup.
Simmer for about 1 hour.
Add soup and cook a while longer.
Salt to taste.
Melt the butter; pour over the dry ingredients.
Mix until crumbly.
Spread over 1 can of apple pie filling.
Bake until brown at 325°.
Put tomato paste in large cooking pot.
Add 5 cans warm water and bring to a boil.
Add sugar, oregano, Lawry's salt, onion and Italian seasoning.
Simmer for about 2 hours.
Add mushrooms and browned hamburger during last half hour.
Serve with pasta.
Makes great lasagna too.
Serves 4 to 6 people.
Recipe can be doubled.
In a large saucepan, brown meat and drain well.
Return meat to saucepan.
Add onion, garlic and thyme.
Stir in vegetable juice, bouillon and water.
Bring to boiling; reduce heat.
Cover; simmer 1 hour.
Stir in potatoes, celery and carrots.
Cover; simmer 30 minutes more.
Put frozen raspberries into a quart glass measuring pitcher. Heat, uncovered, in microwave oven 1 minute on High.
Stir to break berries apart. Cook, uncovered, 30 seconds on High or until berries are defrosted.
Stir a mixture of sugar and cornstarch into raspberries, then stir in currant jelly. Cook in microwave oven 6 minutes on High until sauce thickens.
Melt the almond bark and peanut butter. Remove from heat. Stir in peanuts, rice krispies and marshmallows. Stir until well coated and drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.
Place chicken, skin side down, in a baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix honey, mustard, lemon juice and salt.
Spoon half of mixture over chicken.
Cover and marinate overnight in refrigerator.
Mix all ingredients and congeal.

In a food processor, whirl 1/2 package of the cookies, including filling, until they form fine crumbs; mix in butter. Scoop crumbs into a 9-inch cheesecake pan with removable bottom and press crumbs evenly over bottom of pan and about 1/2-inch up sides. Chill crust to firm, about 20 minutes.
Boil macaroni in salted water 6 minutes. Drain and rinse well to remove starch.
Set aside.
Dissolve jello	in
hot water.	Add pineapple and blueberries. Chill until firm.
Crumble cake in baking pan.
Put berries over cake.
Let set in freezer while you mix pudding and milk.
Pour mix over cake.
Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.
Top with Cool Whip.
Heat oven to 350°.
Grease bottom only of 13 x 9-inch pan.
In large bowl, combine brownie mix, water, oil and egg.
Beat 50 strokes by hand.
Add frosting and sour cream; mix well.
Spread batter in greased pan.
Sprinkle pecans and chocolate chips evenly over top.
Bake at 350° for 42 to 52 minutes.
Cool completely.
Combine caramels, 1/3 cup evaporated milk and 1/4 cup margarine in a double boiler until melted.
Combine cake mix, 1/2 cup margarine, 1/3 cup evaporated milk and 1 cup walnuts.
Spread half in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 6 minutes at 350°.
Sprinkle with chocolate chips.
Spread caramel mixture over the chips.
Top with remaining cake mix.
Bake 18 minutes at 350°.
Do not bake longer!
Cut into bars.
In medium saucepan, combine all ingredients (except optional). Over low heat, simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes.
Serve hot with butter and cinnamon sticks, if desired.
Beat all ingredients together in large mixing bowl for 2 minutes.
Pour into 2 greased 9-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Makes 15 slices per loaf.
(Also, can use for muffins.)
Contains less than 1 gram of fat per 1/2-inch slice.

recipes.t: Mauna Loa Muffins(Third Place Winner Of 1992 Mauna Loa Contest)
d: Preheat oven to 400°.
Spray muffin
tins
with cooking spray. In
large
bowl,	beat milk, oil and
egg.
Blend
in remaining ingredients until flour is just
moistened.
Fill in muffin cups 3/4 full;
sprinkle with sugar.
Bake
until
tops are browned, for 15 to 18 minutes.
Makes 10 to 12 muffins.
Sift all
ingredients.
Place
in
bowl and add 1/2 cup melted shortening,
cups water and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Mix well and bake
in
layers in a moderate oven for 30 minutes or until done.
Cut 3 thin gashes on each wiener.
In medium saucepan over medium heat, cook remaining ingredients, stirring, until cranberry sauce melts and becomes smooth.
Add wieners and heat through. Serve hot with cocktail picks.
Makes 48 appetizers.
Skin chicken breasts and arrange in baking dish.
Place 1 piece of Swiss cheese in each piece of chicken.
Stir together soup and wine or water.
Spoon over chicken.
Top with stuffing mix and drizzle melted butter over each piece of chicken.
Bake, uncovered, for 55 minutes.
In 1 1/2-quart casserole, combine soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper. Stir in beans and 1/2 can fried onions. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Stir, then top with remaining onions.
Bake 5 minutes. Serves 6.
*Save some nuts and cherries for top.
Mix well and serve with fresh fruit.
Make jello according to directions.
When fairly thick, whip the milk.
Add to jello (using large bowl).
Add sugar, lemon juice and vanilla.
Put 1/2 of crumbs into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add jello mixture.
Put remainder of crumbs on top.
Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.t: Pasta With Broccoli Di Rape And Sausage
d: Remove the long stems and tough outer leaves from the Broccoli di Rape.
Keep florets and small leaves, cut up, place in colander and wash several times.
Pour oil into pan on medium heat.
Lightly crush garlic, place in heated oil and allow to turn golden, then remove garlic if you wish.
Remove casing from sausage, place meat in pan and cook thoroughly, breaking the pieces of meat apart as they continue to cook.
If you still have not removed the garlic, do so now.
Drain all but 1 tablespoon oil from pan; add Broccoli di Rape to pan and mix with cooked sausage.
Keep mixing together, add your broth, mix and cook for approximately 5 minutes.
Mix flour and butter together to form a roux and stir into your mixture.
Cook approximately 5 minutes more until sauce thickens. Serve over pasta and add the grated Italian cheese of choice.

Brown hamburger and sausage. In a large casserole dish, slice potatoes and onion (in rings). Put cheese 1 cup on top of potatoes and onion. Layer browned meat on top of potatoes, onion and cheese. Then put a can of green beans, drained.
Mix all ingredients.
Put in baking dish.
Bake until golden brown.
Combine ingredients and bake
in
a greased 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 minutes at 350°.
Cool.
Combine all ingredients.
Bake at 300° for about 1 hour and 40 minutes.
In large bowl, mix pineapple and sugar.
In saucepan, bring water and gelatin to a boil.
Pour over sugar and pineapple and stir.
Refrigerate until slightly set.
Add carrots, celery, cottage cheese, nuts, whipped topping and mayonnaise to pineapple mixture.
Refrigerate until set.
Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Saute onion and green pepper until transparent.
Add both cans of tomato, then remaining ingredients.
Stir and simmer 30 minutes.
Brown sirloin with onion.
Add other ingredients.
Simmer 15 minutes or so.
Serve open-faced on bread of choice.
Simmer first 5 ingredients together 20 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients.
Simmer 30 more minutes.
Drain chilies and olives.
In mixing bowl, combine all ingredients except tortillas.
Spread mixture onto tortillas and roll up jelly roll fashion.
Cover with damp paper towel and plastic wrap to prevent drying out.
Chill for several hours.
To serve, slice tortillas into 1-inch segments.
Serve with salsa for dipping.
Do not use electric mixer.
Use hand wire whisk.
Slightly beat egg yolks; stir in 1 cup milk.
Then stir in remaining milk, sugar and coconut.
Beat egg whites and stir in mixture.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until centers jell.
Combine sugar, water, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Bring to a boil and add oleo.
Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
Cut in shortening.
Add milk, all at once.
Stir until flour is moistened.
Cook green beans; drain.
Cook onion and parsley in butter until onion is tender.
Blend in flour, lemon peel, 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper.
Add milk, cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
Stir in sour cream and cooked beans; heat until just bubbly.
Spoon into 1-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Melt the remaining butter; toss with bread crumbs and sprinkle over beans.
Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat until cheese melts and crumbs brown, 1 to 2 minutes.
Saute celery and onion in butter or margarine.
Cook broccoli and drain.
Mix all ingredients together and pour into greased 13 x 9-inch casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Mix sauce and cream cheese, set aside.
Put lettuce on platter and spread out.
Spread cream cheese mix on top of lettuce.
Layer tomatoes, peppers, onion and olives on top.
Serve with nacho chips.
Cream sugar and shortening; add egg yolks.
Sift flour and soda together; add alternately with buttermilk.
Add vanilla, coconut and chopped nuts.
Fold in beaten egg whites.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Combine just until moistened.
Spoon into muffin pan with liners.
Bake at 400 degrees for 15-18 minutes or until done. Makes 12 muffins.
Cut bacon into small pieces (or crumble sausage into small pieces); fry.
When meat is browned, add bell pepper and onion. Cook until onion starts to clear.
Beat eggs with milk.
Add egg mixture to meat and vegetables.
Top with cheese and cover.
Melt butter.
Add sugar, nuts and cinnamon.
Pour 1/2 of this over the biscuits.
Do other 2 cans of biscuits same as first 2 cans.
Pour remaining mixture over top.
Put water and raisins in large pan; boil for 5 minutes (cool).
While still warm, add all other ingredients.
Mix together well.
Add nuts last.
Grease cans fully to top.
Half fill them.
Bake
until well brown in 350° oven for 45 to 60 minutes.
Cool for short time.
While still warm, tip out of can on wax paper.
(Use 3 or 4 No. 2 cans, vegetable or fruit.)
Mix all ingredients well except crumbs.
Bake at 350° until bubbly.
Cream butter and sugar together until mixture is light and fluffy.
Add egg, raisins, nuts and applesauce and mix together thoroughly.
Sift all the dry ingredients together 3 times.
Add to the creamed mixture and blend thoroughly.
Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet.
Bake in moderate oven for 15 minutes.
In a bowl mix all ingredients together except the crumbs or chips and put into refrigerator for 8 to 24 hours before serving time.
In a baking dish, a 1 1/2-quart greased casserole, put ingredients and top with crumbled chips or bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° uncovered.
Mix carrots, onion, celery, sour cream and cheese.
Pour into 1-quart baking dish.
Melt oleo; add 1/2 cup cheese and Pepperidge Farm dressing.
Mix and sprinkle over carrot mixture.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Cover with foil, if topping is getting too brown.
Cream butter and brown sugar.
Add beaten egg and then dry ingredients.
Add nuts and chocolate bits last.
Bake in a square pan, 8 x 8-inch.
Bake 25 minutes at 350°.

Mix salt, pepper & paprika. Rub into surface of chicken, using it all. Place chicken in crockpot. Alternate layers of chicken, bouillion granules, mushrooms and onions. Pour chicken soup mixture over chicken. Do not stir. Cover & cook on high for 2 1/2 to 3 hours or on low 5-6 hours until chicken is tender.
Cook chicken until tender; remove from bones and cut into bite size pieces.
Save broth.
Fry bacon until crisp.
Break into small pieces.
Saute onions and celery in bacon fat.
Add tomatoes, soup, drained olives, chicken and bacon.
Cook spaghetti in broth and add to chicken mixture.
Salt and pepper to taste; mix well.
Cover with grated cheese.
May use two 9 x 9-inch casseroles or one 3-quart casserole.

Stir together syrup and sugar in a deep microwave-safe bowl. Cook 4 minutes on High.
Stir in nuts.
Cook 3 3/4 minutes on High.
Add margarine and vanilla; stir.
Cook 1 1/2 minutes.
Add soda.
Stir until light and foamy.
Pour on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Do not spread.
Let cool.
Break into pieces.
Boil until soft ball stage the cocoa, sugar, butter and milk. Remove from heat.
Immediately stir in the vanilla, oats and nuts. Drop on waxed paper by spoonfuls; ready to eat when cool (about 15 minutes).
Mix together in crock-pot. Start out on high; then once simmering, turn to low for 5 to 6 hours.
Melt butter in
large
skillet.
Add remaining ingredients, then pecans.
Stir well.
Arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally until they are golden
brown.
Remove
and drain on paper towels.
Cook squash and onion in small amount of water. Drain and mash.
Fold in butter, eggs, soup, salt and pepper.
Place in buttered casserole dish and top with cracker crumbs and Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Mix prepared pasta and vegetables in a large bowl.
Add dressing.
Mix lightly.
Refrigerate several hours.
Stir and serve.
Melt
butter
and mix in stuffing.
Line part of casserole dish
with part of stuffing.
Spoon in other ingredients (mixed together).	Cover with remainder of stuffing.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Mix cake mix and Jell-O dry.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Mix all ingredients together.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
Empty soup into 2-quart casserole.
Stir in milk gradually. Stir in remaining ingredients.
Cover tightly and microwave on High 20 to 35 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes, until tender. Let stand covered for 5 minutes.
Mix all ingredients together with pastry blender.
Drop by big spoon onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake 20 minutes at 400°.
Makes 6 to 8 scones.
Serve warm with jam, jelly or honey.
Quick, easy and good.
They freeze well.
Heat in microwave a few seconds.
Combine all ingredients, form into small balls.
Brown lightly in oil.
Drain off excess.
Add tomato sauce and water.
Cover tightly.
Simmer for 45 to 50 minutes, until rice is done.
Combine sugar,
condensed milk and water.
Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves and mixture boils.
Cook to 330° until soft ball forms in cold water.
Drop into inner circle of cooled cakes and bake 5 minutes only at 400°.
Combine Miracle Whip, Italian dressing and cheese. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients. Mix lightly. Serve chilled.
Brown meat in oil in electric skillet or large frying pan. Add celery and onion; cover and cook slowly 10 minutes.
Add tomato paste, water, noodles, cheese, olives, salt and pepper; stir to combine.
Cook slowly until noodles are tender, about 30 minutes.
Boil peppers until tender (firm, but tender), then drain. Brown hamburger, seasoned with chili and set aside.
Saute onion and bread chunks in a small amount of leftover hamburger drippings.
Add stewed tomatoes and hamburger, mixing thoroughly. Fill peppers with mixture.
Nice served with jello on the side with a vegetable.
Mix bourbon and soy sauce in flat roasting pan, preferably steel.
Marinate steak for at least 5 hours, more if you have time.
Barbecue as usual, seasoning steak as desired while cooking.
Sauce may be stored in refrigerator and used again. Double ingredients if necessary as meat should almost be covered while marinating.

Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix all ingredients except crescent rolls. Arrange crescent rolls in a circle with the bases overlapping in the middle and the pointed ends outward. Put the mixture in the base part and fold the points inward. Bake about 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. You can substitute boiled, cut up chicken and slivered almonds for canned chicken and water chestnuts.
Mix together first 5 ingredients and put in buttered dish. Salt and pepper one side of chicken and put seasoning salt on the other side.
Stand breast up in dish over rice and soup.
Melt 1 stick of butter and pour over top of chicken.
Bake for 2 hours at 275°.
Combine first 4 ingredients in large saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Simmer on reduce heat for 20 minutes or until tender.
Melt butter in small pan.
Add flour, salt and pepper; blend.
Add milk, stirring until mixture boils.
Add cheese and cook until cheese melts.
Stir cheese sauce into vegetable mixture.
Makes 1 1/2 quarts.
Saute onion slowly in butter.
Smooth in flour and brown.
Add bouillon cube dissolved in boiling water and juice from can of mushrooms.
Let simmer for about 5 minutes.
Stir in mushrooms and cook until heated through.
Serve over wild rice.
Makes 4 servings.
Cook spinach according to package.
Drain well.
Combine ingredients and mix.
Shape into 3/4 inch balls.
Place on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Yields: 11 dozen.
Can be frozen before baked.
Thaw slightly and bake for 20 to 25 minutes.
Put all ingredients, except vanilla, in top of boiler.
Stir until well mixed.
Place over simmering, but not boiling, water. Cook, beating constantly with electric mixer at high speed, for about 7 minutes, or until icing becomes stiff and glossy.
Remove from heat and add vanilla.
Stir until blended.
Combine ketchup, soy sauce and brown sugar.
Add chicken wings and mix well.
Put in bowl and cover.
Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for about 1/2 hour.
Lower to 325° and bake for 45 minutes.
Combine first 5 ingredients and set aside.
Mix eggs, pumpkin and oil.
Stir into dry ingredients to moisten.
Stir in apples and other fruit.
Fill muffin pans 3/4 full.
Grease pans or use paper holders.
Sprinkle topping on each muffin.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Crush vanilla wafers to fine crumbs.
Add powdered sugar, butter, orange juice and nuts.
Mix well with hands.
Form into balls.
Chill.
Store in refrigerator.
If desired, roll in coconut immediately after shaping.

Brown meat and onion in skillet. Drain off fat. Mix together soups, enchilada sauce and chilies. Add drained meat to this mixture. Grate and mix together Velveeta and Cheddar. In a deep casserole (9 x 12), alternate layers of 4 to 6 corn tortillas, 1/2 meat
mixture and 1/2 grated cheese. Repeat layers. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serves about 8.
Put over batter; then put rest of batter on top of apple mixture.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Gently	toss ingredients together.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours.
Cream 3/4 cup sugar with 2 tablespoons butter.
Stir in milk. Sift flour, 2 tablespoons cocoa, baking powder and salt together. Add sifted ingredients to the creamed mixture and mix until smooth.
Add chopped walnuts and spread in a buttered 9-inch pan. Mix well 1/2 cup sugar, brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa.
Sprinkle over the batter.
Pour boiling water over the top and bake in 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.
In a microwave oven, cook spinach (without water) covered for about 6 to 8 minutes, until spinach is hot.
Remove from oven and drain well.
Mix together sour cream and salad dressing mix and then stir into the spinach.
Pour into greased casserole dish. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese and paprika on top.
Return to microwave for 3 to 4 minutes or may be baked in a regular oven for 25 to 30 minutes at 325°.
(I prefer the regular oven.)
Cream sugar with shortening.
Add eggs, unbeaten.
Add vanilla. Add sifted dry ingredients alternating with milk to which baking soda has been added.
Roll on floured board.
Cut and fry in hot, deep fat.
Mix well.
Place
into uncooked pie shell.
Cook for 15 minutes on 325°.
Turn oven to 350° and cook 30 minutes more.
Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Cook at 350° for 20 minutes.
Pour milk into blender.
Add pudding mix.
Blend in blender 1 to 2 minutes.
Refrigerate 1 hour.
Gently stir in whipped topping. Place wafers in bottom and sides of Pyrex dish.
Put in pudding mixture.
Add bananas and more vanilla wafers.
Repeat in layers until reaches top.
Last layer is cream mixture.
Place in refrigerator until time to serve.
Mix shortening, sugar
and
egg
well (will look sour). Blend flour, soda,
salt and nutmeg.
Mix all together.
Chill 1 hour or longer.
Drop
by
rounded teaspoon approximately 2 inches apart on
lightly
greased
baking sheet.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400°. Makes approximately 5 dozen.
In a saucepan cook onion, garlic, and tarragon in margarine. Stir in cornstarch.
Add milk all at once.
Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly.
Gradually add cheeses, stirring till melted.
Serve with bread or chips.
Makes 2 cups.
Combine blueberries, sugar, cornstarch and water in saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring until thick. Cool.
Set oven at broil and/or 550°.
Shape meat into 8 thin patties; sprinkle with salt.
Place pineapple slice on each of 4 patties. Top with remaining patties and press edges together to seal.
Place patties on rack in broiler pan.
Broil with tops 4-inches from heat until brown, 3 to 5 minutes.
Mix brown sugar, ketchup and mustard. Turn patties.
Spoon mixture on patties and broil until desired doneness, 3 to 5 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.
The day before serving, drain and dry fruits on paper towels. Arrange fruit on shallow "bake and serve" dish.
Sprinkle with brown sugar.
Melt butter and add curry powder.
Pour over fruit. Bake 1 hour at 325°.
Refrigerate and reheat until bubbly hot when ready to serve.
Cooking the casserole one day early allows curry flavor to penetrate fruits for best flavor.
Serves 12.
Roll 1/4 inch thick.
Cut into whatever shape you choose. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.
In a 2-quart non-metal container, combine bourbon, lemonade, beer and lemon juice.
Refrigerate.
Serve over ice and garnish with mint leaves and lemon slices, if desired.
Makes 8 (1/2-cup) servings.
Preheat skillet.
Mix eggs, milk, salt and pepper.
Pour mixture into skillet.
When eggs are done, turn burner to simmer. Break cheese into 4ths and place on eggs.
Serve after cheese melts.
In a large skillet that has been sprayed with Pam, cook turkey until brown.
Combine all other ingredients and add to turkey. Simmer on low heat for 15 minutes.
Mix Jell-O and hot water; cool.
When partially set, add pineapple, marshmallows and bananas.
Chill to set in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix all together and put into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Let stand overnight or a few hours to blend flavors.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until golden brown on top.
Makes 12 servings.
Cream the butter.
Add Crisco, milk and eggs; blend.
Add flour, salt, baking powder and sugar; beat well with mixer 2 to 3 minutes.
Pour into well-greased and floured cake pan.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour, then at 275° for 1 1/2 hours.
Cook pasta as directed and cool.
Chop up vegetables, any size you please.
Mix pasta, vegetables, Italian dressing and Salad Supreme (1/2 to 3/4 jar) to taste.
Mix together and bake.
Cookies are very good and moist.
Mix and set in refrigerate or 3 hours or overnight.
Place the first four ingredients in a blender; cover and process until smooth.
Pour into glasses; garnish with orange and cherries if desired.
Preheat oven to 375°.
Fully cook sausage and drain well.
Mix sausage, onions, cheese and flour.
Beat eggs and milk; pour over the sausage mixture.
Mix all well and pour into pie shell.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes.
Mix ingredients.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Add cracker crumbs or bread crumbs on top of cheese.
Bake at 400° until brown.
Boil sugar, milk, oleo and chocolate to soft ball stage.
Beat while cooling.
Mix together marshmallows, graham crackers, nuts and vanilla.
Add this to the chocolate mixture.
Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 10 minutes at 350°.
Check with toothpick.
Mix broccoli, cheese and 1/4 cup butter together and place in a 2-quart casserole dish.
Mix crackers and 1/4 cup butter, melted together, and sprinkle on broccoli mixture.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.
Serves 4 to 6.
Layer the first 5 ingredients in order given.
Top with mayonnaise, bacon and cheese.
Garnish with tomato wedges and cucumber slices. Refrigerate at least 6 hours before serving.
Mix all together and form a loaf.
Place in pan and bake at 350° for 90 minutes.
Rub a mixing bowl with the garlic clove which has been cut in half.
(I use garlic salt to taste instead of fresh garlic.) Place the cream cheese in a bowl and cream with a spoon until smooth and gradually add the remaining ingredients, blending well.
Add water to unpeeled potatoes just to cover.
Sprinkle with salt.
Bring to boiling for 30 to 35 minutes.
Drain.
Peel and shred potatoes with a grater.
In a large mixing bowl combine potatoes, cheese and butter; stir until butter is melted.
Stir in sour cream, green onion, salt and the pepper.
Transfer to a greased pan.
Bake, uncovered, in a 325° oven for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika.
Makes 8 servings.
Mix the first 6 ingredients together.
Just before serving add the can of onions and stir.
Mix all ingredients together (except fried onions).
Place in 9 x 13-inch pan, which has been sprayed with Pam.
Bake for 60 minutes, covered.
Uncover and sprinkle with fried onions.
Bake for additional 15 minutes.
Combine the cream cheese, lemon juice, horseradish and seasonings in bowl; mix well.
Add salmon; mix well.
Chill in refrigerator overnight.
Arrange peaches in an 8 x 8-inch pan.
In a small bowl, combine oats, sugar, flour and spices. Cut in butter until coarse crumbs form. Sprinkle over peaches. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve warm with cream or ice cream.
Brown meat and onions. Add rest of ingredients. Bring to boil. Simmer 20 minutes.
(May include 3 to 4 quartered potatoes.)
Brown venison; drain any grease.
In a large stew pot, add all ingredients and bring to a boil.
Reduce temperature to a simmer. Simmer for 30 minutes.
Season to taste with garlic salt and black pepper.

recipes.t: Cherry Nut Icing For Banana Nut Cake
d: Cook
the
sugar,
milk and Karo until soft ball stage. Add dates, cherries, pecans, butter and vanilla.
Soak raisins in hot water for 10 minutes; drain.
Mix the flour with sugar.
Add beaten egg yolks.
Cream together and add cream and raisins.
Cook over low heat, stirring until thick. Cool and add vanilla.
Pour into baked pie shell.
Make meringue from egg whites and bake until nicely browned.
Mix dry ingredients in mixer bowl.
Add buttermilk, margarine and eggs.
Mix well and beat at medium speed for 2 to 3 minutes. Bake in heated waffle iron.
Brown beef and onions; dip off excess grease. Add soups and cook to bubble stage. Pour into greased casserole dish. Put Tater Tots on top. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until Tater Tots are brown.
Mix Bisquick, 1/2 cup sugar and 3 tablespoons cocoa in a greased 8-inch square baking dish.
Stir in milk and vanilla until well blended.
Sprinkle evenly with remaining 1/3 cup cocoa and 1/2 cup sugar.
Pour water on top.
Bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes or until top is firm.
Serve at once, topped with ice cream.
Combine the ingredients in a large pot.
Heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Be careful not to let mixture boil or the cider will become to heavily spiced.
Pour into mugs and serve with cheese or popcorn.
Brown pork in oil and set aside.
Saute celery and onion in pork juices until limp.
In a bowl, mix hamburger with onion soup mix.
Form into meatballs and fry until done.
While frying meatballs, put chili sauce and grape jelly in crock-pot with 1 onion and let cook. When meatballs are done, place in crock-pot and serve.
Great for parties!
Heat oven to 350°.
Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch rectangular pan. Mix brown sugar, margarine, eggs and vanilla in large bowl.
Stir in flour, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves.
Stir in zucchini and raisins.
Spread in pan.
Bake 25 to 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean; cool.
Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.
Cut into 2 x 1 1/2-inch bars. Refrigerate any remaining bars.
Makes 32 bars.
In a bowl mix flour, sugar, cornstarch and salt.
Add cooking oil and add white; stir until smooth.
Add water and mix well. Make one cookie at a time.
Pour 1 tablespoon of the batter on a greased skillet.
Spread into a circle.
Cook 4 minutes on one side and 1 minute on the other at low temperature.
Working quickly, put a message in the cookie.
Fold in half and in half again.
Cream sugar, margarine and eggs.
Mix flour, powdered sugar and salt.
Then mix slowly together.
Roll into balls (size of walnuts).
Roll in mixture of sugar and cinnamon.
Place 2 1/2-inches apart on ungreased sheet.
Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Mix all together and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Add 1/2 cup water to beans and top with bacon strips before cooking.
On the day before:
Drain yogurt through cheesecloth and refrigerate.
Chop peppers and onions and refrigerate.
Grate cheese and refrigerate.
Use 9 x 13-inch casserole.
Spray with Pam.
Spread chopped bell peppers, onions and grated jalapeno cheese.
In separate bowl, beat eggs, yogurt, milk, salt and pepper.
Pour over peppers, onions and cheese mixture.
Sprinkle the one cup grated Cheddar cheese over entire casserole.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Let cool ten minutes before serving. Serves 8 to 10.
Beat egg yolks until lemon colored.
Add sugar; beat well. Add flour, salt and vanilla.
Beat egg whites until frothy.
Add cream of tartar and beat until very stiff.
Add egg yolk mixture to whites, folding carefully.
Pour into large ungreased angel food pan.
Bake 1 hour at 300°.

recipes.t: Kim'S Ham And Hash Brown Omelet
d: Cook bacon until crisp; crumble.
Cook ham; crumble.
Add potatoes, onion and pepper to skillet and cook until brown and crisp.
Blend eggs and milk; pour over potatoes.
Top with cheese, bacon and ham.
Cover and cook at low temperature for 10 minutes. Serve in 4 wedges.
Melt chocolate in double boiler.
Add the remaining ingredients and mix very well.
Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper. Allow to air dry.
Store in an airtight container.
Mix all top 4 ingredients together real good. Make into small balls and press 1 Kiss in each.
Place on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake 5 minutes in a 350° oven.
Yields 3 dozen.
Fix 1 large or 2 small boxes of stuffing mix.
Fix according to directions, but use a little less water so it's on the dry side. Boil and chunk up chicken (2 cups or so).
Mix with mayonnaise and a little salt.
Layer 1/2 of dressing mix in 9 x 13-inch pan, spread chicken over it.
Then put rest of dressing over this.
Mix eggs plus 1 cup milk together, pour over top.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Set out 1 hour before baking.
Mix cream of chicken soup with 1/2 cup milk, pour over top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Brown ground meat; drain.
Heat tortillas until soft, if you want to roll enchiladas.
The fast way is to layer in a greased casserole dish, tortillas, meat, onions and cheese until used up. Finish with tortillas.
Mix and heat remaining ingredients.
Pour over casserole.
Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 375°.
Grease an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Arrange apples in pan.
Mix remaining ingredients with fork. Sprinkle over apples.
Bake until apples are tender and topping is golden brown.
Serve with cream, Dream Whip or ice cream.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine first five ingredients in a Dutch oven or covered baking dish and bake 1 1/2 hours.
Serve over cooked noodles.
Mix all together, adding enough ketchup to color.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Mix ground beef, ham, eggs, milk, mustard and corn flakes. Grease muffin tins and sprinkle brown sugar over bottom of muffin cups.
Spread pineapple over brown sugar.
Shape meat mixture into balls and place in muffin cups.
This is great for entertaining. (This can be made in 10 x 15-inch pan.) Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Makes 15 individual loaves.
Crush Doritos and place in bottom of greased casserole. Prepare beef according to taco seasoning directions; place taco meat over crushed Doritos; combine soups and pour over meat.
Top with cheese.
Bake at 350° until bubbly.
Mix all ingredients well and serve.
Blend all ingredients together and refrigerate until ready to serve.
Microwave last 3 ingredients until butter melts and then stir and put back in bowl for 2 minutes.
Take out and add 1/2 teaspoon soda; stir.
Cook spinach 7 minutes. Saute onions in butter and add cheese. Combine spinach with cheese mixture. Spread on French bread. Bake 5 to 10 minutes at 350°.
Brown meat.
Add salt, mustard, butter, onion, pepper and one cup of water.
Pressure cook 10 to 12 minutes.
Make thickening of 2 tablespoons of flour and water.
Stir into cooked meat.
Add mushrooms, simmer until thickened.
Add sour cream.
Serve over noodles or rice.
Crush vanilla wafers.
Add the remaining ingredients.
Mix well and form into balls.
Roll in additional powdered sugar. Makes about 2 dozen small balls.
Combine all ingredients.
Dice in apples and add nuts.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour in Bundt pan or two 8 x 8-inch pans.
Cream butter and sugar in large mixing bowl until light.
Add egg, mixing well.
Stir in flour until well combined.
Add remaining ingredients; mix well.
Shape dough into 2 long rolls; wrap each roll in waxed paper.
Chill several hours.
Slice rolls into 1/4-inch slices and place on cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 7 to 8 minutes.

Slowly cook onions in butter until lightly browned.
Add bouillon cubes and water to onions.
Cover and simmer 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Add Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper to soup; stir.
When serving soup, place a thin slice of French bread into the bottom of the bowl (must be able to go into the oven).
Ladle soup into bowls; top with layer of shredded cheese.
Place under broiler until cheese melts.
Serve at once.
Saute onion and celery in 1 stick oleo.
Add water, potatoes, salt and pepper.
Cook until tender.
Add corn, soups and milk. Garnish with parsley.
Do not dilute soups.

In large skillet, saute sausage until done; add onion and butter until soft. Add potatoes; saute until lightly browned. Beat eggs, salt, pepper and water; pour over sausage-potato mixture. Cook until eggs are set. Turn with spatula. Cook other side. Serves 4.
Combine ingredients (first seven) and rub on chicken wings. Let stand for 15 minutes.
Saute wings in oil and butter until lightly browned.
Drain excess fat.
Add garlic, jalapeno and beer and simmer until liquid has turned to a glaze.
Mix all ingredients together.
Bake in greased pan at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Remove stems and seeds from green peppers and cut into chunks. In ovenproof dish, saute green peppers in olive oil until soft (on top of stove).
Sprinkle with a little salt.
Remove green peppers from dish; brown sausage in same dish.
Add red wine and cover; bake for 40 minutes at 350°.
Uncover, add sauteed green pepper and bake 30 more minutes.
Serve in same dish.
Mix the sugar, milk, butter and soda in saucepan.
Cook to soft ball stage. The soda turns the sugar to caramel taste and color as it cooks.
Remove from stove.
Cool a few minutes. Add vanilla, then beat.
Before mixture begins to stiffen, add nuts and spoon onto wax paper.

Mix and spread on greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips and spread on top of mixture.
Set in refrigerator.
Cut into squares when set.
Brown sausage and onion.
Add remaining ingredients and bake in casserole at 350°.
Serves 4.
Sausage Casserole plus a salad makes a fine low cholesterol meal.
Combine the preceding and shape into balls.
Place in roaster with 1 can tomato soup and 1 can tomato sauce well blended.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or longer.
Wash and
slice
to	8
squash
and boil until done. Drain excess
water and add 1/2 stick margarine and mash.

Sprinkle cheese and potato chips on top.
Bake in a 425° oven for 15 minutes.
In a bowl, mix beef, Parmesan cheese, onion, tomato paste, oregano, salt and pepper, just until combined.
Toast the muffins in broiler until lightly browned.
Divide meat mixture among muffins.
Broil 4 inches from the heat for 8 to 10 minutes or until meat is cooked.
Top with tomato and cheese slices.
Return to broiler until cheese is melted.
If desired, sprinkle with oregano.
Serve immediately.

Brown hamburger and drain; stir in beans, tomato sauce, taco mix, onion, bell pepper, mustard and 1/4 to 1/2 teaspoon of chili powder.

Spread into ungreased pie plate.
Spread sour cream on top of hamburger mixture.

x 8
x 2 inch baking dish.

Arrange chicken, cavity side up, in a single layer in bag, spooning mixture evenly over top.
Tie bag; pierce top with 2 to 3 small slits.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes.
Mix together all ingredients in large stew pot, adding enough water to achieve desired consistency between
soup or thick stew. Simmer on low to medium-low for 3 or 4 hours.

Mix cream cheese, 1 cup sugar and Cool Whip

cheese.

Roll in flour mixture, then eggs, then croutons.
Cook in butter, 4 minutes per side.
Serve with white sauce or milk gravy.
Fry meat in skillet until done; drain well.
Put meat, chili powder, cayenne, salt and pepper in large pot.
Fill with water. Boil 3 to 4 hours, adding water when needed.
Add onions.
Cook until tender.
Add tomato sauce; stir well.
Spoon off grease that is floating on top.
Add a little cracker meal for grease you cannot remove.
This helps thicken chili.
Add 2 more teaspoons chili powder.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Add beans.
The longer the meat and chili powder boil, the better the chili taste.
Soak beans overnight. Brown salt pork in shortening. Brown onions. Add flour, browning to form a roux.
Add beans and enough water to cover well. Simmer 2 hours.
Serve with rice. Serves 8.

recipes.t: Cheese And Pasta In A Pot
d: Cook ground beef in small amount of oil in large deep skillet until brown.
Drain excess fat.
Add onions, garlic, spaghetti sauce, stewed tomatoes and undrained mushrooms; mix well.
Simmer 20 minutes.
Cook macaroni, drain and rinse in cold water (as per package directions).
Pour half of shells into deep casserole. Cover with half of tomato-meat mixture and half of sour cream. Top with Provolone.
Repeat layering and end with Mozzarella cheese.
Cover casserole.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Remove cover and bake until cheese melts and browns.
In a large bowl, stir together the juices, the Curacao, the sugar and the cherries and let the mixture stand, covered and chilled, overnight.
Stir in the brandy and champagne; serve over ice.
Makes about 18 cups.
Mix sauce. Use ingredients from mayonnaise to tarragon from list.
Salt and pepper each chicken breast.
Use two phyllo sheets per breast.
Spread one sheet with melted butter.
Spread another sheet with melted butter and lay it on top of first one. Coat a chicken breast with sauce and roll it up in the phyllo sheets, tucking the dough around chicken.
Repeat with each chicken breast.
Place each breast (tuck down) on baking sheet.
Don't let them touch.
Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Freeze or bake.
If frozen, thaw completely before baking.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Simmer first 4 ingredients 10 minutes.
Add hot dogs.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Serve.
Makes approximately 50.
Honey wieners work better.
You may add more wieners if you wish.
Mix all ingredients except paprika with fork until well blended.
Place in casserole dish and sprinkle with grated sharp cheese and paprika.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until bubbly.
Serve with crackers.
Blend flour and margarine.
Add nuts.
Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Cool.
Preheat oven to 350°.
In a medium saucepan, combine chocolate chips and margarine.
Cook and stir over low heat until chips are melted and smooth.
Add sweetened condensed milk; mix well.
In a medium bowl, combine flour, nuts, chocolate mixture and vanilla. Mix well.
Shape 1 tablespoon of dough around each candy kiss, covering completely.
Place 1-inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 6 to 8 minutes.
Do not overcook. Cookies will be soft and appear shiny but become firm as they cool.
Cook rotini according to package directions. Drain. Rinse the pasta with cold water and drain. Combine pasta and remaining ingredients. Toss well. Serve immediately or chill until serving time.

Generously grease large baking sheet and set aside. Combine sugar and corn syrup in 2 quart glass measure bowl. Cook on high for 4 minutes. Stir in peanuts with wooden spoon and cook on high for 4 minutes. Stir in butter and vanilla and cook on high for 2 minutes. Add baking soda and stir until mixture is light and foamy. Pour on prepared baking sheet. Spread quickly to edges using back of wooden spoon. As candy cools stretch to a thin sheet using palms of hands. Cool completely before breaking into pieces. Store in airtight container.
Mix flour with corn flakes.
Add cayenne pepper.
Grate into this sharp	cheese.
Mix
well.
Pour in melted butter or margarine (a little
more butter makes them easier to handle). Put in small balls on ungreased cookie sheet.
Press down flat with fork
tines.
Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.	Cut off oven and
let them
stay 10 minutes longer.
Makes 2 cookie sheets full.
Cook macaroni in salted water and drain.
Add egg yolks. Alternate layers of macaroni and cheese in greased baking dish. Place butter, flour, salt and pepper in double boiler; mix well. Add milk and cook until thickened.
Pour over macaroni and cheese mixture.
Fold in egg whites.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
Cream margarine and shortening.
Add chocolate and sugar. Blend well, then add vanilla and milk.
Trim fat from lamb.
Cut lamb into 3/4-inch cubes.
Heat oil in Dutch oven or large, heavy pan until hot.
Cook and stir lamb in oil over medium heat until brown, about 10 minutes.
Add water, garlic and 1 teaspoon of salt.
Cover and simmer over low heat for 40 minutes.
Combine all ingredients and adjust mayonnaise for desired creaminess.
Serves 8.
Cook hamburger and onions.
Drain grease.
Mix tomatoes, sauce and paste into mixture.
Drain beans and add and mix.
Add salt and pepper, hot sauce and chili powder to taste.
More will be hotter.
With pastry blender, mix 1/4 cup cold butter and the brown sugar.
Add rhubarb and mix well.
Spoon into bottom of 12 greased muffin cups.
Cream remaining 1/3 cup butter, white sugar and egg. Sift flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg.
Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk, mixing just enough to blend.
Spoon into muffin cups.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Mix ingredients together.
Heat small skillet of milk on medium heat.
Pour a little warm milk in mixture, then mix until smooth.
Pour back into hot milk and stir until thick, but not too thick.
Serve over hot biscuits.
Mix the 5 ingredients.
Make into balls and drop into melted chocolate chips with little paraffin wax.
Set on wax paper until dry.
Mix all ingredients together in a large pot; cover and bake at 200° for four hours or simmer for four hours.
Stir every hour.
If mixture becomes too thick, add the extra clam juice.
This freezes well.
Cook noodles.
Add to ingredients.
Mix chopped chicken, mushroom soup, Durkee sauce, onion, pimiento, 1/2 cup grated cheese and chicken broth.
Put in casserole dish and add rest of cheese on top.
Bake at 350° until bubbly.
Mix everything well.
Then add 2 cups flour.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Preheat
oven
to
Cook	peas per package directions, unseasoned	and
drained.
Set aside.
Saute onion and celery in the 1/2 cup margarine.
Add drained chestnuts, soup, flour	and peas.
Mix	together
well and cook slightly.
Add salt
and pepper
to	taste.	Melt
the
1/4 cup margarine in skillet
and add
the
herb
dressing.
Set
aside.
Pour all (except the dressing) into a medium casserole dish and bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until bubbly and hot.
Add dressing and brown slightly.
Stir graham cracker crumbs with sugar and melted oleo.
Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Dissolve Jell-O in hot water.
Mix cream cheese to soften, then add to Jell-O, a little at a time.
Fold in crushed pineapple; do not drain.
Add Cool Whip.
Pour on graham cracker crust and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Combine all ingredients except chocolate in large bowl.
Stir and knead until well blended.
Chill 30 minutes.
Roll into 1-inch balls.
Chill balls on baking sheets until firm.
Melt chocolate in glass measuring cup, stirring at least once.
Dip each ball into melted chocolate.
Chill until firm on wax paper.
Store in refrigerator.
Makes approximately 72 balls.
Combine ingredients in a large pan; bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes until pasta is done, stirring occasionally.
Yields 9 servings.
One cup per serving.
Top with Parmesan cheese, grated.
Place peach in center of salad plate.
Position egg for head, celery sticks for arms and legs and lettuce for skirt.
Add cheese for hair, cherry for mouth and raisins for eyes, nose, buttons and shoes.
Yields 1 serving.
Mix all ingredients well.
Place in deep dish pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Put bread slices in bottom of casserole dish.
Put chicken on top of bread.
Mix eggs, broth, milk and salt.
Pour this over bread and chicken. Put cheese slices on this, then soup on cheese. Brown bread crumbs in 1/4 cup of butter.
Spread crumbs on top of casserole.
Bake uncovered for 1 1/4 hours at 350°.
Cook spinach according to directions on package; drain well, reserving 1/2 cup spinach liquid.
Set aside.
In pan coated with nonstick cooking spray, melt margarine and saute onion until tender.
Add flour; stir.
Gradually add milk and spinach liquid to make sauce.
Cook until mixture thickens.
Add cheese and seasonings; cook until cheese is melted.
Add spinach to pan, combining well.
Yields 10 servings.
A favorite of spinach lovers.
Boil noodles and drain.
(If using lasagne, lay flat until ready to use.)
Combine dry ingredients.
Then add oil and other ingredients. Bake in a large square pan for 15 minutes at 350°.
Brown hamburger and add other ingredients.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Prepare first 3 ingredients and refrigerate in covered container for 24 hours.
Drain.
Add sugar and vinegar; let stand in refrigerator again for 24 hours.
Put in containers and freeze.
Mix mayonnaise, cream cheese, lemon juice, chili sauce and crabmeat
all together and fill mushroom caps with mixture. Cook 1 to 2 minutes on High in your microwave.
Watch carefully!
Step 1:
In a large bowl, combine vinegar, wine, onions, celery, spices, salt and pepper.
Wash meat with a damp cloth, put in marinade, cover and refrigerate for 3 days.
Turn meat occasionally.
Mix together and cook at 425° for 10 minutes, approximately. Serve with Wheat Thins.
Serve hot.
Let all-bran cereal and boiling water set in bowl.
Combine remaining ingredients.
Bake in 400° oven for 20 minutes.
Toast
muffins	or buns.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Spread tomato sauce on.
Cut bacon or pepperoni to make 12 triangular eyes and 6 half
moon mouths.
Arrange the eyes and mouths on muffins. Place
the mushrooms and/or olives to resemble hair. Place pizza faces
on
baking
sheet.
Bake
at
450° about 5 minutes or until hot.
Makes 6 servings.
Mix all ingredients, except egg roll skins.
Spoon 1 tablespoon onto egg roll skin; fold.
May use drop of water to seal edges.
Deep fat fry until brown on both sides.
May also use mixture for won tons.
Serve as a snack or as a side dish.
Soften butter and cheese.
Gradually add flour and paprika. Roll out and cut with cookie cutter or cookie gun.
Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.
Makes 4 dozen.
Slice vegetables then mix all ingredients.
Cream margarine and shortening; gradually add sugar and beat until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well. Combine flour and baking powder; add to creamed mixture alternately with cream of coconut.
(Begin and end with flour.) Stir in lemon rind and vanilla.
Pour into greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Cool in pan 10 to 15 minutes.
Remove and cool completely on wire rack.
Separate egg whites (keep aside for meringue).
Beat egg yolks well.
Add other ingredients and mix well.
Pour mixture into pie crust.
For meringue, beat 2 egg whites until frothy.
Add 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar and continue beating.
Gradually add tablespoon of sugar as beating continues until mixture is stiff. Spread meringue over pie filling.
(Be sure to seal edges around crust.) Bake at 350° for approximately 10 to 15 minutes or until meringue is light brown.
Chill in refrigerator.
Serves 8 people.
Combine all ingredients, except for the peppers, and simmer together until onion is nearly done.
Add peppers and continue simmering until all flavors are blended.
Store in refrigerator.
Melt caramels and cream in double boiler.
Combine oat mixture without chocolate chips. Spread 1/2 mixture into 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Blend well. Chill overnight.
Melt white chocolate in double boiler.
Add vanilla and stir - add peanuts and mix well.
Drop on cookie sheet lined with wax paper.
Let cool until firm.
Store in cool place.
Yield 2 - 3 dozen.
Mix cream cheese and mayonnaise; mix well.
Add remaining ingredients, one at a time, stirring well after each ingredient except pecans.
Refrigerate for several hours.
Roll into ball and roll in pecans until fully covered.
Melt the butter in a 2-quart casserole dish.
Add onions and cook for ten minutes.
Stir in beef bouillon, salt, flour and pepper.
Cover and cook another 10 minutes.
Spoon into individual bowls.
Toast bread and add to soup.
Cover with Mozzarella cheese. Heat on High for 1 minute and 15 seconds.
Stir sugar, corn syrup and water over low heat until sugar is dissolved.
Cook, without stirring, to 260° on candy thermometer (or until small amount of mixture dropped into very cold water forms a hard ball).
Mix all ingredients, except cheese, oleo and Ritz crackers. Spread the cheese on top after putting the ingredients in a casserole dish.
Melt oleo; crumble Ritz crackers (use your judgment as to how many).
Mix crumbs and oleo.
Spread on top of cheese.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.
Combine and boil sugar, butter and milk 1 minute.
Stir in oatmeal, coconut, nuts and vanilla.
Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.
Tear lettuce into small pieces.
Place in a 9 x 12-inch glass dish.
Layer next 6 ingredients in order given.
Add sugar to mayonnaise and spread over top as you would frosting.
Top with grated cheese.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 to 12 hours. Garnish with bacon bits and parsley.
Spin all ingredients together in the blender or food processor.
Serves 1.
Grease a 9 x 15-inch pan.
Layer onions, carrots and potatoes in pan.
Salt and pepper to taste and dot with butter.

Make syrup and bring to a hard boil. Add 8 finely chopped apples. Roll dough as for pie crust. Cut into squares. Add a small amount of syrup in bottom of a pan. Peel and core apples. Wrap each apple in a square of dough.
Place in pan.
Pour half of the syrup over dumplings.
Make sure that the top of the dough is secured around apple.
Bake at 350° for 60 minutes or until done. Ten minutes before removing from oven, pour remaining syrup on top of dumplings.
In a large bowl, mix all ingredients.
Pour batter into greased Bundt pan or tube pan.
Bake at 350° until toothpick comes out clean.
Heat oil in a large skillet. Season the chicken with salt and pepper.

Brown on both sides in the heated oil. Remove chicken from pan and set aside. Add green pepper, onion and garlic to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, about 5 minutes. Return chicken to pan. Cover and cook on medium-low for about 45 to 50 minutes, stirring often. Gently stir in frozen peas and cook for another 5 minutes. Serve with potatoes, rice or noodles. Makes 4 servings.

In a skillet, cook the beef, onion, green pepper and garlic over medium heat until meat is not pink. Drain. Add the tomato juice, macaroni, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until macaroni is tender. Makes 2 servings.
Cut up chicken breasts into cubes.
Add salt, pepper and seasoned salt into flour.
Dip chicken into flour, then in milk and egg mix, then back in flour.
Drop into hot grease, about 350°, until golden brown.
In saucepan, combine celery, bell pepper and onions.
Cook until tender and season lightly, if desired.
In a large mixing bowl, combine crumbled cornbread and crumbled loaf bread.
Add sauteed vegetables, boiled eggs and seasonings; toss well.
You may also add Pepperidge herb dressing for taste.
Now, add turkey broth and mix until desired consistency is reached.
You may stuff turkey and arrange turkey around or just bake in pan until done. Use a 350° oven.
Thaw spinach. Blend all ingredients and put in an 11 x 7-inch buttered casserole.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Cut in squares to serve.
Beat first 3 ingredients on high.
Add next 4 ingredients and beat on medium.
Spread in a greased 13 x 10 x 2-inch pan.
Top with coconut and nuts.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Grease an oblong pan.
Layer sausage, bread and cheese in pan. Mix all other ingredients.
Slowly pour mixture over layers.
Place in refrigerator overnight.
The next morning, bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

Cook vegetables per directions on package. Drain off excess water when done. While vegetables are cooking, heat butter, celery soup and cheese on low heat until cheese is melted. Add sauce mixture to drained vegetables and pour in casserole dish. Top with crushed Ritz crackers. Drizzle a small amount of melted butter over cracker crumbs. Bake in a 350° oven until crackers are lightly browned.
Place ingredients in a large skillet and cook over low heat, covered, for 25 to 35 minutes to desired tenderness of vegetables. Serve.
Enjoy!
This reheats well for leftovers.
Rinse chicken and pat dry with paper towels.
Stir butter (oleo) and garlic together in small bowl until well blended. Using your fingers, gently loosen skin on breast and smear about 2 teaspoons of oleo mixture under skin.
Spread remaining mixture over outside of chicken.
Add salt and pepper.
Bake on rack in pan at 375° for approximately 65 minutes.
Brown ground turkey in skillet.
Drain off excess fat.
Add meat into spaghetti sauce and simmer over stove while preparing the rest of the recipe.
Prepare pasta according to directions on box.
Spray with nonstick oil; add pasta and pour meat sauce over. Arrange pepperoni on top.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over the top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Let sit 10 minutes and sprinkle with grated cheese.
Makes 6 servings.
Cook in small baking dish at 350° for 20 minutes.
Sprinkle with paprika before serving.
Mix shortening, sugar, peanut butter, eggs and milk.
Add flour, salt and soda.
Melt chocolate chips.
Divide dough and roll each out into oblong.
Spread melted chocolate and roll. Refrigerate for 10 minutes.
Slice and cook for 8 to 10 minutes in a 350° oven.
Melt chocolate and butter in small saucepan over low heat. Remove and blend in egg.
Stir in the rest except coconut.
Shape in balls.
Roll in coconut.
Refrigerate on waxed baking sheet.
*If making your own crust, add a dash of thyme or poultry seasoning to flour.
If using prepared crust, just cut strips to fit whatever pan you use.
Heat oven to 350°.
Grease oblong pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inch.
Mix all ingredients.
Spread in pan.
Bake until golden brown, about 1/2 hour.
Cut into pieces, about 2 x 1-inch.
Mix together in a bowl.
Add dressing.
Beat Blue cheese, cream cheese, garlic, parsley and brandy in a small bowl on low speed until smooth.
Cover and refrigerate about 6 hours or until firm.
Brown ground beef and drain.
Cook macaroni as directed and drain.
Combine all ingredients in large casserole and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serve topped with Parmesan cheese.
Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add cold water and juice. Gradually add jello to cream cheese, mixing well until blended. Chill until thickened but not set.
Fold in marshmallow, pineapple and nuts.
Pour in 6-cup ring mold.
Chill until firm.
Soak crumbs in milk for
10 minutes. Grease a 1-quart casserole.
Combine crumbs, egg yolks, carrots, onion, cheese, salt and pepper.
Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry. Fold into carrot mixture.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 40 minutes or until set.
Combine potatoes and eggs.
Melt butter; add sour cream and add to mixture.
Pour mixture into casserole.
Top with Ritz crackers.
Heat thoroughly, approximately 45 minutes, at 350°.
Boil chicken and cut into small pieces.
Add ground beef to chicken broth and boil a few minutes.
Add vegetables and sauces. Cook about 4 hours.
Blend together first 6 ingredients; add finely chopped nuts or mini chocolate chips.
Shape into crescents and bake on ungreased cookie sheet 15 to 18 minutes until light golden brown.
Sift powdered sugar over crescents while still warm.
Makes about 4 dozen.
Brown meat and onion.
Drain.
Add beans, soup and tomatoes. Simmer for 5 or 10 minutes.
Stir often.
Place tortilla chips in large casserole dish.
Pour meat mixture over chips.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Place cheese on top during last 5 minutes of baking.
Cook garlic in oil 1 minute.
Stir in next 6 ingredients. Heat to boiling constantly stirring.
Reduce heat & simmer until thickened about 3 minutes.
Cook & drain sausage, stir in 1 c. salsa mixture.
In ungreased casserole dish layer 1/2 of cheese (sliced 1/4 inches) then sausage mixture.
Top with 1/2 cheese. Bake uncovered at 400 degrees 8-10 minutes.
Heat remaining salsa mixture & pour over cheese.
Serve with chips.
Sift together
flour,
soda,
salt and cream of tartar. Set aside.
Cream
together
shortening,
sugar and eggs; beat until fluffy.
Add
flour mixture in small amounts alternately with bananas
to
egg
mixture.
Beat
until smooth after each addition.
Place
in
well-greased
loaf
pan and bake in 350° oven for about
hour or until bread is done.
Makes 1 loaf. (This Banana Bread has cake like texture and flavor and can be served as cake.)
One
may
also add 1/4 cup chopped pecans to dough before baking.
When Banana Bread is baked and hot, pour the glaze over it.
In a saucepan, combine frozen vegetables and boiling water. Bring to boil again.
Cover and simmer 5 minutes.
Drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan.
Blend in flour.
Cook 1 minute. Gradually stir in milk.
Simmer, stirring until smooth and thickened.
Add cheese and seasonings.
Mix in vegetables, onions and pimentos.
Spread into buttered 1-quart casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly and browned.
Heat together vinegar, salt, pepper, sugar and oil until sugar is dissolved.
Set aside to cool.
Place vegetables in large bowl and pour dressing over vegetable mixture.
Refrigerate overnight. Serves 6 to 8.
Mix pretzels and cracker crumbs with Sweet 'N Low and melted margarine.
Press into a 9 x 9-inch pan.
Chill overnight.
Smooth the cream cheese over a dinner plate.
Pour salsa over cream cheese.
Spread black olives over salsa.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Serve with Fritos or corn chips.
Oven should be preheated 10 minutes before using it to a temperature of 350°.

Poke holes in chicken and season chicken in holes, inside cavity and outside with adobo, oregano and garlic. Soften butter stick in microwave and place half of it inside cavity and rub on all of the outside the other half of the softened butter.
Place chicken, breast down, in a pan big enough to also hold potatoes later on.
Place in oven and spread melted butter over chicken frequently.
As soon as chicken is placed in oven, start to prepare potatoes.
Chicken should cook in oven for 1 1/2 hours (set timer when chicken is placed in oven).
Method 1:
Drain 1 can of pinto beans.
Mash.
Cook in bacon grease or lard.
Break graham crackers into fourths and lay them down on a jelly roll pan evenly (should fill the pan). Then bring to a boil the butter and brown sugar on medium-high heat. Let boil 2 minutes.
Preheat oven to 300°.
Combine the first 7 ingredients listed in a mixing bowl.
Pour the mixture into a pie shell.
Bake at 300° for 45 minutes, or until done.
Place roast in slow cooker and sprinkle with onion soup mix. In small bowl, combine soup and water until blended. Pour over roast. Cover and cook on low 7 to 9 hours.
Drain all beans.
Mix sugar, oil, vinegar, salt and pepper. Add beans, green pepper and pimento to oil mixture.
Chill.
Make at least the night before.
Mix
sugar,
syrup and water together and cook, stirring occasionally
until
mixture
forms
a soft ball in cold water. Beat the
egg
whites
until
stiff
and pour the other mixture slowly
over
the egg whites, beating constantly while pouring. Beat until thick.
Stir nuts in and drop by spoonfuls.
In top of double boiler, combine egg whites and honey.
Beat 1 minute with electric beater (hand or electric type), to combine ingredients.
Cook over rapidly boiling water (water in bottom should not touch top of double boiler), beating constantly until soft peaks form when beater is slowly raised.
Allow about 10 minutes for beating to get proper consistency.
Remove from boiling water.
Add vanilla; continue heating until frosting is thick enough to spread, about 4 minutes.
Yields enough frosting for a 9-inch 2 layer cake.
Mix and put on a board and roll to an oblong shape.
Melt butter and spread over dough.
Sprinkle brown sugar and cinnamon over half of the dough.
Fold over other half and pat thin.
Cut into 1/2 inch strips and twist. Let rise 1 hour and bake in 375 degrees till light brown, This makes 24 twist.
May be frosted with powdered sugar frosting.
Steam zucchini, onion and carrots for 5 minutes.
Drain well. Combine soup and sour cream.
Stir in zucchini mixture.
Spread 1/2 of the stuffing mixture on bottom of greased casserole dish. Spoon in zucchini and top with remainder of stuffing.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bubbly.
Melt chocolate and butterscotch bits over hot water or in microwave.
Cool.
Cream shortening and sugar.
Add eggs, vanilla and buttermilk.
Sift dry ingredients and add to egg mixture and cooled chocolate mixture and stir well.
Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.
Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Cool on rack.
Remove from pan.
Dust with powdered sugar or glaze, if desired.
Mix all ingredients, except pecans.
Shape into 2 smaller balls or logs.
Roll in pecans. Wrap in plastic wrap until ready to use.
Peel and cut onions into very thin slices.
Cook onion slices in butter over very low heat.
Add salt and pepper according to taste.
Sprinkle in flour, stirring constantly to thicken butter/onion mixture.
Slowly add beef broth and water, then bring to boil.
Simmer with pan covered for 20 to 30 minutes.
Power Level:
High (100%) and Medium (50%).
Total Cooking Time: 23 to 29 minutes.
Empty cake mix in a large mixing bowl.
Add all other ingredients and beat 3 minutes.
Grease and flour 2 round pans or 1 sheath cake pan. Bake at 350° until done (usually about 30 minutes).
Preheat oven to 350°.
Drain and flake fish.
Add onion and capers to fish.
In separate dish, combine mayonnaise, water, cream, salt, paprika and stir until smooth.
Add 1/2 of this cream sauce to fish and mix well.
Place fish mixture in buttered loaf pan or baking dish.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Use the remaining sauce, after the curry is mixed into it, to spread over the fish loaf slices.
It can be cut into six slices while it is still hot and the sauce spooned over the slices.
This is a good one for dieters.
Heat oven to 250°.
Combine both cereals and noodles in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Set aside.
Combine the remaining ingredients in small bowl and pour over cereal mixture.
Stir to cool evenly. Bake 1 hour, stirring every 20 minutes.
Cool.
Cook sprouts in 2-inches boiling, salted water for 4 to 6 minutes or until just tender; drain.
Place in shallow bowl with celery and tomatoes.
Pour on dressing; cover and chill at least 2 hours.
Drain before serving.
Spoon into lettuce-lined bowl. Makes 4 servings.
Mix packages of jello with 3 cups hot water to dissolve and add 3 cups cold water.
Set aside.
Cook for 15 minutes slowly or until fairly thick.
Serve hot on sausage rolls.
This sauce may be made up and kept in a covered jar.
Put in cool place.
Cut biscuits in fourths.
Mix sugar and cinnamon together. Place in plastic bag.
Drop pieces of biscuits in the sugar mixture.
Shake until well coated.
Place coated biscuits in a well-greased angel food cake pan.
Mix brown sugar and oleo in a saucepan and heat until mixture comes just to a boil.
Pour mixture over biscuits.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Drain pineapple, reserving 1 c. juice in small saucepan.
Set pineapple aside.
To saucepan, add sugar, flour, eggs, orange juice, lemon juice and oil.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute, remove from heat and chill.
In salad bowl, combine pineapple, fruit cocktail, oranges and bananas.
Fold in Cool Whip and chilled sauce.
Chill several hours.
