In a large skillet, cook together beef, peppers and onions, stirring with a fork to break up meat, until meat is browned and vegetables are tender.
Drain off excess drippings.
In a small bowl, mix together remaining ingredients, except buns.
Add to beef mixture in pan.
Mix well; cook over low heat for 50 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Spoon on buns.
Serve immediately.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter or margarine in 8-inch skillet.
Beat eggs with milk and pour into hot skillet.
Tilt pan to spread eggs over bottom.
When eggs are almost dry, spread sauce, oregano and cheese over one-half of eggs.
Add optional toppings, if desired and carefully fold unfilled half over fillings.
Cover and warm over low heat until cheese is melted.
Combine ham with eggs, onion, pepper, mustard, relish and mayonnaise.
Cut off tops of rolls; scoop out.
Fill with ham mixture.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Place in 7 1/2 x 12-inch baking dish.
Cook on Medium for 3 minutes.
Turn dish.
Cook 2 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 sandwiches.
Drain spinach thoroughly.
Preheat oven to 325°.
Mix all ingredients together.
Form into balls.
Place on a cookie sheet and bake for 25 minutes.
Place ground pork in a 21 x 13 x 2 1/2-inch pan.
Cook meat in a 375° oven for 45 minutes.
Mix well to break into small pieces. Pour off drippings and save.
Season with salt and paprika.
Break tomatoes and add instant minced onion.
Let stand 20 minutes. Cook macaroni in salted water and oil; do not overcook.
Drain. In saucepot or kettle, combine soup, garlic salt, pepper, basil and savory.
Mix well and heat.
Add tomato and onion mixture.
In 2 pans (21 x 13 x 2 1/2-inch), place half the pork and half the macaroni, then half of the celery and tomato mixture.
Cover and bake in a 375° oven for 35 to 45 minutes or until hot.
Uncover and sprinkle with 8 ounces grated cheese.
Heat until cheese is melted.
Blend soup and milk in a 6 cup casserole.
Mix in tuna, noodles, beans and onions; top with buttered bread crumbs (toast, butter and crumble).
Bake in a hot 400° oven for 25 minutes or until bubbly hot.
Drain pineapple, but save some juice.
Mix all ingredients with your hands adding some of the pineapple juice.
Put in bowl or casserole dish and refrigerate.
Brown sausage over medium heat.
Drain the grease off the sausage.
In a medium size casserole dish, mix the salsa and the sausage together.
Then cut 1/2-inch square cubes of cheese and add them to the salsa.
Place dish in microwave and heat for about 3 minutes.
Stir salsa thoroughly.
Complete this cycle until cheese is thoroughly melted.
Mix first 6 ingredients together.
You may need a little more flour.
Roll dough 2 inches in diameter.
Cut into 1/2-inch pieces. Cook in boiling water about 5 minutes (when pieces come to the top).
Put into colander to drain.
Butter a serving dish and place these pieces on it.
Pour some sauteed onions over the layers.
Layer in 9 x 12-inch pan as follows:
ground beef (raw, place in thin layer), Cheddar cheese soup, corn and Tater Tots.
Bake in 400° oven for 55 minutes.
Sprinkle grated cheese over top and return to oven until cheese melts.
Serve immediately.
Keeps the mess in your oven, not all over your kitchen.
Coat chicken pieces with flour in a plastic bag.
Make sure they are coated well. Heat butter and Crisco in a 13 x 9-inch pan in 425° oven until melted.
Place chicken in pan.
Bake 30 minutes.
Turn. Bake 30 more minutes.
Sprinkle the cucumber with salt and let stand 25 minutes. Sprinkle the onion rings with the paprika.
Place all the ingredients in a glass jar and refrigerate at least 1 hour.
Cook butter and sugar over low fire.
Cook over low fire until starts to brown around edges of butter and sugar.
Take off fire and add your pecans and vanilla and drop onto graham crackers.
Mash the fruit in a food processor.
Add the sugar and lemon juice and mix until the sugar is dissolved.
Mix with the whipped cream.
Pour in a freezerproof container, preferably a flat one, so it will freeze faster.
Set freezer at maximum freezing capacity and put the container in the freezer.
After an hour, remove the container from the freezer and stir its contents well.
Use mixer or food processor if you like.
Reduce freezer setting to normal operating temperature/freezing capacity.
Put the container back in the freezer.
Preferably, repeat this procedure after another hour again.
Count on a total freezing time of at least 3 hours.
Serves 4 persons.
Combine sugar, corn syrup, 3/4 cup water and salt in a 2-quart glass casserole.
Microwave on High for 19 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes or to 260° on a candy thermometer.
Heat egg whites until very stiff.
Pour hot syrup gradually over egg whites, beating at high speed for about 12 minutes or until thick and candy begins to lose gloss.
Fold in vanilla and pecans.
Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.
Meats can be marinated in this sauce up to 8 days.
Can also be used as a basting sauce.
Terrific for chicken, pork, beef and fish.
With fish, only marinate overnight or a few hours.
Combine softened cream cheese and rest of ingredients together.
Mix well; chill and shape into ball before serving.
Mix everything together.
Put in well-greased baking dish. Bake at 300° for 1 hour.
Blend and pat flat in a 9 x 12-inch pan.
Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.

Combine dry ingredients. Make a well in center of dry ingredients. Add eggs, oil and vanilla. Stir in pineapple, carrots and nuts. Turn into tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours or bake in 3 round pans for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown and starting to separate from pan.
Steep the tea bags in 1 cup boiling water for 2 to 3 minutes. Remove tea bags.
Stir in sugar.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix until sugar is dissolved.
Pour into a freezer container and freeze until firm.
Spoon slush into glasses.
Add Fresca, 50-50, Squirt, ginger ale or 7-Up.

Combine raisins and 1 cup water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients in large bowl. Add raisins and water. Mix well. Grease 9 x 5 loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Into blender, combine cukes and tomato juice.
Place in a non-metal container.
Blend all other vegetables except only 1/2 of onion.
Add juice of 2 lemons and pimientos, salsa, spices and sliced tomato.
Refrigerate and serve after a couple of hours or days.
Brown beef with onion.
Add the remaining ingredients, being generous with the garlic powder.
Simmer all until noodles are done.
Stir to keep from sticking.
Serves 4 generously.
Preheat oven to 375°.
In small bowl combine flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon, set aside.
In large bowl combine butter, sugars, eggs and vanilla.
Beat until creamy.
Gradually add flour mixture.
Stir in oats and morsels.
Drop by tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake at 375° for 7 to 8 minutes for chewier cookies or 9 to 10 minutes for crisper cookies.
Makes about 4 dozen.
Mix first three ingredients until grainy.
Mix remaining with rest of mixture.
Roll crust.
Makes 3 pie crusts.
Bake at 425°.
Brown ground beef in skillet with onion and salt.
Drain off excess fat.
Put in a 2-quart casserole.
Add sauerkraut, brown sugar and tomato juice.
Mix well.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Mix all ingredients, except fowl and spices.
Cook until beans are almost done.
Add the chicken or turkey and spices, and simmer about 30 minutes.
Mix above ingredients together and roll in small balls.
Bake at 350° for 8 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet.
Remove from oven and let cool.
Fill with Betty Crocker can white (vanilla) icing. Makes about 30 double cookies.
In large skillet, cook sausage until brown in olive oil. Remove sausage and wilt onions in oil.
Remove or drain oil from skillet.
Add rest of ingredients and cook about 5 minutes.
Add sausage and simmer, stirring often, for about 30 minutes.
Heat oven to 350°.
Grease pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch).
Cook and stir sausage and onion over medium heat until sausage is brown; drain.
Mix baking mix, milk and 1 egg.
Spread in pan.
Sprinkle with caraway seed.
Top with sausage mixture.
Mix sour cream, salt and remaining egg; pour evenly over sausage.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake, uncovered, until set, 25 to 30 minutes.
Cut in rectangles (approximately 2 x 1 1/2-inch).
Makes 32 appetizers.
Cream sugar, margarine	and
eggs.
Beat
in
extracts, fruit and pecans.
Bake in
greased tube pan at 300° for 1 1/2 hours. Cool before removing from pan.
Can be baked in 2 loaf pans.
Put all but spices in large kettle.
Tie cloves and allspice in cheesecloth (add cinnamon sticks if you are not going to use individual cinnamon sticks in cups).
Add nutmeg and spice packet to liquid.
Simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove bag; serve with individual cinnamon sticks, if desired.
Let the cream cheese soften.
Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Refrigerate 24 hours before serving.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Prepare brownies following package directions for original recipe. Remove from oven.
Sprinkle marshmallows over hot brownies.
Return to oven; bake 3 minutes longer.
Combine chocolate chips, peanut butter and butter in medium saucepan.
Cook on low heat, stirring constantly, until chips are melted.
Add Rice Krispies and mix well.
Spread over marshmallow layer.
Refrigerate until chilled. Cut into bars.
Makes 24.
Mix sugar, flour and oleo like pie dough.
Save 1/2 cup for use as topping.
Add egg, milk with soda and vanilla.
Mix well all in 1 bowl.
Pour in well greased and floured cake pan (8-inch square pan).
Sprinkle with topping and cinnamon.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Have ingredients at room temperature and mix.
Remove crust from bread.
Spread cheese mixture on 3 slices and place them together, then cut into 3 strips and cut these 3 strips in half (end up with 6 pieces).
Frost sides and top with cheese mixture thinly.
Place cubes on cookie sheet and freeze.
When frozen, put into plastic bag and keep frozen.
Preheat oven to 300°.
Grease 6 mini loaf pans and 4 (6-inch) loaf pans.

Crush Heath bars. Soften ice cream. Split ladyfingers in half and line the bottom and sides of a 10 or 12-inch spring-form pan. Spoon layer of chocolate ice cream over ladyfingers. Cover with half of crushed Heath bars. Add layer of vanilla ice cream.
Cover with remaining Heath bars. Add top layer of peppermint ice cream. Freeze at least 8 hours.
Unmold and top with sweetened whipped cream. Serves 8 to 10.
*I always bake my pie shell some before adding filling, but do not brown them.
Cream oleo, oil and sugar.
Add eggs, vanilla and sour milk. Beat well.
Sift flour and rest of dry ingredients together.
Stir in zucchini.
Pour into greased 9 x 12-inch oblong pan.
Sprinkle chocolate chips on top.
Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes on top shelf of oven.
Check before 45 minutes.
Heat cornmeal and 1 1/4 cups milk over medium heat until thick and dry, stirring frequently, about 3 minutes.
Spoon cornmeal mixture into a bowl.
Add remaining milk, butter and eggs.
Beat until smooth.
Stir in salt, baking powder and red chiles.
Stir in cheese and bacon.
Pour into cake pan.
Bake at 325° for 35 minutes or until cooked through.
In 2 quart microwave bowl, put sugar and juice.
Stir well. Add lemon juice and stir.
Put in microwave for 10 minutes.
Add Sure-Jell and stir well.
Put back in microwave and let boil 2 minutes.
Makes 2 pints.
Blend all ingredients in a large bowl; beat at medium speed for 2 minutes.
Pour batter into a greased and floured tube pan and bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
Cake is done when toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Mix and let stand in refrigerator two hours.
Serve.
Mix ingredients well.
Marinate meat (chicken, beef or ribs) 1 hour.
Can be marinated overnight.
Baste meat with sauce while broiling.
Yields 1 1/4 cups.

Mix cottage cheese, 2 cups shredded Mozzarella and 1 egg. Drain and squeeze defrosted spinach; add salt, oregano and pepper. In greased 9 x 12-inch dish, spread small amount of sauce, later 1/3 noodles, 1/3 cheese mixture, 1/3 cheese slices and 1/3 sauce. Repeat 2 times more.
Sprinkle with remaining shredded Mozzarella. Pour water around edges.
Seal tightly with foil.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.
Let stand 15 minutes before serving.
Remove foil and serve.
Mix all ingredients well.
Cook for about 30 minutes on medium heat.
Serve.
Cook cauliflower until tender.
Combine all ingredients except Parmesan cheese and paprika.
Gently mix cauliflower.
Pour into greased baking dish and top with Parmesan cheese.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until golden.
Put carrots, celery, onion, water and bouillon cubes in saucepan and cook until tender.
Cook milk, flour and cheese over low heat until smooth; pour into vegetables and simmer until thoroughly blended.
Combine first 5 ingredients in a large mixing bowl.
Add eggs and oil, stirring until dry ingredients are moistened.
Do not beat.
Stir in vanilla, pineapple, 1 cup pecans and bananas.

recipes.t: Beef Roast With Mushroom And Onion Soup
d: Line a pan with a large piece of foil.
Sprinkle onion soup mix in bottom of pan.
Lay roast on top of dry soup mix.
Sprinkle roast with salt and pepper.
Pour mushroom soup over top of roast. Fold foil loosely over top of roast.
Cook in oven at 325° about 2 1/2 hours or until tender.
Beat cream cheese and soup until blended.
Stir in onions and dried beef.
Refrigerate.
Serve on Ritz crackers.
Pour all ingredients, except sherbet, in large punch bowl. Add scoop of sherbet.
Thicken water with flour to a thin batter.
Add sugar, salt and yeast and stir in more flour until quite stiff.
In the morning, add a small teaspoon soda and flour enough to make the batter stiff as can be stirred with a spoon.
Put into pans and let rise again, then bake in even oven, not too hot at first (keep warm while rising).
Smooth over the loaves with a spoon or knife dipped in water.
Mix all ingredients together.
If not moist enough to stick together, add water, a tablespoon at a time.
Roll into small balls (about 1-inch).
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes or until done.
Drain on paper towels.
May be frozen, warmed and served. Best when served hot.
Put chicken in bowl, layer of onions, layer of chicken, etc. until used up.
Heat the jelly and ketchup until jelly melts; add lemon juice.
Pour over chicken.
Let stand overnight.
Bake skin down 1/2 hour, turn and bake another 1/2 hour.
Remove stem ends from tomatoes; cut thin slice from bottom of each tomato to prevent tipping.
Remove pulp from each tomato, leaving a 1/2-inch wall; chop enough pulp to make 1/3 cup.
Mix tomato pulp, green pepper, cheese, croutons and salt.
Fill tomatoes.
Place in ungreased oblong baking dish.
Cook uncovered in 350° oven for about 20 minutes or until tomatoes are heated through.
Garnish with parsley sprigs or crumbled, crisply fried bacon, if desired.
Cook spinach according to package directions; drain well. Combine remaining ingredients with spinach; mix well.
Chill mixture for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Form spinach mixture into 1-inch balls.
Bake on a greased cookie sheet at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serve hot.
Makes 4 to 6 dozen.
If using fresh cook them till tender. Canned ones drain most of the liquid away an place in kettle add butter and sugars. Cook on medium heat till all is melted and stir well.
Brown meat and drain.
Add 1/2 pkg. taco seasoning mix.
Set aside to cool.
Combine next 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Gently mix in meat.
Combine dressing, mayonnaise, ketchup and remaining taco seasoning in a bowl to make dressing.
Pour over salad and toss.
Makes 10-12 servings.
Mix the first 3 ingredients together.
Add to liquid mix the sugar, nutmeg, flour and baking powder.
Combine these dry ingredients and mix before adding to liquid mixture.
Drop by 1/2 teaspoon (approximately) into grease (approximately 375°).
Fry until well browned for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes.
Drain on paper towels. Cool.
If desired, add sugar or cinnamon and sugar.
I put them in plastic bags to do this.
Pour jello into hot water.
Mix thoroughly then cool for 10 minutes.
Add pineapple and strawberries.
Mix well and pour into an 11 x 7-inch pan.
Place in refrigerator.
To make the topping: mix the cream cheese, marshmallows and whipping cream together. Cover and let stand overnight in the refrigerator.
The next day, whip the cream cheese mixture until well blended.
Pour over jello. Sprinkle nuts on top.
In a medium bowl, stir first 5 ingredients until smooth.
Add remaining ingredients; toss to coat well.
Cover and chill. Serve.
Mix all ingredients together.
Bring to a boil and tea is ready to serve.
Serve cool or hot.
Place sliced oranges and lemons on top for color.
Keep in refrigerator.
Serves 20.
Put everything in bowl and blend well.
Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

Cook Duncan Hines butter cake mix according to directions. Let cool. Punch holes in cooled cake. Mix crushed pineapple and sugar and bring to a boil, then simmer about 5 minutes. Pour over cooled cake when cooled. Mix oleo, cream cheese, chopped pecans and confectioners sugar. Spread this on cooled cake.
Split cleaned birds down back.
Rub with olive oil, butter and salt and pepper.
Place 2 inches under preheated broiler for 8 minutes; basting again with olive oil.
Serve on buttered toast with mushrooms.
Allow 1 quail per person.
Heat oven to 425°. Prepare pastry.
Mix sugar, flour, nutmeg, cinnamon and salt.
Stir in apples.
Turn into pastry lined pie plate.
Dot with margarine.
Cover with top crust that has slits cut in it. Seal and flute.
Cover edge with 3-inch strip of aluminum foil.
Remove foil during last 15 minutes of baking. Bake until crust is brown and juice begins to bubble through slits in crust, 40 to 50 minutes.
Saute vegetables in margarine until soft.
Add flour and mix until smooth.
Add chicken stock.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add cheese and ham.
Cook 10 minutes longer.
Add milk, salt and pepper.
Heat to serving temperature. Makes approximately 2 quarts.
In a large saucepan, stir together sugar and cocoa.
Stir in egg yolks with 2 cups of cream.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until very hot.
Do not boil.
Cool to room temperature.
Stir in remaining cream, almond and vanilla extracts.
Refrigerate 6 hours.
Freeze according to ice cream freezer instructions.
Immediately fold in cherries and almonds.
Arrange the fish fillets in a single layer and close together in a shallow pan.
Beat together egg, 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice, 1/2 cup of the wine, salt and pepper and pour over the fish.
Cover and chill for about 1 hour.
Lift fish from marinade, draining.
Heat 1 tablespoon of the butter in a wide frying pan; add fish fillets and brown on both sides.
Place fish on a heated platter in a warm place.
In a pan, melt the remaining butter; add 1/8 cup of the marinade, the remaining lemon juice and wine. Bring to a rapid boil.
Pour some of the sauce over fish and pass the remainder to add to each serving.
Sprinkle with parsley. Serves 2.
Melt margarine in ovenproof skillet, about 10 minutes in diameter.
Combine flour, milk, eggs and nutmeg in bowl.
Pour into hot skillet.
Bake in preheated 450° oven 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown.
Remove from oven.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar and lemon juice and serve immediately.
Put cream cheese in a bowl; mix until softened.
Add egg and onion; mix well.
Heat water to boil.
Add beef bouillon; let dissolve.
When water is slightly cooled, add to cream cheese mixture and blend together.
Remember, the water should not be too hot, or it will cook the egg.
You don't want that to happen. Thaw spinach; squeeze out excess water.
Add spinach to cream cheese; mix well.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top.
Put spinach in casserole.
Bake, covered, for 10 minutes at 350°.
Remove cover and bake additional 10 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.
Saute meat, onions, pepper and garlic.
Mix with rice and cabbage.
Put in 11 x 13-inch pan.
Mix 1 can tomato soup and 1 cup tomato juice or sauce and pour over top.
Bake at 350° for 70 minutes, covered.
Serves 8.
Brown hamburger (you may add onion if preferred).
While browning meat, cook macaroni and drain.
Add soup, cheese and mushrooms to hamburger mixture.
Pour into casserole dish and bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Add salt and pepper as desired.
(This is a great dish to make 3 or 4 of and store in freezer for baking later.
Great, especially when you work and have little time to get dinner.)
Boil together in saucepan the enchilada mix, tomato sauce and water.
Brown ground beef and drain fat.
Stir in 3/4 cup of sauce to meat.
Also add 1/2 cup Mozzarella and 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese to meat.
In a 9 x 13-inch pan, pour enough sauce to cover the bottom.
Dip tortilla shells into sauce and fill with 3 tablespoons of meat mixture, placing them seam down.
Pour remaining sauce over prepared enchiladas and remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes and garnish with lettuce, tomato and sour cream before serving.
Combine all ingredients; blend well. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes.
Serve hot with crackers.
Mix ingredients together well.
Bake in any kind of pan at 300° about 1/2 hour.
Mix and sift flour, baking powder, soda, salt and spices. Cream shortening until soft and smooth.
Add sugar, eggs and jam. Add buttermilk and mix into batter.
Bake at 350° about 30 minutes.
Makes 3 layers.
Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy; add eggs 1 at a time beating well after each addition.
Add crushed wafers alternately with milk.
Add coconut and pecans, and mix well.
Pour into a large greased tube or bundt pan.
Bake in preheated 300° oven for 1 hour and 45 minutes.
Cool completely before removing from pan.
Wrap in heavy-duty foil and leave on cabinet for 3-4 days, or put in freezer.
(Do not cut right away because it will be dry and tasteless.)
Mix pie filling and pineapple together in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Spread cake mix over top.
Drizzle melted oleo or butter over top of dry cake mix.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden.
When cool, top with whipped cream.
Mix together cream cheese, egg yolk, sugar and vanilla; set aside.
On a slightly greased cookie sheet, spread one can crescent rolls.
Pinching together at all seams.
Spread cream cheese mixture on top of rolls.
Take second can of rolls and put on top of cream cheese layer.
Pinch together all seams.
Beat the egg white until foamy; brush the top of the rolls with it.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven and let stand for about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Can be served warm or cold.
Sift together dry ingredients.
Mix together, eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla.
Then mix with dry ingredients.
Fold in apples, nuts and raisins.
Bake in a tube or loaf pan for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.
Mix dates, baking soda and butter into boiling water.
Stir and let cool.
Combine flour, sugar, salt, vanilla and nuts.
Mix all ingredients.
Fill bread pans 1/2 full.
Bake at 350° for 60 minutes.
Pan-fry pork chops or steaks in water.
Cook until tender. Before meat is half done, toss in a few cauliflower and broccoli flowerets.
Cover and finish cooking meat.
Add only enough water to not scorch.
Turn down heat.
Add chopped bell pepper with flowerets, if you like.
Open up a can of chicken and dumplings. Spoon onto skillet mixture and heat without lid.
Be sure water is almost cooked away before adding dumplings.
Can be served from frying pan or pour into Pyrex dish, spooning meat over into dish first.
Finish in 325° oven for about 20 to 25 minutes to set and brown around edge of dish.
Serve with salad and sliced tomatoes.
Preheat oven to 475°.
Mix flour and salt.
Pour Wesson oil and milk into a measuring cup (don't stir).
Add all at once to flour.
Stir until mixed.
Press into balls.
Smooth and flatten slightly.
Roll between 2 sheets of waxed paper.
Press into pie pans.
Brown hamburger meat.
Put cream of mushroom soup in a casserole dish; add a little water for moistness.
Alternate layers of hamburger, sliced (thin) onion and potatoes and finally pour Cheddar cheese soup on top (add a little water).
Put lid on dish and bake in a preheated oven for about 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Boil zucchini in water until tender.
Drain well.
Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
Boil chicken until done then chop.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions and drain.
Add chicken, tomatoes, soup and cheez whiz.
Stir until cheez whiz is completely melted and all ingredients are thoroughly mixed together.
Line large cookie sheet with waxed paper.
In double boiler top over hot, not boiling, water, melt butterscotch pieces with salad oil, stirring occasionally.
In large bowl, mix chow mein noodles and marshmallows.
Pour on butterscotch; mix well with fork.
Onto cookie sheet, drop mixture by heaping teaspoonfuls (if mixture thickens, place over hot water a few minutes). Refrigerate until set.
Makes about 30 pieces.
Grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Remove crusts from bread.
Place 1 slice of bread in each muffin cup.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Drop a raw egg into each cup.
Top each with 1/4 teaspoon butter. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes, or until eggs are cooked and bread is toasted.
Mix sugar, flour and salt.
Add yolks and enough milk to form smooth mixture.
Stir in rest of milk.
Cook over low heat until thick.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla, butter and raisins (including juice).
Pour into 2 baked pie shells.
Top with Cool Whip.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Sift together flour, salt, baking soda and baking powder.
Stir nuts into flour mixture.
Set aside.
Cream together shortening and sugar.
Add eggs, vanilla and sour milk.
Combine well and stir in apples.
Stir in dry ingredients.
Spread batter evenly in the prepared pan and bake 50 to 60 minutes or until pick inserted in center comes out clean.
In medium saucepan, combine apricot nectar, orange juice and lemon juice.
Add cinnamon (if desired).
Bring just to boiling and reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Remove from heat and discard the stick.
Stir in Equal until dissolved.
May be garnished with lemon slice and cinnamon stick.
Makes 5 (6 ounce) servings.
Diabetic Exchange:
1 1/2 Fruit.
Put over top of potatoes before baking.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Mix together.
Right before serving, pour mixture over cut/torn lettuce, shredded Cheddar cheese and crushed nacho or plain tortilla chips in large bowl and toss, adding more dressing if necessary.
Mix all ingredients well and press in a 9 x 12 pan.

recipes.t: Rice With Lamb Sauce(Riz Bi Yahkna)
d: In saucepan, brown meat and onion in oil.
Add tomato sauce and seasoning.
Let cook over med. heat till meat is cooked through and sauce thickens a bit. Meanwhile in another saucepan, melt butter and add rosemarino.
Stir constantly till golden brown.
Add rice and water to cover all.
Cover and slowly boil till water is absorbed and rice is cooked.
In a frying pan, brown onion in oleo.
When rice is cooked, add onion mixture to rice. Serve sauce over rice.
In heavy 4-quart pan saute onion in 1/4 cup butter until limp; add green onions, potatoes, salt and water.
Bring to a boil and then simmer partially covered for 45 minutes or until potatoes are very tender.
Mash.
Add shrimp and cook 20 to 30 minutes until shrimp are done.
Cool.
Add 1/4 cup butter, cream and chives. Adjust seasoning.
Heat through, but do not boil or cream will curdle.
Pour milk into a large mixing bowl.
Add dry pudding mix and beat for 1 to 2 minutes until pudding starts to thicken.
Fold in whipped topping.
Mix yogurt and cottage cheese, stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and chill for 2 hours to blend flavors.
Serve as a dip for crackers, chips or raw vegetable pieces or serve as dressing for green salad.
Mix ingredients in pan.
Cook over medium heat until mixture pulls away from sides of pan and becomes doughy in consistency. Knead until cool.
Ready for play.
In saucepan, heat oil and saute onions, green pepper and celery.
Add tomatoes, chili powder and simmer uncovered about 30 minutes.
Add kidney beans and uncooked macaroni.
Simmer another 12 to 15 minutes, stirring frequently, or until macaroni is tender.
Top with cheese and serve.
Blend vanilla ice cream, chocolate syrup and peanut butter. Add milk.
Beat until frothy.

For sauce, in a small saucepan, stir together the tomato sauce, onion, brown sugar, tomato paste, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, dry mustard, garlic and if desired, hot pepper sauce. Bring to boiling; reduce heat.
Simmer, uncovered, for 20 to 25 minutes or until desired consistency, stirring occasionally. Remove half of the sauce (about 1/2 cup).
Cover and store in the refrigerator for another use for up to 2 weeks.
Combine sugar, cocoa, milk and margarine.
Bring to boil and boil for 1 minute.
Add peanut butter and oatmeal.
Stir well and drop by teaspoons onto wax paper.
Put rice on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan, ungreased.
Place chicken parts over rice.
Mix soup and juice; pour over chicken. Sprinkle soup mix on top; cover with foil.
Bake at 325° for 2 1/2 hours.

recipes.t: Easy Mexican Casserole(Can Be Made Ahead Of Time)
d: Prepare 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan with Pam.
Cook spinach according to package directions; drain well.
Brown meat and onion in skillet.
Drain off excess fat.
Add tomatoes and cooked spinach.
Combine soup, sour cream and garlic salt; set aside.
Combine the olive salad ingredients.
Toss to blend.
Let marinate about half an hour at room temperature, if possible. Slice the rolls.
Brush with olive oil. Layer with the cheese, ham and salami.
Top with the olive salad.
Replace top of the roll. Serve or wrap for a bag lunch or picnic.
Mix together the first four ingredients.
Cook sugar, egg and pineapple juice together and pour over cool jello.
Mix Cool Whip and cream cheese and top.
Beat egg whites, sugar, strawberries and lemon juice at high speed for 15 minutes in large bowl.
Fold in whipped cream and pat mixture in baked pie shell and freeze until serving.

recipes.t: Macaroni And Cheese In A Crock-Pot
d: Toss together macaroni and oil.
Grease crock-pot.
Stir all ingredients together.
Place in crock-pot.
Either place on high for 3 hours or place on low for 7 hours.
Combine cream cheese and milk.
Add rest of ingredients. Serve with crackers.
Freezes well.
In saucepan, melt caramels and 1/2 can milk; set aside and keep warm.
Mix cake mix, melted margarine and 1/2 can milk until moistened.
Mixture will be thick.
Spread half of this mixture in a well-greased, floured pan (9 x 13-inch).
Bake for 6 minutes at 350°.
Cool briefly.
Spread chocolate chips evenly over baked cake.
Spread caramel mixture over chocolate chips.
Put remaining cake mixture over top.
Bake for 14 to 18 minutes, until top is set.
Brownie will pull away from sides.
Do not overbake.
Cool; cut into small squares.
Dissolve gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water.
Make jello according to package directions.
Add dissolved gelatin and refrigerate until it congeals.
Fold in mayonnaise and all other ingredients.
Beat with Mixmaster to blend.
Pour into 11 x 13-inch pan.
Refrigerate several hours.
Boil chicken in salted water until tender and take meat off bones.
Saute celery and onions in oil until tender.
Add flour, one spoon at a time, to the onions and celery and blend.
Add salt, pepper and margarine.
Add chicken broth, stirring to blend, then add soup.
Add milk, stirring constantly.
Bring mixture to a boil and cook 2 minutes.
Add chicken and pour in a greased 9 x 13-inch dish.
Cover with Pinwheels.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until golden.
Place roast in crock-pot.
Turn heat on low.
Cook 14 to 16 hours.
Remove roast and cool.
Break meat into pieces; remove all fat.
Pour juices from crock-pot and discard.
Place meat in layers back in pot.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Beat pumpkin, milk, sugars, eggs and spices together.
Pour into an ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Sprinkle with cake mix.
Pour melted margarine on top; sprinkle with nuts.
Bake at 350° for 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center of dessert comes out clean.
Top with whipped topping.
Cook pasta according to package directions.
In saucepan over low heat, add remaining ingredients.
Heat until butter is melted; stir in hot pasta.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until thoroughly heated.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
In 1 1/2-quart saucepan, combine soup, water and salsa.
Over medium heat, heat through, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle each serving with tortilla chips, cheese and onion; top with spoonful of sour cream.
You will need an 8-inch diameter flowerpot, a small hand shovel and artificial flowers.
Plug holes of flowerpot.
Grease inside of flowerpot with margarine.
In a large mixer bowl, sprinkle yeast over the 1/4 cup water. Let stand for 5 minutes.
Stir in salad oil, sugar, salt, milk and 2 cups flour.
Beat on medium speed for 5 minutes or until dough pulls from side of bowl in stretchy strands.
Stir in more flour (about 1 cup) to form a stiff dough.
Turn onto a lightly floured board.
Knead for 10 minutes or until smooth.
Turn dough over into a lightly greased bowl.
Cover with plastic wrap.
Let rise in warm place for 1 hour or until doubled.
Turn dough out onto board. Knead to expel trapped air.
Cut into 12 equal pieces.
Cover and let rest for 5 minutes.
Dissolve gelatin in the hot water.
Drain the thawed frozen strawberries and pineapple and add water to make 1 cup liquid and add to gelatin.

If possible, allow dough to stand in cool place to stiffen before rolling and cutting.
May decorate with sugars or raisins.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes on greased cookie sheets.
In large saucepan, cook peas according to package directions.
Combine dry ingredients.
Coat chicken.
Place in shallow baking pan.
Drizzle melted butter over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Turn.
Bake 15 minutes.
Turn again and bake at 450° for 10 minutes.
Peel, slice or cube eggplant and cook in boiling water with salt added, until tender.
Drain and mash.
Place half of cracker crumbs, butter, onion, celery and crabmeat in greased casserole dish.
Sprinkle with remaining cracker crumbs.
Combine egg and milk.
Pour over contents of casserole.
Sprinkle with paprika and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden brown on top.
Serves 4 to 6.
Preheat oven to 350°.
In medium bowl, combine 3/4 cup sugar, flour, 3 tablespoons cocoa, baking powder and salt.
Blend in milk, melted butter and vanilla.
Beat until smooth.
Pour batter into an 8 or 9-inch baking pan.
Mix cream cheese, soup mix and dried beef and form into a ball.
Roll in chopped pecans and serve with crackers.

recipes.t: Dr.  Kuracina'S Pasta Party Sauces(For Family And Friends)
d: In a food processor with steel blade or blender, place ingredients, except cheese, and process until smooth.
Makes 1 1/2 cups sauce.
Cook broccoli just until it is tender; drain.
Mix cheese soup and milk in a saucepan; bring just to a boil, stirring constantly. Mix well.
Butter glass Pyrex dish.
Arrange broccoli in dish. Pour cheese soup on broccoli.
Make sure broccoli is covered. Place slices of cheese on top of broccoli.
Cook at 350° until bubbly and sliced cheese just starts to brown.
Combine all ingredients in blender; mix well. Use as topping on tacos or tossed salad.
Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl with a wooden spoon.
Pour wet ingredients into a small bowl; mix with electric mixer on medium for 20 seconds or until smooth.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients.
Continue mixing with electric mixer on medium another 30 seconds or until dough forms.
Make a 1/2 inch ball with your fingers formed around 3 chocolate chips.
Place on a dry cookie sheet in rows 4 across and 6 down.
Bake in a 350° oven for 7 minutes.
Remove from cookie sheet and cool 30 minutes.
Mix all together except cheese. Pour half batter in greased baking dish. Add half cheese. Add remaining batter. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Dice bacon in small pieces and pan-broil over moderate heat until crisp.
Add remaining ingredients, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil.
Pour over salad greens and toss gently until well blended.
Season to taste and serve at once.
Melt oleo.
Stir in sugar, syrup and salt.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Boil without stirring for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat; stir in baking soda and vanilla.
Gradually pour over popped corn, mixing well.
Turn into 2 large shallow baking or roasting pans.
Bake in a 250° oven for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Cool completely.
Break apart and store in covered container.
Yields 5 quarts.
This recipe can be halved.
Place crackers in a single layer in a foil-lined 15 x 10-inch baking pan.
In a saucepan over medium heat, melt butter.
Add sugar; bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil 2 minutes. Remove from the heat. Add vanilla.
Pour evenly over crackers; sprinkle with nuts.

recipes.t: Applesauce Cake(This Is A Good Breakfast Cake.)
d: Before mixing, sprinkle dates and raisins with some flour, so they don't stick together in mixture.
Sift together flour, sugar, baking soda, cocoa, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Add apricots.
Mix in shortening, walnuts and raisins.
Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes, then turn oven down to 350° for 30 minutes more.
Remove from oven and cool.
Saute celery and onion in 2 tablespoons oil.
Mix soups and milk
together;
add to rice.
Cook broccoli; drain.
Add rest of ingredients; bake 30 minutes at 350°.
In a skillet over medium heat, put 1 tablespoon margarine; cook chicken for 10 minutes or until browned on both sides. Remove chicken; keep warm.
Cut melon in half crosswise and remove seeds.
Slice melon into 1-inch rings.
Remove rind.
Fill each ring with scoops of ice cream.
Top with melted preserves.
Serve immediately.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Melt chocolate over hot, not boiling water and cool.
Grease well and flour a 10-inch tube pan.
Sift flour with baking powder, soda and salt.
Set aside.
In large bowl, beat eggs until thick at high speed.
Gradually add sugar, 1/4 cup at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add oil and cooled chocolate; beat until well blended.
At low speed, add sifted dry ingredients, mixing until smooth.
Add zucchini and nuts with wooden spoon.
Stir until well combined.
Turn batter into prepared pan.
Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or until surface springs back when pressed lightly with fingertip.
Cool in pan on wire rack 15 minutes.
Remove from pan; cool thoroughly on rack.
Put in saucepan 1/2 cup sugar and let brown; add little water and cook until light syrup (don't let sugar get too brown).
Stir and mix well 1/2 cup sugar, flour or cornstarch, egg yolks and whole egg.
Add to syrup and cook until thick.
Put in baked crust and top with meringue and brown.
Stir together dry ingredients.
Stir in next five ingredients. Beat eggs, oil and vanilla and stir into first mix until just combined.
Fill greased tins.
Bake at 350° for approximately 25 minutes.
Makes 18 muffins.
Mix flour, sugar and salt in a 2-quart bowl.
Add in syrup and mix well.
Beat eggs in with fork one at a time.
Mix in remaining ingredients.
Pour into a 9-inch pie pan lined with unbaked pastry.
Bake near center of 375° oven for about 50 minutes or until firm.
Cool before serving.
Combine flour, salt and pepper.
Lay meat on chopping board and sprinkle meat with flour mixture.
Pound in flour mixture, turn meat over and repeat.
(This pounding also tenderizes the meat.)
In hot oil in skillet, brown meat.
Add rest of ingredients.
Stir well.
Simmer about 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or until meat is tender.
Serve over rice.
Serves four people.
Remove crusts from bread; spread bread slices with butter. Place in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; set aside.
Cook sausage until browned, stirring to crumble; drain well.
Spoon sausage over bread slices; sprinkle with cheese.
Combine beaten eggs, milk, salt and pepper; mix well and pour over bread and cheese.
Cover casserole; refrigerate overnight.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Rub the sage, cinnamon and cloves over the surface of the pork.
Place it on a rack and roast the pork for 1-1/2 hours or until it registers 160° on a meat thermometer. Let the roast rest for 15 minutes, then slice and serve.
Heat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients and put in casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
(You can cook bacon to lay on top.)
Lightly toss the chicken, pineapple, dates, celery and almonds until mixed.
Chill well
before you add the mayonnaise. Serve on crunchy bed of lettuce - serves 6.
Mix all ingredients and bake one hour at 350°.
Makes 4 (3 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch) loaves.
Mix all together in a greased casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
In a large bowl, combine the first five ingredients.
In another bowl, combine egg, orange juice, water, butter and orange peel.
Add to dry ingredients just until combined.
Fold in the blueberries.
Pour into a greased and floured 8x4x2-inch loaf pan.
Bake for 65-70 minutes or until test done.
Cool for 10 minutes, remove from pan to wire rack.
Layer in a 9 x 13-inch dish in the order listed.
Refrigerate. Serve with Doritos or Fritos.
After cooking apples stir in soda and set aside.
Cream sugar and butter together.
Add eggs.
Combine flour and dry ingredients together.
Use apples for milk.
Fold in nuts and raisins.
Pour in tube pan and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Grease large casserole.
Add rice, celery, onion, mushrooms, broccoli and parsley.
Heat and mix in a saucepan the remaining ingredients.
Pour the heated sauce into the casserole.
Mix. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Makes 8 servings.
Cooking Time: 45 minutes.
Servings: 4 to 6.
Have steak cut in 3/4-inch slices.
Season with salt and place in shallow glass dish.
Mix peppercorns, onion, carrot, parsley, thyme, bay leaf, wine and 5 tablespoons olive oil; pour over meat. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours.
Turn meat in marinade from time to time.
Remove meat from marinade; pat dry.
Heat 3 tablespoons oil in skillet; cook venison 3 minutes on each side or depending on desired doneness.
Remove meat and keep warm.
Make sauce in same pan.
Fry bacon until crisp; drain.
Crumble and set aside.
Combine spinach, sour cream and soup mix; stir well.
Spoon into a lightly greased 1-quart casserole.
Sprinkle cheese over spinach mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Top with crumbled bacon.
Yields 6 servings.
Preheat oven to 325°.
Shake flour in large size (14 x 20-inch) Reynolds oven cooking bag; place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Add tomato sauce, water, instant bouillon and pepper; squeeze bag gently to blend ingredients.
Place roast in bag. Peel and quarter vegetables; add to bag.
Turn bag gently to coat ingredients with sauce.
Close bag with nylon tie; make 6 (1/2-inch) slits in top.
Insert a meat thermometer through slit in the bag into thickest part of the roast.
Bake 1 3/4 to 2 3/4 hours or until meat thermometer registers 160°.
Slice roast thinly across the grain.
To serve, spoon gravy from bag over roast and vegetables.
Makes 6 to 10 servings.
Stir sugar into beaten egg yolks.
Beat whites until stiff, add to egg yolks and sugar.
Stir vigorously for 10 minutes.
Crush ammonium carbonate thoroughly and add to mixture, along with anise oil and lemon rind.
Add flour in several portions, combining well. Divide dough into 3 or 4 portions.
Turn one out onto floured board and place others in refrigerator.
Roll out 1/4-inch thick.
Dust springerle board with flour, by tying flour into a twist of cheesecloth and striking it lightly against the board.
Stamp sheet of dough firmly with the floured springerle board.
Dissolve jello in 1 cup of boiling water; let cool.
Beat cream cheese, sugar and vanilla; set aside.
Beat cream until stiff.
Mix all together and spread over crust.
If using dried peas, add 1 small onion and garlic and 1 quart water.
Bring to a boil, lower flame and let simmer slowly until beans are tender and creamy.
Add cooked rice, stirring gently, until rice is coated with bean mixture.
Add parsley and onion tops.
Chopped ham or bacon may be added to this.

recipes.t: Chicken With Cauliflower And Black Olives
d: Saute chicken in olive oil with garlic, salt and pepper to taste over moderate heat in wide, uncovered skillet. While chicken is cooking, blanch cauliflower in boiling water (or microwave). Drain and set aside, but keep warm.
When chicken is brown, add vinegar, rosemary and parsley.
Cover, lower heat and simmer for 3 minutes. Take off cover, turn up heat and boil until vinegar has evaporated.
Add tomatoes and when they begin to boil, add black olives and cauliflower.
Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes (careful not to overcook cauliflower).
Serve with white rice. Serves 6.
In a soup pot, saute the scallions in the oil for 1 minute. Add the thyme and tarragon; saute for another minute.
Stir peas, nutmeg, salt and pepper and hot water.
Cover; bring to a boil. Boil for 2 minutes, until the peas are tender but still bright green.
Using a slotted spoon, remove about 1 cup of the peas and set aside.
In a blender or food processor, puree the rest of the soup.
Return the pureed soup into the pot; stir in the milk and reserved peas.
Gently reheat, or chill for about 1 1/2 hours. Garnish with scallions, adding croutons if you wish.
Serves 4. Preparation time:
30 minutes.
Wash navy beans and then run them through hot water until the beans are white again.
Boil slowly 3 1/2 hours in a covered pot containing 4 quarts of water and smoked ham hocks.
Braise onion in a little butter and add it to the soup.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serves 8.
Chop vegetables and pepperoni.
Add to cold spaghetti; add spice.
Toss with entire bottle of dressing.
Mix well.
Better served next day.
Blend ingredients together.
Pour in pie shell.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and bake 35 minutes more or until center is set.
Combine all ingredients, saving 1/2 cup grated cheese for the top.
Place in casserole and bake for 45 minutes in a 450° oven. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
Mix instant tea with remaining ingredients. Store in refrigerator.
When ready to use, add 2 parts water to 1 part mixture. Serve over ice.
Cut chicken tenders into small pieces and fry until golden brown; set aside.
In 3-quart saucepan over high heat, heat water to boiling.
Add noodles and broccoli.
Return to boiling.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover; cook 5 minutes or until noodles and broccoli are tender, stirring occasionally.
Stir in seasoning packets; drain off most of liquid.
Add cheese soup, sour cream, pepper and chicken.
Heat through, stirring occasionally.
In large bowl mix 3/4 cup flour, sugar, salt and yeast.
Add softened margarine; gradually add hot water to dry ingredients and beat for 2 minutes at medium speed.
Add egg and 1/2 cup flour or enough flour to make thick batter.
Beat at high speed 2 minutes, scraping bowl.
Stir in enough additional flour to make a soft dough.
Turn out onto lightly floured board.
Knead until smooth and elastic, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Place in greased bowl, turning to grease top.
Cover.
Let rise in a warm place until double in bulk, about 1 hour.
Beat all ingredients in a bowl. Serve with vegetables, crackers.
Slice flank steak in strips (1/2-inch thick by 2 inches long). Use enough water to cover strips in pressure cooker.
Close lid; cook on high until steam comes out.
Put cap on lid; lower heat to medium.
Cook over medium heat for 20 minutes.
Combine dry ingredients; add eggs and milk, stirring well. Add onion and blend (mixture will be thick).
Dip a large spoon into hot salad oil, then into batter for each hush puppy; drop by spoonfuls in hot salad oil.
Cook until golden brown on both sides.
Drain on paper towels.
Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

recipes.t: Cheese And Potato Wild Rice Soup
d: Combine
wild
rice and water in saucepan and cook over low heat for 45 minutes.
Drain.
Set aside.
Fry bacon pieces and onion
in
skillet until bacon is crisp.
Drain bacon and onion on paper towel.
Place soup in large saucepan; dilute as directed. Stir
in
milk
(1 quart), bacon, onion, cheese and cooked
rice. Stir
until
cheese
is
melted.
Garnish
with carrot.
Yields 8 to 10 servings.
Heat water to boiling and add bouillon.
Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Transfer to blender or food processor and puree until smooth (in several portions, if necessary).
Reheat if necessary or serve at room temperature. Makes 6 servings at 40 calories each.

In large bowl, combine the pretzels, crackers and peanuts. In large pan, combine sugar, butter and corn syrup. Bring to a boil over medium heat; boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla and baking soda (mixture will foam). Pour over pretzel mixture and stir until coated. Pour into greased 15 x 10 x 1 baking pan. Bake at 250° for 45 minutes, stirring every 10 to 15 minutes. Break apart. Add M&M's and candy corn.
Mix well all ingredients.
Sprinkle paprika on top.
Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.
Can also use Monterey Jack, garlic Cheddar and Mozzarella cheese, too.
Best served in a little crock-pot to keep it warm and supply crackers to dip in.
Brown first 3 ingredients.
Mix remaining ingredients.
Add to hamburger mixture.
Simmer 45 minutes.
Bake chicken in a 350° oven for 45 minutes to one hour until fully cooked.
In a medium saucepan, melt the margarine.
Stir in the remaining ingredients and baste the cooked chicken.
Cook the chicken for 10 to 15 minutes.
Serves 8 to 10.
In a large pot, cover onions and potatoes with water.
Simmer, covered, for 25 minutes, until vegetables are tender.
In large saucepan, melt butter and blend in flour.
Gradually add milk and cook until thickened, stirring frequently.
Add milk mixture and shrimp to the soup pot.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Add half and half. Stir well and reheat.
Do not boil.
Add salt and pepper and serve. Yields 2 quarts.
Season fish with salt, pepper and garlic.
Set aside for 15 minutes.
Cut up onion and green pepper.
Squeeze lemon juice over fish.
Put in covered dish.
Add onion, green pepper and s/c lemon over the entire dish.
Cook slow in oven for one hour.
Serve hot.
Combine ingredients in bowl and mix well.
Drop by spoonfuls into the hot oil and fry until golden brown.
Grease and flour tube pan.
Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Bake for 1 hour at 325°.
Cool and remove from pan.
Brown ground beef; drain grease.
Add soup, milk and chilies. Bring to a simmer.
The longer you cook, the hotter it will be.
Dip chicken into egg.
Coat with bread crumbs.
In skillet, over medium heat, heat oil.
Cook chicken 10 minutes or until done.
Set chicken aside.
In same pan, heat Prego sauce to a boil.
Return chicken to skillet.
Cover and cook over low heat 5 minutes or until chicken is done.
Top chicken with cheese and heat until cheese is melted.
Serve with spaghetti.
Top with Parmesan cheese and parsley.
Serves 4.
Brown hamburger meat, chopped onion and chopped bell pepper in skillet.
Drain.
Add barbecue sauce and let simmer for 10 minutes or until mixture is cooked good.
Cook rice in pan and rinse in a colander with cold water to keep rice from sticking together.
I leave both dishes in pans and we dip rice out and add as much meat mixture as we want on top of rice.
Very good.
Cream together butter and sugar.
Put soda in buttermilk. Sift dry ingredients together, adding alternately with the buttermilk.
Add eggs; blend and fold in jam and raisins.
Bake in 10-inch tube pan at 350° for about 1 or 1 1/2 hours according to your oven.
Test with toothpick.
I always line my pan with greased brown paper sack.
Cook chicken breasts until tender.
Debone.
Combine sour cream and both soups and pour over chicken in dish.
Mix dressing mix with butter.
Pour broth on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Prepare cake mix as directed on box.
Let cool.
Poke holes all throughout cake.
Pour pineapple over top.
Mix pudding as directed on box.
Pour over pineapple.
Arrange bananas over pudding.
Frost with Cool Whip and sprinkle pecans over top.
Brush the cut sides of buns with butter. Place on ungreased baking sheets. Combine cheese and seeds; sprinkle over buns. Bake at 450° for 7 to 9 minutes or until golden brown.
Line bottom of an 8-inch square baking dish with wax paper; set aside.
Combine first 6 ingredients in a 2-quart casserole, stirring gently.
Add butter; microwave, uncovered, at High for 2 to 3 minutes or until thoroughly heated through.
Stir until smooth.
Stir in pecans.
Pour mixture into prepared dish. Refrigerate until firm.
Cut into squares.
Yields 16 squares.
Combine sugar, milk and butter; mix thoroughly. Boil 1/2 minute. Mix in oatmeal, vanilla and peanut butter.
Mix thoroughly.
Pour into buttered pan. Cool and cut into squares.
Combine butter, sugar and vanilla; mix well.
Add eggs and beat well.
Stir in flour.
Gradually stir in chocolate, nuts and coconut.
Pour into pastry shell.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Bring water, sugar and vinegar to a boil.
Pour over onions and set overnight.
Drain well.
Add the 1/2 cup mayo and 1 teaspoon of celery seed.
Put sliced potatoes in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.
Mix soup with hamburger and oregano.
Pour over potatoes.
Pour Prego over hamburger.
Bake 1 to 1 1/4 hours at 350°.
Sprinkle cheese over lasagna last 10 minutes of baking.
Combine soup, celery, onion and paprika.
Spoon into 9-inch pie plate that has been sprayed with nonstick vegetable spray.
Spread stuffing mix over, evenly.
Arrange chicken over stuffing.
Combine sugar and mustard; spread evenly over chicken.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
Serves 4.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Prepare cake mix according to package directions, substituting margarine for oil.
Reserve 1 cup batter. Pour remaining batter into 12-cup greased and floured fluted tube pan.
Combine cream cheese and sugar, mixing at medium speed on electric mixer until well blended.
Blend in eggs, one at a time. Pour over batter in pan.
Spoon reserved batter over cream cheese mixture.
Bake 1 hour or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean.
Cool 30 minutes; remove to wire rack.
Combine margarine, chocolate and corn syrup.
Pour over cooled cake. Makes 12 servings.
Preparation time: 15 minutes; cooking time: 35 minutes.
Combine sugar, water and corn syrup in large boiler, being careful not to get mixture on sides of pan.
Place over high heat. When mixture begins to steam, turn unit to low.
Cook mixture to hard ball stage.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Pour one cup of cooked mixture over egg whites, beating constantly.
Cook remaining mixture to light to medium crack stage.
Gradually pour this mixture over egg whites, beating constantly.
Add vanilla. Beat until mixture loses its gloss.
Drop onto waxed paper.
Chop chestnuts and mix with beef and sausage; shape meat into balls and bake on cookie sheet in a 350° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.
Melt peanut butter and chips in large pan; add peanuts and stir well.
Drop onto wax paper and refrigerate.
Form into balls and place in a well-greased dish.
Bake at 350°.
Fry bacon and reserve grease.
In 9 x 11-inch pan, combine beans, onions, brown sugar and catsup.
Crumble bacon and add 2 tablespoons of the grease.
Bake at 300° for 2 hours.
Broil chops on preheated broiler 4 inches from heat 2 minutes on each side.
Heat oil in large skillet.
Add onion and garlic. Cook over medium heat until softened.
Add 1/4 cup water and remaining ingredients except apple.
Top with chops and simmer, covered, on low heat about 1 hour or until chops are tender.
Then stir in apple slices and simmer about 3 minutes.
Serves 2.
Combine turkey (skinned and cooked without salt), carrots, celery and yogurt.
Stir well.
Cover and chill.
Chop beef.
Boil in water.
Add salt and pepper.
After beef is partially cooked, add vegetables and cook 15 minutes.
Add batter made of rest of ingredients.
Drop into stew.
Cover and cook 20 to 30 minutes.
Thoroughly mix all ingredients and chill about 1 hour.
Makes 6 servings.
Place chicken in a casserole. Mix together all the other ingredients and pour over the chicken. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

Mix first 5 ingredients over low heat, stirring constantly until it thickens. Cool. Fold apples and 1/2 cup of peanuts into mixture. Fold in Cool Whip and sprinkle remaining peanuts on top. Refrigerate overnight (but good same day too). Makes about 6 servings.
Mix all ingredients together and pour over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Peel potatoes and cube.
Put in casserole dish with parsley, chopped onion and cut butter all over.
Cook at 400° until potatoes are done.
While still hot, add bacon bits and grated cheese.
Pour Ranch dressing all over.
Cover all; let sit until all is melted.
Saute
vegetables
in
3 tablespoons water with garlic. Mix together
all
ingredients.
Loaf
should be moist but not runny. Bake in sprayed pan at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.
Mix the first 6 ingredients gently, but well.
Put in low, flat casserole.
Toss corn flakes and nuts in margarine and put atop chicken mixture.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or if made ahead and refrigerated, increase baking time to 1 hour.
Serves 10 to 12.
Mix mayonnaise, soup, margarine, eggs and cheese together. Add and mix in vegetables.
Pour into a sprayed casserole dish. (Size 10 x 13-inch for thin casserole or 10 x 10-inch foil pan for thicker.)
Top with stuffing mix and bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.
Mix all ingredients together.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Brown beef with garlic, salt and chili powder; drain.
Mix soups and enchilada sauce.
Crush Doritos and put in bottom of dish.
Pour meat over Doritos.
Top with onions, chilies and cheese.
Bake at 350° to 400° until cheese melts.
Put margarine, brown sugar, Karo syrup and butter flavoring in a microwave-safe dish and cook on High until it boils.
Stir and cook for 2 more minutes; then add baking soda and stir.
Put popcorn in a large brown grocery bag; pour syrup in and stir. Close top of bag and shake.
Microwave in bag on High for 1 1/2 minutes.
Shake and repeat 2 more times.
Pour into a large bowl and stir until dry.
Mix sugar, eggs and oil together.
Add flour, soda and salt, sifted together.
Add vanilla, coconut, nutmeats and apples.
Pour into a large baking pan and bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
Brown hamburger; drain fat off.
Add onion and potatoes; cook for about 20 minutes.
Add tomatoes, corn, salt and pepper.
Cook for 20 minutes more.

Preheat oven to 350°. Brown ground beef and drain. Add salt and pepper. Add mushroom soup and dry onion soup. Spread mixture evenly in the bottom of a 9 x 13 pan. Lay American cheese slices over the top. Cover the top with Tater Tots. Bake at 350° until food thermometer reads 165°, about 20 minutes.
Cube squash and cook in salted water until crisp and tender. Drain.
Saute onions and peppers in butter.
Stir in mushrooms and spaghetti mix.
Add squash, tomato paste and cheese.
Pour all ingredients into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Mix the ingredients and pour into an unbaked pie shell.
Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes or until knife comes out clean.
Cook rice according to package directions.
Dice cooked chicken into large pieces.
Spread rice on bottom of buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Place chicken pieces on top.
Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over chicken and rice.
Heat in a 350° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.
Do not overbake.
Serves 12.
Spread cherries evenly over bottom of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Pour in pineapple, but do not mix.
Sift cake mix on top.
Pour butter on evenly.
Sprinkle with coconut and pecans.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown and coconut is toasted.
Stir together cream cheese, pimento, olives, lemon juice and seasoning until well blended; set aside. Cut each pepper lengthwise into 6 wedges; remove seeds and membrane.

Cut cucumber into 12 slices, on the diagonal. Spoon the cheese mixture into a decorative bag or a heavy large food storage bag; snip one corner. Pipe the mixture onto the vegetables. Cover and chill until ready to serve.

In a large mixing bowl, beat the cake mix and eggs until well blended. Fold in pie filling. Spread into a greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool on a wire rack.
Put pumpkin into large mixing bowl.
Break eggs into pumpkin and mix slowly in electric mixer.
Add sugar, coffee cream, milk, salt and vanilla and mix well.
Pour into crusts.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Bake at 400° for 1/2 hour, then lower temperature to 350° to 375° and bake another 1/2 hour or until testing knife comes out clean.
Makes 2 pies.
Heat oven to 350°.
Combine 1/2 bag of chips with all other ingredients, except cheese.
Put in a 9 x 12-inch pan.
Top with cheese and remaining chips.
Bake until cheese melts and casserole is warm, about 45 minutes.
In butter, saute
onions until pale yellow.
Place in large casserole. Add remaining ingredients, let stand all day.
Bake, uncovered, 1 1/2 hours in 350° oven.
Cream Wesson oil, sugar and applesauce.
Add baking powder, cloves, nutmeg, cinnamon, soda and salt; stir to blend.
Mix together flour, raisins and nuts; add to batter.
Pour in tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.
Cool before removing from pan.
Chop chicken in blender.
Place in bottom of baking dish. Mix dressing according to directions on box and spread on top of chicken.
Heat soup and milk in saucepan until blended.
Pour over dressing.
Dot top with butter.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Mix all ingredients together and cook until heated, approximately 30 minutes.
Boil sugar, syrup and water until it strings (dip spoon in mixture, let drip, cook until it make a thread-like string).
Add peanuts and boil until peanuts turn in color (295° on candy thermometer).
Remove from heat and add soda, mixing well and quickly.
Mixture will be foamy.
Immediately spread as thin as possible onto large buttered cookie sheet or greased marble slab. After cooled, break up into pieces.
Store in covered container. Makes 36 servings.
Combine chicken, drained pineapple, grapes, celery and peanuts.
Stir in tarragon.
Combine mayonnaise, lemon juice and 2 tablespoons pineapple juice.
Gently fold into chicken mixture. Serve on lettuce with parsley or small celery leaves as a garnish. Serves 8.
Cut very fine as for relish the cukes, peeled and with seeds removed.
Add 1/4 cup of salt and let stand overnight.
Drain in morning and add onions, chopped fine, vinegar, sugar, flour, turmeric, dry mustard, mustard and celery seed.
Cook 1 hour and put in hot jars.
Boil potato until done.
Mash potato (do not add anything). Then add powdered sugar to dough consistency.
Roll out to about 1/16-inch thick.
Spread peanut butter all over.
Roll up and slice.
May add food coloring at beginning for color.
Mix together all ingredients.
Spray 2 loaf pans with Pam. Divide mixture between pans.
Top with catsup or barbecue sauce. Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Dissolve gelatin and marshmallows in hot water. Add juice from pineapple. Chill until set.
Blend mayonnaise and cream cheese. Add pineapple. Beat well with gelatin mixture. Add pecans and whipped cream.
Refrigerate until firm.
Serve on lettuce.
Cut cantaloupe into about 1-inch cubes.
Place in a 9-inch unbaked pie shell.
Mix sugar, flour and salt and sprinkle over cantaloupe.
Then sprinkle with cinnamon and dot with margarine. Bake at 425° until thick and brown.
Bake at 350° for approximately 50 minutes.
I haven't found anyone who didn't love this dish.
Freezes well also.

Boil shells until done. Mix Ricotta cheese, Parmesan cheese and eggs in bowl. Stuff shells with mixture. Line in a 9 x 12- inch baking dish. Pour spaghetti sauce over stuffed shells and top with cheese. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes. Let sit for 15 minutes, then serve.
Reserve 1/4 cup frosting.
In large bowl, combine remaining frosting, graham cracker crumbs and margarine.
Blend well.
Shape mixture into 1-inch balls and immediately roll each ball in ground nuts.
With finger, make imprint in center of each ball. Place in single layer in 13 x 9-inch pan.
Combine mayonnaise, salt, lemon juice, onion juice and pimentos.
Add chicken, celery and hard-boiled eggs; stir gently to coat.
Pour into lightly greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Top with grated Cheddar cheese and then top with crumbled potato chips.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Yield:
8 servings.
Excellent when served with spiced peaches and soft rolls.
Spice peaches with sprinkles of one or more of your favorite spices, cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, cloves, etc.
Follow directions on cake mix (bake in oblong pan).
Let cake cool on serving platter.
Beat softened cream cheese.
Add milk, then package of instant pudding; mix well.
Spread on top (not sides) of cooled cake.
Spread pineapple over that (not sides). Spread Cool Whip over entire cake.
Then place strawberries on Cool Whip after you have washed them.
Keep refrigerated.
Cook cubed potatoes in boiling water until tender.
Drain well.
Mix mayonnaise, sugar, celery seed, vinegar, mustard and salt.
Add onion, celery and sweet pickles.
Add mayonnaise mixture to potatoes.
Toss lightly to coat mixture.
Carefully fold in chopped eggs.
Cover tightly and chill.
Makes about eight servings.
*Three level tablespoons of cocoa + 1 tablespoon of oil = 1 square chocolate.
In a 6 to 8 quart container heat together candy bars, broken into pieces, marshmallow cream, butter, vanilla and semi-sweet morsels.
In a 4 to 6 quart sauce pan combined granulated sugar and evaporated milk.
Let sugar and milk come to a hard boil. Cook stirring constantly for 6 minutes.
Pour sugar and evaporated milk over remaining ingredients. Blend until smooth and creamy. Fold in chopped pecans. Pour mixture into a cook tray or jelly roll pan lined with wax paper.
Let stand 4 to 6 hours until completely set before removing. Yield:
6 pounds fudge.
*Vegetables:
Green onions, chopped broccoli, cauliflower, shredded carrots, green peppers and whatever you have.
Beat cream cheese and add Eagle Brand milk.
Blend in lemon juice and vanilla.
Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.
Garnish with cherry pie filling and put 1 fresh cherry in center.
Measure all ingredients into blender; mix on high speed until smooth (or beat all ingredients with rotary beater).
Yields 2 servings (about 3/4 cup each).
Mix all ingredients in large bowl.
Wash chicken; put in colander to drain and wipe dry with paper towel.
Prepare chicken first and set aside.
Place chicken in large baking plan flat and pour over chicken.
Refrigerate overnight or at least 6 hours. Cover with wax paper.
Mix all ingredients together and pour in unbaked pie shell. Cook for 1 hour at 300°.
Cut the salt pork into 1-inch pieces and simmer for one hour. Wash and remove the wilted leaves of the cabbage, cut into the size you want.
Add the cabbage, carrots and potatoes to the salt pork. Simmer until vegetables are cooked.
With this recipe, you can also cook it in 1 pint of milk and 1/4 cup flour to give it creamy sauce.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.
Combine all ingredients in a large bowl; beat at medium speed of an electric mixer until well blended.
Pour into freezer can of a 5-quart hand turn or electric freezer.
Freeze according to manufacturer's instructions.
Let ripen at least 1 hour before eating.
Mix ingredients and pour into buttered casserole dish.
Bake at 325 ° for 2 hours. Onion and/or bacon may be added for flavor, and I think they greatly improve the beans.
About 1 hour before serving, start heating oven to 375°.
In large bowl with fork, combine bread crumbs, milk, eggs, salt, Tabasco, m.s.g. and poultry seasoning until mixed.
Add chunks of salmon with fork; mix well.
Lightly turn into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan; smooth off top.
Bake for 45 minutes or until firm in center.
Turn out.
Place right side up on heated platter. Serve, sliced, with peaches as the garnish and Creamy Pea and Scallion Sauce over each slice.
Makes 4 servings.
Beat oil and sugar together.
Add slightly beaten eggs.
Add all ingredients together (except flour), then add flour.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
(I bake at 325° after about 15 or 20 minutes.)
Melt white chocolate in double boiler over medium heat.
Add peanut butter.
Stir as needed.
Remove from heat.
Combine nuts and crisp cereal in a bowl.
Pour melted chocolate and peanut butter over mixture; stir in marshmallows.
Use a teaspoonful to drop small amount of mixture onto wax paper; let cool.

recipes.t: Tuna Fish And Egg Bows Salad(Italian)
d: Cook bows according to package directions.
Drain and rinse with cold water.
Chop vegetables and mix well with bows, salt, pepper and paprika.
Combine pickles and mayonnaise.
Add vegetable mixture. Arrange tuna fish on top. Serve on bed of lettuce. Serves 4 to 6.
Preparation time:
15 to 20 minutes. Cooking time:
10 to 12 minutes.
In a small bowl, thoroughly combine onion soup mix, preserves and water; set aside.
In an aluminum foil-lined broiler pan, arrange chicken breasts and peppers.
Top with soup mixture. Broil 20 minutes or until chicken is done, turning once while broiling.
Serve over hot rice.
Melt oleo and brown sugar.
Add quick oats, baking powder and salt.
Press into greased or buttered pan. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Mix together thoroughly.
Form a loaf and place in loaf pan.
Blend soup and milk in buttered 1 1/2-quart dish and arrange layer of potatoes, onion and sauce.
Dot top with butter and sprinkle with paprika.
Cover and bake in 375° oven 1 hour and uncover and bake 15 minutes or until potatoes are done.

Fry ground meat and onions. When done, drain off fat and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan or a large casserole dish. Cook potatoes and drain, leaving 1/2 cup of water in potatoes. Put butter in potatoes. Add mixed vegetables and mix well. Pour over ground meat mixture. Pour creamed corn over entire mixture. Mix Jiffy cornbread as directed on box. Pour over all ingredients. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until brown.
Combine butter, cheese, flour, hot sauce and salt.
Mix well. Gently fold in Rice Krispies.
Shape into walnut size balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with a fork.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Makes 6 dozen.
Combine and put in greased casserole dish.
Fry the burger, sausage, onion and green pepper in the butter.
When cooked, add cumin, hot sauce, Tabasco and salsa. Simmer for about 30 minutes.
Add V-8 juice.
Bring to boil and add pasta.
Cook until pasta is just tender.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Julienne the green pepper and zucchini.
Slice onion thin. Finely chop the garlic.
Peel the tomatoes; seed and drain.
Beat eggs and Parmesan together.
In a 12-inch nonstick omelet pan, saute green pepper and onion until onion begins to brown.
Add tomatoes and garlic; saute 5 to 10 minutes.
Add shrimp, zucchini and drained spaghetti.
Toss until well mixed.
Pour egg and Parmesan mixture over the contents in pan.
Cook until eggs begin to set and mixture browns.
Slide Frittata onto an oiled plate. Invert pan over the Frittata; flip over and fry on the other side until brown.
Boil chicken breasts for 45 minutes with plenty of water. Remove chicken and add bouillon cubes; stir in cream of chicken soup.
Mix dry ingredients; cut in shortening.
Add milk; mix and put on floured board.
Roll to 1/8-inch thickness, then cut into 1-inch squares.
Drop into pot of boiling broth and cook about 15 minutes.
Cover pan and reduce heat for cooking time.
Cut up chicken and add to dumplings.
Mix all dry ingredients. Beat margarine and sugar until fluffy.
Add 1 egg at a time, continually beating. Add dry ingredients to oil.
Mix thoroughly. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight.
To bake, form small balls and place on greased and floured cookie sheet.
Press with glass that has been dipped in sugar.
Bake at 350°, 12 to 13 minutes or until edges are brown.
Combine graham crackers and 1/4 cup sugar; add gradually to softened butter; stir in water.
Press into pie plate.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Soak gelatin in 1/4 cup of the milk for 5 minutes.
Scald rest of milk.
Separate eggs; beat yolks slightly; add 1/3 cup sugar and salt.
Pour scalded milk over them gradually while stirring.
Return to heat and cook, stirring until custard coats spoon.
Remove from heat and add gelatin; stir until dissolved.
Beat egg whites stiff; fold into custard; add brandy and nutmeg.
Chill until thickened.
Pour into crust.
Chill until set and top with whipped cream.
Mix ground beef, onion and celery in 5-quart casserole. Microwave on High (100%) until ground beef loses its pink color, 5 to 7 minutes, stirring after half the cooking time.
Brown beef and drain.
Mix all other ingredients in 5-quart saucepan.
Add ground beef and cook until cabbage is tender, then drain.
Take 1/4 cup of mix and place in corner of one egg roll wrapper.
Roll wrapper to corner.
Fold over opposite ends. Continue rolling.
Dab water on edges to seal.
Deep fry until golden brown.
Place all ingredients in blender.
Mix until chickpeas are smooth.
Store hummus in covered container in refrigerator. Serve well chilled.
Garnish with chopped parsley.
More garlic may be added, if desired.
Thin with additional lemon juice if served as dip with chips.

Combine flour, sugar, salt and baking powder in mixing bowl. Add Crisco and first cup milk called for in the recipe. Beat vigorously by hand or electric mixer on medium speed for 2 minutes. Add egg whites, additional 1/3 cup milk and lemon flavoring. Beat for 2 minutes on medium speed. Pour into two 9-inch layer pans which have been greased with Crisco and floured. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
To start, take whole chicken and boil in about 8 to 10 cups of water and chicken bouillon cubes; makes broth. Have this ready to go before beginning rest of recipe.
Simmer onion and pepper in oil for approximately 5 minutes. Add okra, then tomato sauce.
Let simmer; cover for 45 minutes.
Mix all ingredients together and warm on Medium power in microwave until cheese melts (not too hot; do it slowly).
Serve with rye crackers or pumpernickel bread.
Melt caramels and cream in double boiler or microwave. Gradually add other ingredients and drop by teaspoonful on waxed paper.
Makes two dozen.
Separate rolls; pat them around pie tin.
Press chips into dough.
Brown meat.
Drain grease.
Add seasoning plus water. Bring to boil and simmer.
Blend in sour cream and add to pie crust.
Sprinkle grated cheese and more corn chips.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
In large mixing bowl, mash hot potatoes.
When all lumps are removed, add cream cheese in small pieces and then butter.
Beat well until cheese and butter are both melted and well mixed.
Mix in sour cream.
To the milk, add eggs and onions.
Add to the potato mixture along with the salt and pepper.
Beat well until fluffy.
Place in a greased casserole dish and refrigerate several hours or overnight.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes until lightly browned.
Makes 8 to 12 servings.
Cream together margarine and sugar.
Add eggs one at a time, beating after each addition.
Add vanilla and combine flour, baking powder, salt and soda.
Combine spread and yogurt.
Add dry ingredients and strawberry mixture to creamed mixture (beginning and ending with dry ingredients).
Pour into a loaf pan and bake at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes.
Combine ingredients and form into mini loaves.
Put loaves in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Top with sauce.
Bake.
Mix peanut butter and maple syrup.
Add Rice Krispies.
Put half mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spread softened ice cream on top of mixture.
Put rest of Krispies mixture on top.
Freeze.
Enjoy!
Mix crust ingredients together and pat in a 9-inch spring-form pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Cook noodles.
Rinse.
Combine ham and 3/4 cup cheese. Combine soup, milk and onion.
Place 1/2 noodles in bottom of 2-quart dish.
Sprinkle 1/2 ham and cheese mixture over noodles. Pour 1/2 soup mixture over ham mixture.
Repeat 1, 2, 3.
Sprinkle top with rest of cheese.
Dot with butter.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
Drain
juice
off
of canned corn, beans and peas.
Mix all ingredients together, then put into refrigerator.
Let set 24 hours before serving.
In a 2-quart casserole dish, combine butter and mushrooms 2 to 3 minutes on High in microwave, stirring once.
Stir in soup, soy sauce and white pepper.
Microwave on High 3 minutes or until hot. Stir once.
Stir in shrimp and sour cream.
Cover with lid and cook on Medium in microwave 4 to 5 minutes or until heated.
Stir once.
Serve over rice.

recipes.t: Oriental Marinade For Beef Or Chicken
d: Mix all ingredients together and blend well.
Pour over chicken or steak.
Marinate 4 to 6 hours.
Turn once during marinating.
Grill!
Saute first 4 ingredients in 1/4 cup butter.
Add flour and cook 2 minutes.
Heat milk and
broth to boiling.
Slowly add vegetables.
Stir constantly.
Add rice, pimento, chicken and parsley.
Simmer until thick.
Combine onion, orange juice, oil, orange peel and salt in greased (12 x 8 x 2-inch) pan.
Arrange snapper fillets in this mixture, turning to coat evenly.
Leave at room temperature for 30 minutes (lightly cover dish).
Add nutmeg and pepper.
Bake at 400° for about 12 minutes or until fillets flake easily.
Baste. Serve immediately.
Mix in large mixing bowl with mixer on high.
Mix for 4 to 5 minutes or until smooth.
Line muffin pan with bake cups.
Pour batter in bake cups (2-inches).
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in the middle comes out clean.
Mix all ingredients together.
Boil for 5 minutes.
Reduce heat and simmer until mixture thickens.
Serve on any meat of your choice.
Store unused portion in the refrigerator.
Sprinkle eggplant in colander with 1 1/4 teaspoons salt.
Let drain 30 minutes.
Place tomatoes, cut side down, on paper towels. Drain 30 minutes.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in skillet. Saute garlic and onion.
Discard garlic; don't break onion into rings.
Drain. Rinse eggplant and drain.
Brush with oil and broil 5 minutes; turn and repeat.
Arrange in alternating layers, slightly overlapping.
Sprinkle with spices and cheese.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until cheese melts.
Makes 6 servings.
Place all the ingredients into a suitable container, toss and refrigerate.
Soak sun dried tomatoes in warm water for 30 minutes.
Cook rotini as directed (al dente).
Cook chopped broccoli in microwave on High for 4 minutes.
Add red pepper and chopped sun dried tomatoes to broccoli.
Cook 1 minute in microwave.
Saute chopped garlic in oil until hot.
Add vegetables, chopped Feta cheese and garlic and oil to rotini.
Cover with parsley and serve.
Cream margarine and sugar.
Add eggs, beating well after each. Stir in milk and apples.
Mix dry ingredients and stir in.
Add nuts.
Pour into 2 greased loaf pans.
Let stand 20 minutes.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
Turn out and cool on rack.
Put cabbage on top of meat mixture.
Add Ro-Tel tomatoes. Cook until cabbage is done, then serve.
Dissolve jello in hot water.
Add sugar, lemon juice and pineapple syrup.
Then add the rest of the ground up ingredients. Put in refrigerator to set.
Excellent for Thanksgiving.
Wash spinach; cook in small amount of water 3 to 5 minutes. Drain well.
Wash and pat dry mushrooms.
Slice and saute mushrooms in butter.
Combine soup, milk, 1/2 cup cheese, salt and pepper to taste.
Heat sauce, stirring until smooth and cheese is melted.
Layer spinach, mushrooms and sauce in greased 1-quart casserole.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake in preheated 350° oven 20 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.
Cream shortening,
sugar,
brown sugar, vanilla, peanut butter,
eggs
and	water.	Beat
creamed
ingredients
for
2 minutes.
Mix flour, soda and salt in a separate bowl.
Add to creamed mixture and beat
1 minute more.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet.
Bake for 7 to 11 minutes at 325°.
In food processor, mix 1 part sun dried tomatoes and 1/4 part water until pasty.
Cut Foccaio bread into 4 x 4-inch squares and slice so that you have two 4 x 4-inch sides of bread.
Lightly brush bread with olive oil.
Spread tomato mixture on the bottom side of bread.
Place 2 ounces of chicken breast on top of tomato mixture.
Put 2 leaves of fresh basil on chicken, broken into small pieces.
