Put 1 ounce of cheese on top of basil and chicken.
Cover with top slice of bread.
Grill or bake until cheese is melted.

Brown beef if not already cooked. Add frozen vegetables and bring to a boil. Lower heat; add remaining ingredients (except tomatoes). Keep a check on the water content and add more as needed. Cook until potatoes and vegetables are tender. Add tomatoes; cook another 15 minutes. Serve with cornbread.
Dissolve Jell-O, sugar and salt in boiling water. Stir in orange juice. Chill until slightly thickened.
Beat until fluffy and light. Stir in whipped topping until well blended. Fold in undrained pineapple and coconut.
Pour into a large serving bowl. Chill until firm.
Mix pretzels, margarine and 1 cup sugar and press in 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish.
Bake at 325° for 8 minutes.
Take Cool Whip, cream cheese and sugar; mix and spread on pretzels.
Put pineapple and cornstarch in saucepan; bring to a boil until thickens.
Spread on top of cream mixture.
Chill!
Dissolve yeast.
Add milk, sugar, salt, shortening and half the flour; mix until smooth.
Mix in rest of flour until dough
is easy to handle.
Knead on floured surface until smooth (10 minutes should do it).
Put in greased bowl, cover with dish towel and let it rise about an hour, until double.
Divide dough in half, shape into loaves.
Place in greased loaf pans.
Brush with butter and let rise another hour.
Bake at 425° about 25 to 30 minutes, until brown.
To test for doneness, tap to see if they sound hollow. Brush with butter, if you like.
Yields 2 loaves.
The sausage patties should be no more than 1/2 inch thick. They should be cooked slowly so as not to destroy the taste of the spices.
Turn often so the sausage will cook all the way through.
Combine squash, onion and pepper with salt.
Let stand 1 hour. Combine sugar, vinegar and celery seed; bring to boil.
Add squash, onion and green pepper; boil 3 minutes.
Pack in jars and seal.
Blend oil and brown sugar.
Stir in egg.
Blend flour and baking powder and add to egg mixture.
Add vanilla.
Pour in greased 8 x 8-inch pan.
Cook 25 minutes in 350° oven.
Layer 1 can refried beans mixed with salsa or taco sauce and sour cream mixed with taco seasoning.
Top with onion, pepper, cheese, tomatoes, black olives or whatever you choose.
Dip in unseasoned taco chips.
Stir all ingredients together until well blended.
Pour in unbaked pie crust and bake 10 minutes at 400°, then bake 30 minutes at 325°.
Mix all ingredients in blender.
Place chicken breasts in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Pour salad dressing over chicken.
Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 20 minutes. Place rice, vegetables, 1/2 cup French fried onions around and under chicken.
Combine bouillon and Italian seasoning; pour over chicken and vegetables.
Bake, uncovered, 25 minutes.
Top with remaining onions; bake 2 to 3 minutes longer.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
Peel eggs; cut in half.
Take out yolks.
Mash fine; add all ingredients but paprika.
Mix until smooth.
(May need a little more liquid, if so use pickle juice or salad dressing.)
Place mixture back in egg whites and sprinkle with paprika.
Can decorate with olives.
Store in refrigerator.
Prepare noodles as per package directions. Add all soups but only 1/2 the water required for soups.
Heat over low heat until bubbling.
Drain corn and place in large bowl.
Add remaining ingredients.
Serve with tostitos.
Heat oven at 350°.
Cream margarine; add sugar, salt and flavoring and cream well.
Add flour gradually.
Shape into balls the size of a marble.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Press a hole in the center of each ball.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes, until delicately browned.
Fill with Creamy Pecan Filling while warm. Cool before frosting.
Melt oleo in a casserole dish.
In another bowl, mix remainder of ingredients.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Pour into casserole with melted oleo.
Bake in a 350° oven until sides are brown.
Brown turkey in a little oil.
Add 2 cups water and mixed vegies.
Throw in the noodles and stir.
Cover pot and simmer about 10 minutes.
Add the soup mix and more water if it needs it. Let simmer until all the vegies are done.
Don't let it suck up all the liquid.
Real good with corn bread.
Serves 4.
Mix browned meat and onion with other ingredients.
Top with the remaining Tater Tots.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
In a large punch bowl, combine pineapple juice, cranberry juice, lemonade concentrate, sugar and food coloring, if used. Just before serving, pour in the ginger ale.
Garnish with ice ring or serve over ice.
Makes 36 (1/2-cup) servings.
Stew chicken breasts; cool.
Remove chicken from bone.
Tear into bite-size pieces.
Combine butter and cracker crumbs, mixing well.
Spoon 1/2 of crumbs into a shallow 2-quart baking dish.
Top with chicken.
Combine sour cream, soup, broth, salt and pepper. Pour over chicken and top with remaining crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
Scramble eggs until firm; break up into small pieces. Set aside.
Marinate chicken pieces with 1/2 soy sauce, cornstarch and 1 tablespoon water for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
Heat oil in frying pan (medium-high heat).
Fry chicken pieces, separating pieces at the same time, for 2 1/2 minutes or until chicken is cooked.
Set aside.
Using the same frying pan, stir-fry onion, green onion and frozen peas for 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to low; add cooked rice, soy sauce and oyster sauce.
Mix and stir; add cooked egg and chicken.
Mix well.
Makes 4 servings.
Mix ground beef, sausage, regular rice, onion, garlic, 1 can tomato sauce and seasonings in bowl.
Prepare cabbage by simmering in boiling water until tender.
Remove core before placing in water.
Roll meat mixture into sausage link shape and wrap with cabbage leaves.
Place seam side down in heavy baking pan. Cover with sauerkraut and juice and second can of tomato sauce.
Add enough water to partially cover.
Bake at 325° for 3 hours.
Cover loosely with foil for first 2 hours.
Makes 20 to 24 rolls. Reheats well.

Bring to boil. Place cucumbers in sterilized jars, wide-mouth if possible. In each jar, place a clove of fresh garlic, hot pepper, if desired, a fresh grape leaf and fresh green dill. Pour the boiling brine over the cucumbers. Seal tightly and store about 30 days.
Melt butter.
Add flour and nuts; press into bottom of dish. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
In medium bowl, combine ingredients; mix well.
Cover.
Chill. Serve with tortilla chips.
Refrigerate leftovers.
Makes about 4 cups.
Brown hamburger with several strips of bacon, cut up.
In separate bowl, cut up onion.
Add beans and remaining ingredients. Add hamburger and bacon; stir well.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.
Combine first 5 ingredients and mix well.
Sprinkle 1/4 cup pecans in an oiled 7-cup ring mold and press cheese mixture into mold.
Chill until firm.
Unmold on platter and pat remaining pecans onto cheese ring.
Garnish with parsley sprigs.
Serve on crackers with strawberry preserves.
You can prepare this early in the day or even weeks ahead and freeze it.
Mix all ingredients to form a spread.
Cut Pepperidge Farm French loaves into thin slices and spread mixture evenly on bread. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.
May be made ahead and frozen. Increase baking time 10 to 15 minutes.
Place cheese in bowl.
Add eggs.
Mix well.
Add salt and flour and mix.
On floured board, knead lightly until smooth and it doesn't stick to hands.
Drop by spoonfuls into boiling, salted water.
Cook until dumplings rise to the top or until tender, about 10 minutes.
Drain.
Fry onion in butter; pour over dumplings.
Serve with sour cream.
Place 1 chicken piece and half of the remaining ingredients on each of 2 foil squares.
Seal tightly.
Place in casserole.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes or until chicken is tender.
Place the elderberries in an 8 x 12-inch baking dish.
Mix together the next 7 ingredients.
Crumble over berries.
Pour the melted oleo over crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, or until brown on top.
Serves 12 to 15.
Mix all ingredients except cheese and place in a large, greased casserole dish or 2 smaller ones.
Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake in 350° oven for about 30 minutes.
Combine all ingredients; mix well.
Better if made a day ahead.
Mix thoroughly; pour into greased and floured loaf pan.
Bake in moderate oven 1 hour.
Cook sausage until done (well browned).
Slice bread about 1/2-inch thick and put in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Drain sausage and spoon over bread (reserve 1/2 cup).
Now beat eggs and milk together; pour this over the sausage and bread.
Top with remaining sausage and cheese.
Bake 35 minutes in a 350° oven.
Mix ingredients together.
Roll in pecans (crushed).
Add Tabasco sauce, if desired.
Place 1/2 of Tater Tots in bottom of 2-quart casserole.
Brown hamburger meat.
Add onion and cook until done; drain.
Add cream of mushroom soup and water.
Mix well.
Add grated cheese.
Pour over Tater Tots and place remaining Tater Tots on top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bubbly and browned on top.
Mix ground
beef,
egg,
chili powder, salt and pepper. Shape into 1 1/2 to 2-inch balls.
Place in 2 quart casserole. Microwave on High
until
meatballs
are set and lose the pink color (4 to 7
minutes), rearranging meatballs after half the cooking time. Drain.
Stir
in remaining ingredients.
Cover. Microwave on High until
mixture
is	bubbly	and
onions are tender (4 to
7 minutes).
Stir
after half the cooking time. Let stand until rice is tender (2 to 3 minutes).
Make instant pudding as directed per package.
Mix the flour, butter, sugar and nuts together.
Press the mixture in a 9 x 13-inch flat pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes or until done.
Cool for 30 minutes.
Bring 8
cups water to a boil.	Add tea bags and remove from heat. Keep covered for 5 minutes. Add sugar.
Boil 4 cups water. Add cloves and simmer for 5 minutes. Mix tea and clove water
with orange
juice,
lemon
juice and pineapple juice. Makes about 1 gallon. Serve warm.
Mix together 1 1/2 cups of the flour, sugar, salt, cinnamon and undissolved yeast in large bowl.
Combine milk, water and butter in saucepan.
Heat to very warm (120° to 130°).
Gradually add to flour-yeast mixture.
Beat with electric mixer at medium speed for 2 minutes.
Add eggs and 1/2 cup of the flour; beat 2 minutes at high speed.
Stir in raisins and enough remaining flour to make a soft dough.
Cover; let rise until doubled, about 50 minutes.
Stir down.
Turn into 2 well-greased 1 1/2-quart casseroles.
Cover; let rise in warm place until double, about 40 minutes.
Bake in 375° oven for 35 minutes or until done.
Remove from casseroles; cool on racks.
Makes 2.
Saut bell pepper and onion in bacon drippings until onions are translucent.
Add the remaining ingredients and stir gently. Cover and simmer until okra is tender, about 10 minutes.
Cook broccoli in boiling water.
Do not overcook.
Drain.
Mix together soup, sour cream, salt, pepper, carrots and onions.
Mix broccoli in the sauce.
Melt butter.
Mix in bread crumbs and spread on top.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until bubbly.
Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.
Stir in frozen orange juice.
Add pineapple (with juice).
Drain oranges; add.
Mix all together.
Refrigerate overnight.
Soften yeast a little in milk.
Add remaining milk and beaten egg yolks.
Mix shortening into flour and salt.
Add liquid to make a soft dough.
Chill thoroughly.
Roll out as pie crust on sugar sprinkled lightly floured board and cut into pieces about 3 x 4-inches.
Make a paste of the walnuts, egg whites, sugar and salt. Spread onto the dough and make into tiny rolls.
Place on cookie sheets and bake at 350° until lightly brown.
Salt, pepper, garlic powder and thyme to taste.
Cook spinach and drain very well.
Combine all ingredients and roll into balls, using about 1 teaspoon mixture for each.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 20 minutes on greased cookie sheet.
Remove from cookie sheet at once and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot.
Makes 75 balls.
Slice bananas and spread over crust.
Mix condensed milk, lemon juice and sugar; spread over bananas.
Spread crushed pineapple over condensed milk mixture.
Spread Cool Whip over pineapple.
Sprinkle chopped nuts and cherries on top. Refrigerate to set.
Serve.
Makes 8 servings.
Mash avocados to a lumpy consistency.
Mix all ingredients except the garlic.
Stick the toothpicks with garlic into the mixture.
Refrigerate.
Remove toothpicks with garlic before serving.
Blend egg yolks and milk.
Stir in the pancake mix.
Continue stirring until smooth.
Fold in the corn. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into mixture.
Pour cooking oil into an iron skillet a half to 1-inch deep and heat. Drop batter by tablespoonfuls into hot oil. Cook until golden brown on both sides.
Use half of seasoning mix in rice mix.
Combine all ingredients and let stand overnight in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Serves 15.
Mix ground beef, egg, salt and pepper together.
Shape into meatballs.
Combine Rice-A-Roni seasoning packet with 2 1/2 cups of water; pour over meat.
Cover and let simmer for 30 minutes.
Mix in order given.
Put in 9 x 9-inch greased and floured pan.
Combine all ingredients and spread in baking dish.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
Place can of milk in freezer until cold.
Combine eggs, sugar and pineapple juice.
Cook over medium to low heat until eggs are cooked, approximately 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and add jello to mixture while still hot.
Cool.
Take can of milk from freezer. Beat on high for 5 to 6 minutes.
Fold in with cooked cooled mixture.
Pour into graham cracker crusts.
Refrigerate.
Be sure congealed before cutting.
A cool dessert for summer.
Sear both sides of roast over hot coals.
Place in a large piece of heavy-duty foil.
Add sliced potatoes, onions, carrots and any other vegetables.
Season.
Seal in double foil.
Cook on hot coals about 1 hour; turn occasionally.
Boil chicken (add no salt).
Skin and debone.
Reserve 2 cups chicken broth.
In a 9 x 13-inch pan, place half of chicken.
Mix 1 cup chicken broth and cream of chicken soup. Pour over chicken. Put remaining chicken on top of soup.
Take the other cup of broth and mix with the cream of mushroom soup.
Pour over the next chicken layer.
(If you are using mushrooms, use half each time with chicken layers.)
Melt butter and mix with the stuffing.
Put over top of second soup layer.
Cook in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine cake mix, cooking oil and water; mix.
Add eggs; mix.
Add peanut butter; mix well.
Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Press crisscross on each cookie with fork prongs that have been dipped in water.
Cream butter and cheese in bowl.
Add garlic powder and Worcestershire sauce.
Mix in crab meat.
Spread mixture over toasted halves of muffins.
Place on cookie sheet.
(You can now freeze well wrapped until needed.)
Heat oven and bake until hot. Cut in quarters to serve.
Roll chicken in margarine.
Roll in mixture of bread crumbs and cheese.
Place in Pyrex dish.
Bake at 425° for 20 to 30 minutes until crispy and browned.
Serves 4.
To
Make
Sauce:
Boil	the
dashi
broth with carrots, celery and
onion
until	the vegetables are tenderly cooked. Add soy sauce and thicken it with a little cornstarch (about 1 1/2 tablespoons) mixed with about 2 tablespoons water.

Place the vegetables, broth, 2 cups of water and celery seeds in a soup pot and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Cover loosely and reduce heat to simmer until vegetables are very tender, 25 to 30 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. Transfer the vegetable mixture to a food processor and puree until very smooth. This may have to be done in batches. Return the soup to the pot. Add salt and pepper to taste and cook over medium heat until just heated through. Taste and adjust the seasonings, if necessary. Serve garnished with parsley.
Beat the first 3 ingredients together until stiff.
On brown paper or parchment lined cookie sheet, shape meringue into shells, either with pastry bag or spoon. Bake at 275° for 1 hour.
Cool.
Cook until thick; take off stove and add lemon juice, coconut and butter.
Blend well.
Pour into a baked pie shell.
Add meringue made with the 2 egg whites.
Cream together first 4 ingredients.
In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt.
Add bananas and half of flour mixture.
Mix well.
Add chips and nuts; then rest of flour.
Drop on greased and floured cookie sheet.
Bake for about 12 minutes at 350°.
Makes a soft cookie and a large batch.
Mix together the flour, butter and pecans.
Press into the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 15 minutes at 350°.
Combine soups, chicken broth and tomatoes; set aside.
Oil a 3-quart casserole.
Layer half of tortilla pieces, half of chicken, half of onion and half of cheese in the casserole.
Pour half of chicken broth mixture over layers.
Repeat layers of tortillas, chicken and onion, then pour remaining chicken broth over top with remaining cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
Place all ingredients in bowl; mix well.
Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet.
Bake 10 minutes at 375°.
Preheat oven to 425°.
Fry sausage in heavy medium skillet over medium heat until cooked through, turning occasionally. Drain.
Dice sausage.
Dust one side of pie crust with 1 teaspoon of flour.
Gently transfer crust into pan.
Arrange half of Mozzarella over bottom of crust.
Spread 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce over Mozzarella.
Sprinkle half of Jack cheese atop sauce. Drizzle 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce over cheese.
Repeat layering with remaining Mozzarella, 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce, remaining Jack cheese, pepperoni and sausage.
Sprinkle with olives and drizzle with remaining 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce.
Top with remaining pie crust.
Pinch edges of crust together to seal.
Crimp edges to make decorative border.
Bake until golden brown, about 40 minutes.
Let pie stand 30 minutes before serving.
Mix all ingredients together.

recipes.t: Caramel Rolls(Made With Frozen Bread Dough.)
d: These light, tender sweet rolls feature a rich caramel topping made with brown sugar and heavy cream.
Heat oven to 350°.
Place chocolates, margarine or butter and instant coffee in a large, microwave-safe bowl.
Cook on High (100% power) for 2 minutes, until margarine is melted.
Remove from oven; stir until chocolate is completely melted.
Stir in sugar and corn syrup.
Beat in eggs, sour cream and vanilla. Pour into pie shell; sprinkle with almonds.
Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes or until knife inserted 1-inch from the center comes out clean.
Cool on rack.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.
Heat soup.
Dissolve gelatin in cold water.
Add to soup, along with all the other ingredients.
Pour into loaf or mold pan and chill overnight.
Serve with crackers or celery.
"Excellent with Triscuits."
Dissolve jello in hot water.
Add other ingredients.
Use any desired salad dressing (optional).
Very good.
Combine all ingredients except noodles and put into greased casserole. Sprinkle noodles over casserole. Bake at 325° for 40 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

Heat oil in large skillet. Sprinkle pork chops with seasoning salt and brown in hot skillet. Set aside. In large mixing bowl, combine soup, sour cream, black pepper, potatoes and cheese. In 9 x 13 baking dish, layer potato mixture with pork chops on top. Bake in 350° oven for 40 minutes. Cover with onion rings and return to oven for 5 more minutes. Serves 6.
Cut 36 large marshmallows in half.
Combine all ingredients except marshmallows and mix.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet.
Bake at 350°
for 8 minutes.
Put marshmallows on center of cookies and bake 2 minutes longer.
Cool and frost if desired.
Make Jell-O according to package directions; let set. Whisk. Add can of crushed pineapple and marshmallows.
Whip the cream. Add to Jell-O mixture. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Stir together and cook in crock-pot or oven for 4 hours at 275°.
Serve over rice or noodles.
Mix together all ingredients.
Makes about 3/4 cup.
Sift flour and measure out 3 cups.
Scald milk in small saucepan.
Remove from heat.
Stir in sugar, salt and shortening. Cool until lukewarm.
Pour water into bowl; sprinkle yeast in and stir until dissolved.

Add lukewarm mixture and eggs; mix well. Add flour 1/2 cup at a time, until mixture is a soft pliable ball. Sprinkle remaining flour on board and knead mixture until firm. Place in greased bowl and cover with dish towel.
Keep in a warm place and let rise until double in bulk.
Put back on floured board and knead.
Make 3 balls of dough the same size.
Add fruits and nuts at this point.
Make balls into long cones.
Place side by side and braid as hair.
Place in a greased bread pan.
Let rise again for approximately 1 hour.
Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes. Make a glaze of milk and powdered sugar; drizzle over coffee cake while still warm.
Sift flour and measure.
Add salt, baking powder and sift again.
Cream butter or margarine.
Add sugar gradually and cream together until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, then flour alternately with milk.
Add vanilla.
Then melt 1/2 cup butter or margarine in pan or baking dish.
Add brown sugar and smooth over sides and bottom of pan.
Beat eggs well.
Add remaining ingredients, but do not overmix.
Cook on a greased griddle.
Layer in 13 x 9-inch pan, rice, onion, green pepper, pork chops and consomme.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until liquid is cooked away.
Mix eggs, onion and 1/2 package seasoning in blender.
Add to beef and mix well.
Roll in meat balls the size of a large marble. Put in shallow pan and bake until they are cooked through.
Put tomato sauce in pan with the other half of seasoning; heat.
As the meat balls are cooked, put them in tomato sauce and cook as long as you want to cook down the sauce.
Combine all ingredients except bread crumbs. Spoon into a greased baking dish. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serves 4 to 6.
Cook zucchini in boiling water.
Brown hamburger and onion. Add seasonings, rice and soup.
Drain zucchini well.
In large casserole place 1/2 of the zucchini, 1/2 meat, 1/2 cottage cheese, 1/2 shredded cheese.
Repeat layers.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Combine the flour, sugar and almonds in a food processor.
Cut in the butter.
Turn the mixture onto a pastry board and quickly knead into a smooth ball.
Refrigerate for 1 hour.
Thaw bread dough.
Let rise for about one hour (follow package instructions).
Form and cut dough into disks of about 2-inches in diameter and 2-inches thick.
Grease your fingertips with the olive oil.
Press each dough piece into 1/2-inch thick disks.
Place dough disks in a lightly greased baking sheet about 2-inches apart. Set aside in a warm place.
Mix lamb (or beef), onion, green pepper, tomato, tomato sauce, Tahini, spice and salt.
Spread one to two tablespoons of the meat mixture on the dough disks.
Bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes or until dough is golden brown.
Let cool for few minutes then transfer to a platter.
Serve warm or cold.
Mix cereal, raisins, brown sugar and milk well and let stand for 1 hour or longer.
Then add the flour and baking powder.
Put in a small, greased loaf pan.
Bake at 400° for 1 hour or less, until done.
When cool, refrigerate.
Doubles well.
In a small bowl, stir together brown sugar, sour cream and the pecans and set aside.
To the bananas, add egg, sugar and oil. Stir until well blended.
Add Bisquick, stirring just until moistened.
Cream butter, oil and sugars.
Add eggs, then dry ingredients. Mix well.

recipes.t: Hot Or Cold Baked Potato Salad
d: Bake potatoes on greased cookie sheet at 425° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Stir occasionally while baking so they don't stick.
Add all other ingredients in bowl and stir together.
Serve warm or cold.
Makes 6 servings.
Pour butter over single layer of fish in a 10-inch Corning Ware or any microwavable dish.
Pour lemon juice over fish. Sprinkle with parsley and all of the Ritz cracker crumbs.
Cover loosely with plastic wrap.
Microwave 5 minutes on High.
Rotate dish and cook 6 more minutes on High.
Smooth beans on large plate.
Mix sour cream and taco seasoning together.
Add additional seasoning to your taste, mild or strong.
Layer all over beans.
Add lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, all by layering.
(Kids love this dip.)
Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.
Stir in lemonade concentrate.
Add cold water and cranberry juice.
Place in large punch bowl with two trays of ice cubes or a molded ice ring.
Pour punch over ice.
Slowly pour in chilled ginger ale.
Makes 25 servings.
Brown onions and celery.
Add ground turkey and brown.
Add salt, pepper, chili powder, soups and water.
Add chow mein noodles.
Sprinkle remaining noodles on top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Bring water and salt to boil in large Dutch oven; stir in macaroni.
Return to a rapid boil and cook 8 to 10 minutes.
Drain. Rinse in cold water.
Drain.
Combine macaroni, soup, mayonnaise, cheese and mushrooms.
Add pimentos.
Spoon into a lightly greased 2-quart casserole dish.
Combine cracker crumbs and butter. Sprinkle evenly over macaroni mixture.
Bake at 300° for 30 minutes.
Yield:
6 to 8 servings.
Combine first 6 ingredients. Lightly beat eggs, sugar and oil. Add mixture to dry mixture. Fold in zucchini, vanilla and walnuts. Bake at 350° for 1 hour in greased loaf pan. Check with toothpick.
Saute mushrooms and onions in shortening.
Mix all in bowl with whisk; reserve 2 ounces of the cheese.
Pour into greased 9 or 10-inch pie plate; bake in 425° oven for 25 minutes.
Remove from oven and spread remaining cheese on top; bake 5 minutes more.
In a bowl, combine milk and lemon juice; mix well. Stir in the pineapple, cranberry sauce,
banana, marshmallows, and pecans. Fold in Cool Whip. Spoon into a 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Freeze overnight. Cut into squares. Makes 12-16 servings.
Mix brown sugar and flour together; add water.
Bring to a boil and cook until thickened.
Add margarine.
Serve over plain cake, hot.
Cut 1 large steak in cubes and flour. Brown in oil. Add onion and garlic; brown slightly. Add mushrooms, soup and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer until done; cool 20 minutes.
Add about 1/4 cup sour cream. Serve on noodles. Serves 4.
In large saucepan, bring liquid to boiling.
Stir in gelatin to dissolve.
Remove from heat; stir in limeade concentrate and rum.
Using wire whisk or electric mixer, blend in mayonnaise. Chill until thickened, but not set.
Fold in pineapple, whipped cream and bananas.
Spoon into 12-cup fluted tube pan.
Chill until firm.
Makes 10 to 12 servings.
Recipe may be halved for 6-cup fluted tube pan.
*(You can use hash browns instead of O'Brien potatoes, but add 1/2 cup of minced onion.)
Heat oven to 400°.
Mix all ingredients well and spread in 9 x 12-inch pan.
Bake 10 minutes; cool.
Cut into 1 x 2-inch squares. Refrigerate 1 hour and enjoy!
Mix milk, margarine, sugar and cocoa.
Bring to a boil for 1 minute.
Remove from heat and add oats, peanut butter, vanilla and pecans.
Mix well.
Drop by teaspoons on buttered wax paper. Cool.
Stir constantly over boiling water until thickened,about 8 minutes. Cool. Whip 1 cup cream. Pour cooled custard mixture into whipped cream. Pour into meringue pie shell.
Be sure all pockets of meringue are filled. Let stand in refrigerator several hours. Serve with fresh strawberries or any seasonable fruit.
Saute onions with butter and margarine.
Put 1/2 into bottom of dish.
Layer macaroni, cheese and potatoes (2 layers).
Top with rest of onion mix.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
Mix everything together.
Chill for several hours or overnight. Roll out dough into a thin rectangle.
Spread jar of mincemeat over 1/2 rectangle.
Add nuts, if desired.
Roll up like a jelly roll. Make slits across top of roll.
Bake on a cookie sheet for 25 minutes at 350°; then for 25 minutes at 325°.
Boil potatoes or use sliced or diced leftovers.
Put in casserole dish.
Mix remaining ingredients and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
Boil 2 sticks cinnamon, cloves and 2 cups apple cider.
Boil spices for 15 minutes.
Strain spices and add 1/2 can frozen orange juice to remaining hot cider and serve.

recipes.t: Chicken In Carrot And Mushroom Sauce
d: Brown chicken in oil and remove from pan.
Add mushrooms and carrots and cook until tender.
Mix in soup and sherry, scraping bottom of pan.
Put chicken back into pan and simmer 15 minutes or until tender.
Fry ground sirloin, 1 onion, 1 stalk celery and chili powder in skillet until almost done.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Then mix in crock-pot with rest of ingredients.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Saute onions, bell pepper, garlic and parsley in butter until tender.
Add crabmeat and saute for approximately 20 minutes.
Soak bread in milk.
Add this to crab mixture and stir.
Cut off heat and add beaten eggs.
Salt and pepper to taste and stir.
Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish and top with bread crumbs.
Bake for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350°. Heat mushroom soup and water on stove until warm. Add chicken breasts; bake 30 minutes on each side.
In a saucepan, simmer tomatoes, onion, bay leaf, sugar and 1/2 teaspoon salt for 10 minutes.
Put through food mill and set aside.
In same saucepan, melt butter; stir in flour and 1/4 teaspoon salt.
Add milk.
Cook and stir until thickened.
Slowly stir in tomato mixture.

recipes.t: Raisin, Apple Or Oat Bran Muffins
d: Spray muffin tins or use paper liners.
Mix first 6 ingredients in large bowl.
Mix other ingredients together except yogurt.
Mix with oat mixture.
Stir in yogurt.
Spoon into muffin pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Makes 12.
Spread half of lettuce in 2-quart casserole.
Add celery, onions, green pepper and peas as second layer.
Use remaining lettuce as top layer. Mix mayonnaise with sugar and spread over top.
Refrigerate overnight.
Before serving, fry 1/2 pound of bacon very crisp and crumble; sprinkle over top of salad.
Sift sugar, flour, baking powder and salt into a bowl.
Stir in dates and nuts.
Add eggs, mix thoroughly.
Spread in greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1 inch pan.
Bake at 375 degrees for about 20 minutes.
Cut into squares while warm.
Roll in confectioners sugar.
Yield:
6 dozen.
Combine ingredients in large bowl.
Press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Top with 2 cups corn flake crumbs, which have been mixed with 1 stick melted margarine.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Place half the mushrooms in a 13 x 9 inch baking pan.
Dip chicken into beaten eggs and roll in bread crumbs.
In skillet, melt butter over medium heat.
Brown both sides of chicken in skillet.
Place chicken on top of mushrooms.
Arrange remaining mushrooms on chicken and top with cheese.
Add chicken broth to pan.
Bake at 350° for 30-35 minutes.
Serve chicken over hot cooked rice or noodles with chopped fresh parsley.
Boil macaroni and eggs until done. Pour into bowl to cool; add eggs, onion, tomato and cucumber.
Mix.
Beat egg yolks and 2 tablespoons Kahlua in a 3-quart microwave-safe dish. Add 1/4 cup sugar.
Beat until slightly thickened and color lightens. Cook egg yolk mixture on Medium-high power 3 to 4 minutes until thickened. Stir every 45 seconds. Set dish in a bowl of cold water.
Beat until thick, 3 to 4 minutes.
Using an electric mixer, cream butter.	Gradually add brown sugar, mixing well. Mix in eggs. Combine flour, baking powder, and salt.
Add flour mixture gradually, blending until smooth.	Add vanilla flavoring.	Spread batter into a greased 9 inch x 13 inch pan.
Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 25 minutes, or until lightly browned. Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle with powdered sugar. Cut into bars and enjoy.
Combine flour and cinnamon in a small bowl.
Beat together butter, sugars and egg.
Gradually beat in flour mixture.
Stir in oats and half of chocolate chips and nuts.
Spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake in a 350° oven for 22 to 28 minutes. Immediately sprinkle with remaining chocolate chips.
Let stand 5 minutes or until chips are glassy and sprinkle with remaining nuts.
Combine eggs and milk; stir in crumbs, onion, parsley, salt, sage and 1/2 teaspoon pepper.
Add beef; mix well.
Pat into a 5 1/2 cup ring mold; unmold in a shallow baking pan.
Bake in a 350° oven for 50 minutes.
Spoon off excess fat.
Combine catsup, sugar and mustard; spread over meat.
Return to oven for 10 minutes. Serves approximately 6.
Combine all solid ingredients in greased loaf pan.
Cover with liquid and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Brown meat.
Chop pepper and onion; add to meat and cook until tender.
Add chili powder, black pepper and salt.
Add soup and corn; simmer 15 minutes.
Prepare crumb crust (1 1/2 cups crumbs and 1/4 cup melted butter).
Bake 10 minutes at 350°.
Dissolve Jell-O in water.
Chill slightly.
Cream together cheese, sugar and vanilla.
Beat bananas into cream cheese until fluffy.
Blend in Jell-O.
Chill until thick, stirring occasionally.
Mix cracker crumbs and butter.
Press half into bottom of 12 x 7-inch dish.
When Jell-O mixture is partially set, whip milk.
Add lemon juice.
Beat until stiff.
Beat Jell-O mixture slightly and fold into whipped milk.
Pour in dish. Sprinkle with remaining crumbs.
Chill.
Garnish with maraschino cherries and banana slices.
Combine sugar, milk, marshmallows, butter and salt on medium heat.
Leave until it starts to boil.
Take off heat.
Stir in chocolate bits and vanilla until all blended.
Pour into buttered pan.
Finally cut into your favorite size bites.
Combine first 5 ingredients in a mixing bowl; season with salt and pepper.
Mix thoroughly.
This spread can be used on your favorite bread, rolls or crackers.
Melt butter;
add Eagle
Brand
milk
and chips over low heat until chips are melted.
Pour into cooled, buttered pan or platter immediately.
Let cool
for 2 hours and cut into 2-inch squares. Store in
tightly
closed container to prevent drying out.
Beat eggs.
Add milk, salt and mustard.
Add bread and stir. Add cheese and sausage.
Mix well and pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish and refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes. Allow to stand a few minutes before cutting into squares and serving.
Parboil green peppers.
Stuff peppers with vegetable mixture. Place in baking dish and pour tomato soup and vinegar over peppers.
Bake about 1 hour.
Dice and fry bacon until crisp.
Add to drippings, diced apple, diced green pepper and diced onion.
Saute until tender. Add 2 large cans of Hunt's small red beans (drain before adding). Add 1 large can of chopped up tomatoes.
Add curry powder and brown sugar.
Mix together.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover; set overnight.
Before serving, bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Cook broccoli and rice as usual.
Set aside.
Saute celery and onions in butter.
Melt Cheez Whiz and soup.
Mix together and spoon in casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Pour pears into pan (with juice).
Pour in apple pie filling. Spread evenly.
Pour in cake mix and sprinkle ginger.
Cover top with butter.
Cover butter with pecans.
Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.
Heat first 3 ingredients.
Place remaining ingredients in jar. Pour liquid into jars and close tightly.
Refrigerate for 3 weeks.
This makes one pie.
Mix together milk and cream cheese. Fold in Cool Whip.
Pour into pie shell.
Put margarine and coconut in skillet and lightly brown.
Mix in 2 cups of nuts. Sprinkle on top of pie mixture. Melt caramel in microwave and drizzle all over pies. Makes 3 pies.
Cut up and peel squash.
Cut up 2 apples.
Mix and pour over oleo, brown sugar, mace and salt.
Bake until done.
In a small bowl, mix cottage cheese with sweetener and cinnamon.
Spread on toast.
Sprinkle with coconut.
Broil for 2 to 3 minutes or until bubbly.
Make jello as usual according to the directions on the box.
Empty spaghetti sauce mix into saucepan; add tomato paste, tomato sauce and water.
Heat, stirring until well blended.
Remove from heat.
Beat eggs in a large bowl and add Ricotta or cottage cheese, spinach, salt and 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese.
Lightly grease bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish.
Cover with a little sauce.
Layer noodles, 1/2 of cheese/spinach mixture, 1/2 of Mozzarella and 1/2 of tomato sauce mixture.
Repeat layers.
Sprinkle with 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese.
Cover dish with lightly greased foil and bake in preheated 350° oven for 60 minutes or until noodles are tender. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.
Serves 8.
Combine pudding mix with 3 cups milk.
Fold in Cool Whip. Layer in a casserole dish (9 x 13-inch) with a layer of graham crackers.
Top this layer with pudding mix.
Continue layering crackers and pudding mix, ending with a layer of crackers.
Mix together and blend well butter, brown sugar, white sugar and eggs.
Add salt, baking soda, vanilla, flour, dates and nuts. Drop by teaspoon on buttered baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen.
Grate squash and onion on large section of grater.
Mix all other ingredients, except margarine, in a 375° oven.
Place a slightly greased iron skillet or casserole dish in oven until almost smoking hot.
(It is very important to do it this way or it will not brown properly.)
Remove from oven and pour melted margarine over top.
Cook until brown, (375° for 45 minutes to 1 hour).
Mix all fruits together.
Cover and chill for 1 hour.
Eat and enjoy.
Mix all ingredients together except sugar and cheese.
Mix cheese and sugar together and sprinkle over salad.
When ready to serve, toss with mayonnaise.
Mix cake according to directions on box.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Combine brown sugar and undrained pineapple.
Spread on warm cake.
Refrigerate until cool.
Cook spaghetti and drain.
In large bowl, combine all ingredients.
Pour salad dressing over and mix just before serving.
Mix salt, zucchini and onion.
Let stand overnight.
Rinse off salt; drain well and add remaining ingredients.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add dash of green food coloring, then seal in jar.
Combine sugar, nutmeg, cinnamon and salt.
Wash, core and slice apples in 1/2-inch slices.
Heat butter in heavy skillet.
Add apple rings and one half the sugar mixture; cook about 3 minutes. Turn, sprinkle with remainder of sugar mixture and continue cooking until apples are almost transparent.
Serve hot; makes 6 servings.
Fry hamburg; add the beans and taco seasoning.
Put in 8 x 8-inch frypan and top with sour cream and cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serve with taco chips.
Combine cake mix, salad dressing, eggs, water and cinnamon, mixing at medium speed on electric mixer until well blended.
Stir in carrots and walnuts.
Pour into greased 13 x 9 inch baking pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool and frost with cream cheese frosting.
Makes 10 - 12 servings.
Brown chicken in small amount of oil.
Season with pinch of rosemary, salt and pepper.
Drain!
Buy Pepperidge Farm puff pastry, 2 sheets per package, and thaw.
Cut in quarters.
Take 1 quarter, roll out a little to cover chicken breast.
Set breast in center (drain on paper towels first).
Sprinkle small amount chopped green onion over top.
Take cream cheese, slice chunks size of butter patty and spread on chicken.
Fold pastry and seal (pinch).
Heat oven to 450°.
Put chicken in and immediately turn to 400°.
Cook until golden brown, about 1/2 hour.
Serve with Mushroom Sauce.
Combine first 3 ingredients.
Press into a 9-inch pie plate. Bake pie crust at 350° for 10 minutes or until lightly browned; cool.
Stir together sweetened condensed milk and lime juice until blended.
Pour into prepared crust.
Top with meringue and bake at 325° for 25 to 28 minutes.
Chill 8 hours.
Blend first five ingredients together until smooth.
Pour into a baked graham cracker crust.
Freeze at least two hours before cutting.
Wrap and store in freezer.
To serve, you may sprinkle some chopped nuts on top if desired.
Dates and nuts may be left out.
Raisins may be added in their place also.
Sprinkle salt and pepper on steak.
Thinly spread mustard on top.
On top of steak, layer the following:
bacon strips, onions and mushrooms.
Roll up steak and pin together with toothpicks. Grease or spray pan.
Sprinkle flour on top of steak for crust. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Split hamburger buns.
Combine tuna, cheese, celery, mayonnaise, catsup and lemon juice.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Divide tuna mixture among 4 buns.
Wrap each sandwich in waxed paper and twist ends of paper.
Cook one at a time 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until rolls are hot.
Put turkey carcass pieces in large kettle and cover with water. Cover kettle and simmer 1 1/2 hours.
Skim surface to remove excess fat.
Add vegetables and salt and simmer 15 minutes.
Add noodles and simmer about 15 minutes.
Serve hot.
Break noodles into small pieces.
Noodles and almonds may be toasted, if desired.
Place noodles, almonds and sunflower seeds in a plastic bag or sealable container.
Combine sugar, vegetable oil, vinegar and Soy sauce
and mix well to make dressing. Combine ingredients immediately prior to serving as it will not keep, the dry ingredients get soggy.
Combine oranges and juice, apricot jello and Knox gelatine in saucepan; heat.
Add cream cheese which has been cut into cubes and mix.
Cool slightly.
Fold in Cool Whip (reserve some Cool Whip for topping).
Place in slightly oiled pan (9 x 12 x 2-inch). Cover with foil and refrigerate.
Cut into squares and top with Cool Whip and orange segments.
Serve on lettuce leaf with sprig of mint or sprig of watercress.
Mix cornmeal with Cajun seasoning.
Dip catfish into mixture of milk, eggs and mustard.
Coat well with cornmeal mixture.
Heat oil.
Drop fish into hot oil and cook until golden brown.
Mix together all ingredients, except soup, and make into meatballs.
Brown on baking sheet, turning over once.
Move meatballs to casserole and add mushroom soup.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour or a little longer.
These freeze very good, so you can double batch and have ready for next batch of company.
Boil sugar, cocoa, butter, cream and milk for 3 minutes.
Add the oats.
Drop by tablespoons on wax paper.
The cocoa may be omitted and add some peanut butter.
Save out 1 cup corn chips and mix remaining chips with other ingredients.
Pour into an 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch lightly greased baking dish.
Bake, uncovered, in a 375° oven for 30 minutes or until hot.
Spread top with 1 cup sour cream, an additional 1/2 cup shredded cheese and circle with reserved corn chips around edge.
Bake an additional 5 minutes longer.
Makes 6 servings.
Mix all ingredients in 1-quart casserole.
Cover tightly and microwave on Medium-high (70%) 4 to 5 minutes, stirring after 2 minutes, until hot.
Serve warm with thin slices French bread or rye crackers, if desired.
Cover large cookie sheet with foil; grease with vegetable shortening.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Boil noodles according to directions.
While they are cooking, mix in a bowl the soup, milk and drained tuna.
Drain cooked noodles.
Add tuna mixture and put into casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.t: Vinegar Sauce For Cut Up Vegetables
d: Bring to a good boil.
Store in gallon glass jar.
Cool and store.
Put over cut up fresh vegetables or bean salad.
Keeps for a long time.
Measure water into large mixer bowl.
Blend well.
Beat 3 minutes at medium speed of mixer. By hand, gradually add remaining flour to form a stiff dough, beating well after each addition. Cover and let rest 15 minutes.
Toss dough over lightly floured surface until no longer sticky.
Knead 1 minute.
Shape.
Scrub cucumber to remove wax.
Grate the unpeeled cucumber and drain very well until almost dry.
Combine with other ingredients. Serve with crackers.
Preheat oven to 450°.
Combine baking mix, milk and cheese to a soft dough.
Drop by the spoonful on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes, or until golden brown.
Mix melted butter or margarine with the garlic powder and brush over warm biscuits before removing from cookie sheet.
Serve warm.
Makes 10 to 12 servings.
Cook macaroni until tender.
Run cold water over macaroni and let cool.
Add green pepper, onion and celery seed.
Make dressing with mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar.
Stir until mayonnaise is smooth.
Pour over macaroni and mix well.
If macaroni is dry, make more dressing.
Best if refrigerated.
Mix the cream cheese, 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 tablespoon half and half.
Whisk until smooth.
Stir in Cool Whip and spread on bottom of crust.
Pour 1 cup of half and half into bowl.
Add pudding mix.
Blend well.
Let stand 3 minutes.
Stir in pumpkin and spices.
Mix well.
Spread over cream cheese layer. Refrigerate at least 2 hours.
Garnish with additional Cool Whip and nuts.
In 1 1/2-quart saucepan, combine soup and salsa.
Cook over low heat for 5 minutes, stirring often.
Serve over tortilla chips.
Top with tomatoes, green onions, olives and pepper.
Makes 6 servings.
Preparation Time: 10 minutes.
Soak bread almost two days old in milk until soft.
Press out all the moisture and add an equal amount of quickly cooked hoe cakes or corn bread.
Place in saucepan with onion, butter and bacon.
Cook 10 minutes without browning.
When cold, season with salt and pepper, celery seed and minced parsley.
Use sage and thyme and the yolk of 1 egg.
Unroll roll mix and press flatly onto cookie sheet.
Bake according to package directions.
Mix together cream cheese, salad dressing and dill weed in mixing bowl until smooth.
Spread onto top of cooled roll mix.
Cut into squares.
Place assorted vegetables on top.
Sprinkle cheese over top of vegetables.
Place olive, if desired, on top of each pizza square.
Keep refrigerated until use.
Recipe can be easily doubled.
Serves 12 to 16.
In a large pan (frying pan), fry cut up bacon until crisp. Drain off grease.
Pour in wine and simmer.
Meanwhile, as bacon is simmering, cook the spaghetti.
Then mix eggs and cheese together in a mixing bowl.
When spaghetti is ready, drain and return to pan.
Add the cheese and egg mixture, covering the spaghetti.
Mix thoroughly.
Finally, add wine and bacon mixture; mix thoroughly.
Serve immediately.
Serves 4.

Chop all (except pastry squares and egg) ingredients and stir fry. Drain off any grease. Fill center of pastry squares; fold up bottom and sides then roll up; seal with a beaten egg. Fry in hot corn oil.
*Stewed tomatoes or diced are really the best.
Cream sugar and shortening.
Beat in eggs, water and vanilla. Combine flour, baking powder, soda and salt; add to creamed mixture.
Add nuts.
Roll out on floured board; cut.
Sprinkle on decorative sugars, if desired.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 375°. Cookies should be golden brown.
Cool.
Frost if desired.
Melt butter in saucepan.
Blend in flour.
Stir in chicken broth.
Cook until mixture begins to thicken, stirring constantly. Add half and half, parsley, crab meat, chives, sherry, Old Bay and salt.
Mix well.
Heat just to serving temperature.
Do not boil.
Combine salad ingredients in a serving bowl.
Toss with desired amount of dressing and serve.
Combine fruit, tapioca and grape juice in a crock-pot.
Add enough water to cover (about 3 cups).
Cover and cook on low setting for 8 or 10 hours.
Before serving, stir in remaining ingredients.
Serve warm or cold as a soup or dessert.
Makes 10 to 12 servings (about 2 1/2 quarts).
Brown hamburger, bell pepper and onion. Cook and drain macaroni. Mix all together real good. Put in casserole dish. Place in oven for about 15 to 20 minutes until cheese is real bubbly.
Buy a small ham (Bryan, Gooch), about 2 to 3 pounds.
I usually buy a ham and serve with rice salad.
A couple of days later, take leftover ham and make a ham salad and if I have even more, I make a ham and cheese pie (recipe included in cookbook).
Place one cake layer or one-half of 9 x 13-inch cake in bottom of a 1 gallon or larger punch bowl.
(I use Tupperware cake box because I make 2 round layers.)
Cover with 1/2 of instant vanilla pudding, 1/2 can cherry pie filling, 1/2 can of fruit cocktail, 1/2 pineapple and coconut and 1/2 of the Cool Whip.
Sprinkle with 1/2 cup nuts.
Boil the Chicken, then remove all bones and skin.
Tear meat into chunks.
For 10 minutes cook broccoli, onion and celery.
Drain; put in a baking dish.
Add cream of mushroom soup, cooked rice, Cheez Whiz and jalapeno Cheez Whiz.
Mix together and bake for 35 minutes in a 350° oven.
Then mix stuffing with butter and spread over the top.
Bake another 5 to 10 minutes until the top is a light golden brown.
Sift
dry
ingredients	together
in
a small bowl.
In another
bowl, beat egg.
Add cooled margarine, molasses, milk and wheat germ.
Add dry ingredients.	Drop by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart
on
lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Put into casserole dish in layers:
soup diluted with 3/4 cup water, noodles, chicken and celery.
Garnish with mandarin oranges and cashew nuts.
(Can put cashews throughout if desired.)
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
Serves 6 (six times the amount serves 40).
Combine first 5 ingredients in large bowl.
Combine next 3 ingredients in a cup and add to dry ingredients.
Work in 9 cups white flour.
Place on floured board and knead for 8 to 10 minutes.
Place in greased container and let raise to double the size.
Grease pizza pan; melt almond bark (all but one square) and chocolate chips on low heat until melted.
Take off heat and add marshmallows, Rice Krispies and nuts.
Pour into pizza pan, spread out to sides and sprinkle with coconut.
Cut cherries in half and arrange on top.
Melt one square of almond bark and drizzle over top.
Looks like pizza!
Cut in small wedges and serve.
Grind bologna, cream cheese and Colby cheese through a food grinder alternately.
In a bowl mix ground-up mixture, Mozzarella cheese, oregano and pizza sauce.
Spread on open face buns.
Place face up in oven or under broiler and heat until bubbly.
Cook and drain the peas.
Add water chestnuts, mushroom soup and pimentos, chopped fine.
Saute celery, onions and green pepper in oleo.
Add this mixture to the pea mixture.
Pour into two greased casserole dishes.
Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350°.
Put crushed potato chips on top and heat.

Prepare pie crust according to package directions for a filled, one-crust pie, using 9-inch pie pan or 9-inch quiche pan. Heat oven to 400°. Layer Mozzarella and Cheddar cheese in pie crust lined pan.
Top with pepperoni and mushrooms.
Drain 1/2 the water of green beans, put the rest of the water and beans into a medium saucepan.
Add the can of soup.
Cook over medium heat (about 10 minutes).
Add cheese to desired taste. Cook until cheese makes a creamy sauce over the green beans.
Cook onions until tender.
Fry bacon until crisp.
Add 2 tablespoons bacon drippings to softened cream cheese.
Add onion and crumbled bacon.
Wash mushrooms; remove stems.
Stuff mushrooms with cream cheese mixture.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Place chicken on grill or rack of broiler pan.
Brush with half of sauce.
Grill or broil about 10 minutes, turn and brush remaining sauce and broil or grill for 10 minutes or until tender. Serves 4.

recipes.t: Couscous With Chickpeas And Feta Cheese
d: In medium saucepan, bring broth to boil.
Stir in couscous. Remove from heat; cover and let stand for 5 minutes.
Transfer couscous to large bowl and fluff with fork.
Let stand 5 minutes; fluff again. mix in chickpeas, scallions, cheese and olives.
Pour dressing over mixture and toss lightly with fork.
Serve on bed of lettuce.
Serves 6. Enjoy.
Mix mayonnaise, sugar, and vinegar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Boil octopus slowly 1 1/2 to 2 hours until tender when pierced. Rinse off black covering.
Cut up octopus into bite size pieces. Cut up both cheeses into bite size pieces.
Toss all ingredients together and place in casserole dish.
Season to taste.
Pour small amount of oil over all.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted.
Mix the ground beef with the salt, pepper and parsley.
Shape mixture into 8 patties, 4-inch diameter.

On each of 4 patties, arrange an onion ring, a tomato slice and a slice of cheese. Cover with the other 4 patties and press edges together to seal. Broil on both sides for a total of about 20 minutes.

Wash pheasant well. Salt and pepper. Line Dutch oven with tin foil and place bird in center. In a bowl, mix wine, marmalade, cinnamon and nutmeg. Pour over bird. Cut butter in squares and put on and around bird. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Baste every 20 minutes. Tighten foil after each basting.
Clean mushrooms with dampened paper towels and remove stems. Pour some oil in a bowl.
With fingers, wipe oil on outside of each mushroom cap.
Add a drop of oil to the center of the inside.
Chop stems fine and combine them in a bowl with 1/2 cup bread crumbs and cheese; toss together.
Add onion, chervil (or tarragon), salt and dash of pepper.
Toss again.
Add milk or stock.
Lightly mix. Mixture should be moist enough to hold together.
Fry bacon until crisp. Drain on paper towels. Crumble and set aside.
Place onion rings, garlic powder, mustard, brown sugar and vinegar in a large skillet. Cover and cook 20 minutes over medium heat. Combine beans in 3-quart casserole.
Stir in bacon and onion mixture, blending ingredients.
Bake, covered, at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 10.
Cook and drain spaghetti.
Partially cool.
Add margarine and stir.
Add Salad Supreme and stir.
Marinate overnight.
Add cucumber, tomatoes and salad dressing.
Stir and ready to serve.
Add beef cubes to marinade, turning to coat.
Refrigerate 24 to	36
hours
to
give
marinade time to tenderize the beef; turn the
meat occasionally.
Fill skewers, alternating meat cubes with
mushroom caps or other kabobs tidbits of your choice.
Place skewers
4	to
inches from the heat.
Broil about 25
minutes, turning
frequently and basting often with marinade.
About last 5 minutes of cooking, add small tomatoes to ends of skewers.
Put first 4 ingredients into greased 9 or 10-inch round or square pan and mix.
Next 4 ingredients beat until smooth with electric mixer and then beat for 1 minute.
Put this into the dish and mix with other ingredients.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
Let sit for 10 minutes or until golden brown.
In large bowl, combine brown sugar and rum; mix until combined.
Add pineapple; toss gently to combine.
Store in refrigerator.
Makes 4 cups.
Melt butter in a large, heavy saucepan; blend in flour.
Cook over low heat until bubbly, stirring constantly.
Gradually add broth and milk; cook until thickened, stirring constantly.
Stir in chicken, peas and carrots and seasonings; heat.
Bring sugar and water to boil. Add cinnamon candy. Stir until it melts. Pour over cored apples. Bake at 400° for 40 minutes. Dip syrup over apples when finished.
Mix cream cheese with the juice of the fish.
Add the other ingredients.
Spread on the rusks.
Top with tomato slice and slice of processed cheese.
Bake until cheese melts, about 25 minutes at 300°.
Mix the shortening, butter, sugars, eggs and vanilla; then mix dry ingredients with shortening mixture.
Add raisins.
Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Cool slightly before removing from pan.
Mix cornbread as directed.
Pour batter into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Heat chili with 1/4 cup water to simmering point, spoon over cornbread batter, sprinkle grated cheese and minced onion over chili.
Bake in 425° oven 15 to 18 minutes.
Cornbread will rise above chili mixture.
Serve hot; makes 4 generous servings.
Cover and cook on high for 1 hour.
Lower heat and cook all day until thick and dark.
Stir occasionally.
Place in small jars; cool and freeze.
Pour vegetable oil at least 2-inches deep into wide skillet. Heat to 375°.
Beat the eggs with wire whisk; blend in 1/2 cup water.
Sprinkle the cake flour evenly over the liquid.
Stir in flour with whisk only until moist and large lumps disappear.
Mix the shrimp, mixed vegetables and onion into flour mixture.
Drop by spoonfuls into hot oil.
Fry until lightly golden.
Blend egg with cream cheese and Blue cheese.
Trim crust from bread slices; roll each slice lightly with a rolling pin.
Spread with cheese mixture.
Cut asparagus stalks length of bread; place on edge of bread.
Roll as for jelly roll; brush with margarine. Place in covered plastic container and freeze.
Remove from freezer; cut each roll crosswise in 1 1/2-inch lengths.
Place on a greased cookie sheet and bake at 325° for 9 to 11 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve hot.
Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain.
Toss macaroni with Dressing.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cover; chill. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese over each serving. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
Combine chili and Ro-Tel in medium saucepan.
Heat until hot, stirring occasionally.
Pour into shallow, 1 1/2-quart bowl. Arrange lettuce along outside edge to form a circle.
Continue to arrange remaining ingredients in a circular pattern in the order listed.
Serve with tortilla chips.
Mix cream cheese, grated onion, Worcestershire sauce, mayonnaise, lemon juice and garlic salt well.
Spread on bottom of serving dish.
Refrigerate for 15 minutes.
In small bowl, mix chili sauce, ketchup, horseradish sauce and lemon juice.
Mix well.
Add to chilled dish.
Cover with backfin crabmeat and chill at least 1/2 hour.
Shape ground beef into patties.
Place each patty on a square of foil.
Top with pineapple ring. Fill hole with chili sauce or barbecue sauce. Wrap in foil.
Broil in oven or over charcoal until done. Serve on a bun.
Melt butter in skillet.
Brown chicken in butter, remove from skillet and set aside.
Saute onion and peppers in butter until semi-tender and remove from skillet.
Return chicken to skillet, add onions and peppers, cover and simmer until chicken is done. Add cheese to skillet, cover and continue to simmer just long enough to melt cheese.
May be served with Mexican-style rice.

Peel baked potatoes or not. Mash with a fork. Melt butter in a Dutch oven pan over medium heat. Add onion and saute until tender. Add flour, stirring until smooth. Stir in potatoes, half and half, milk, salt and pepper. Cook over low heat until thoroughly heated. Top each bowl with cheese and bacon.
Wash the kumquats in warm water; drain and dry.
Gently prick each kumquat with a skewer in 2 or 3 places.
Combine the water and sugar in a saucepan (not aluminum).
Bring to a boil and add the kumquats.
Cook over low heat for 20 minutes, or until syrup is thick and clear.
Stir in the ginger and lime juice.
Pack in sterile jars and seal.
Makes about 3 pints.

recipes.t: Mom'S Best Pecan Pie(Ethel Greenwood Chadwick)
d: Cream butter, sugar and flour.
Add eggs.
Add syrup, salt, vanilla and nuts. Bake in 9-inch pie shell for 50 to 60 minutes at 350°.
Brown ground beef and onions; slightly drain.
In the same skillet, add 2 tablespoons cooking oil.
Coat zucchini in flour, salt and pepper.
Brown lightly on each side.
Drain on paper towel.
Use 2-quart casserole dish and alternate sliced zucchini, sliced tomatoes and hamburger.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, uncovered.
Take out and sprinkle cheeses on top and bake 10 minutes longer or until cheeses melt.
In a large mixer bowl combine 2 1/2 cups flour, yeast, sugar and salt; mix well.
In a saucepan heat milk, water and butter until warm (120° to 130°).
Add to flour mixture, add eggs.
Blend on low until moistened.
Beat for 3 minutes at medium speed.
By hand, stir in raisins and enough of the remaining flour to make a firm dough.
Knead on floured surface for 5 to 8 minutes.
Place in a greased bowl and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour.
Punch down dough and divide into 2 parts.
Mix brown sugar, white sugar, butter and lard or margarine together.
Add eggs and vanilla and mix well.
Sift salt, flour, soda and cream of tartar together, then add.
Mix well.
Form into loaves (wrapped in wax paper) and refrigerate overnite.
Chocolate bits and/or nutmeats may be added, if desired.
Melt peanut butter and margarine in bowl over hot water or in microwave.
Add remaining ingredients.
Stir until blended. Spread into greased and floured 9x13 pan.
Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 mins.
Cool completely.
Add chocolate frosting if desired.
Cut into squares.
Mix cake by directions on box using half the batter in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°.
Melt in saucepan, caramels, butter and milk.
Pour over cake.
Spread the chocolate chips and pecans on top of this.
Pour the remaining cake batter over this and bake 15 to 20 minutes.
Mix well.
Keep in refrigerator until ready to serve.
Cook the beets until tender.
Slip off skins.
Combine vinegar, water, sugar, spices and salt.
Bring to a boil and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the beets and simmer 5 minutes longer. Pack the beets into (hot) sterilized jars.
If not enough liquid to cover beets, add hot vinegar.
Seal immediately.
Makes about 4 quarts.
Core tomatoes and apples.
Put in food chopper.
Add ingredients.
Bring to boil and boil for 5 minutes.
Immediately put in jars.
Ready for pie.
Mix first three ingredients.
Let come to a boil.
Boil hard for three minutes.
Have Ritz crackers placed on a cookie sheet. Pour mixture over crackers.
Take a spoon and make sure mixture is spread well on crackers.
Put chopped nuts on top of crackers. (Nuts are to be chopped fine.) Put in a 300° oven and bake 10 minutes (preheat oven).
Remove from oven and place on aluminum foil until cool.
Cook chicken pieces in margarine at medium temperature.
When chicken pieces are browned, add picante sauce and water.
Cover and simmer until all moisture has evaporated.
Combine egg, peanut butter and honey in a small saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture starts to bubble.
Remove from heat; add granola and mix well.
Spread in greased 8-inch square pan.
Chill until firm.
Cook noodles as directed on package; drain.
Cook vegetables as directed; drain.
Combine all ingredients and chill several hours.
Makes a large salad.
Combine sweet potatoes, granulated sugar, eggs, vanilla, milk and 1/2 cup butter.
Place in greased casserole.
Combine brown sugar, flour, 1/3 cup butter and nuts.
Sprinkle over top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
In a 5-quart stockpot cook cabbage in boiling water until tender.
Add carrots, potatoes and onion.
Cook until tender.
Add hot dogs and add pepper.
Cook until hot dogs are done.
Salt to taste.
Eat with cornbread.
Coarsely grind orange in processor. Transfer to heavy saucepan. Add berries, 1 1/2 cups sugar and cornstarch.
Boil over medium-high heat until thick, stirring constantly, for about 3 minutes. Cool completely.
Bring vinegar, sugar and chili sauce to a boil.
Mix the other ingredients together and pour the hot mixture over it (do not use the juice from the vegetables).
lst Layer:
Mix together pretzels, pecans, butter and granulated sugar.
Place in a 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan and bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.
Mix chocolate squares and margarine in a glass bowl in microwave (about 1 1/2 minutes on high setting).
Stir mixture until smooth.
Add sugar, eggs and vanilla, blending thoroughly. Stir in dry ingredients, mixing well.
Add nuts.
Spread brownie mixture in greased 8 or 9-inch round cake pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Cool.
Cut into 8 pie shaped wedges.
Serve topped with hot fudge sauce.
Grease cookie sheet and line with wax paper.
Grease wax paper.
Pour mixture on pan evenly.
Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Bake 15 minutes at 375°.
Sprinkle powdered sugar on towel and dump cooked mixture.
Peel off wax paper.
Roll in towel long way. Cool for 1 1/2 hours.
Cut fish into fillets.
Place fish in single layer in cake pan.
Brush both sides of fish with equal parts of soy sauce and liquid smoke.
Sprinkle with garlic salt, paprika, salt and pepper.
Bake at 375° until desired doneness.
Mix together ingredients.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
Will fall after rising.
Cut corn from cob; set aside.
In 8-inch skillet, cook bacon until crisp; remove and crumble, reserving drippings.
Add corn, milk, sugar, salt and pepper to reserved drippings. Cover and cook 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In screw top jar shake together light cream and flour until combined, stir into corn mixture.
Add butter or margarine, cook, stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly.
Garnish with crumbled bacon.
Lightly grease 8 x 8 casserole dish.
Combine rice, cheese, tuna, onion, parsley, and season-all salt.
Stir in eggs and milk. Mix thoroughly.
Pour into casserole dish, and bake at 375 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes, or until set and slightly browned on top.
Serve with tangy butter sauce.
Boil chicken pieces until tender.
Remove from bone and cut into bite size pieces.
Cover bottom of oblong dish with chicken. Crumble crackers over chicken.
Boil chicken breasts.
Set aside broth.
Cut chicken into bite size pieces.
Mix celery and chicken soups and sour cream together.
Add chicken to mixture.
Pour in an 8 x 12-inch dish. Cover the top with stuffing mix.
Spoon some broth over the stuffing mix.
Bake in oven at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown on top.
Cook noodles by package directions.
Serve over noodles and enjoy.
Beat egg whites until thick.
Add sugar slowly.
Fold all ingredients together.
Spoon on 2 cookie sheets.
Cover with foil. Turn oven on to 350°, then turn off when you put cookies in. Peel cookies off the next morning!
After slicing all vegetables, place them in a bowl and pour Zesty Italian dressing over the vegetables.
Let the mixture chill for an hour.
Mix together cream cheese, egg, cheese and soup mix.
Grate potatoes into bowl of water.
Place potatoes (by handfuls) on a clean dish towel and squeeze out water.
Immediately mix potatoes, cheese mixture, salt and pepper.
Add about 2 heaping tablespoons sour cream (don't make mixture too moist).
Fry pancakes in oil in nonstick pan for 3 to 4 minutes on each side.
Drain the juice from the oranges.
Add pineapples and juice and pudding mix.
Stir.
Add sliced bananas.
Chill until ready to serve.
Put tomatoes into a bowl.
Mix olive oil and lemon juice together; stir in herbs and onions.
Pour over tomatoes.
Add shrimp, combining gently.
Check for seasonings and add salt and pepper as desired.
Let stand marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes, then chill.
Serve on lettuce, sprinkle wheat germ on salad.
1st Layer:
Dissolve 2 small packages lime jello in 2 cups boiling water and 1 1/2 cups cold water.
Add crushed pineapple. Let set until firm and add 2nd Layer.
Start cooking slow.
Bring to a rolling boil.
Remove from heat and let stand for 10 minutes.	Stir well.
Pour into jars and seal.
Can be served over cream cheese with crackers.
In a large saucepan, combine potatoes, carrots, onions, celery, parsley, salt and pepper and water to cover vegetables.
Cook until tender, about 20 minutes.
Gradually add milk to flour mix until well blended.
Gradually add to potatoes.
Cook until thickened. Add cheese.
Stir until melted.
Combine all ingredients except ice cream.
Fold in ice cream. Pour into 2 graham cracker crusts.
Freeze until firm.
Garnish with whipped cream and nuts.
Dissolve bouillon cubes in water.
Add all remaining ingredients, except spareribs.
Place ribs in large baking pan. Pour mixture over them.
Let marinate in refrigerator for 24 hours, turning meat a few times.
Place ribs on rack in baking pan and bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.
Mix pudding mix and milk; chill until firm.
Slice cake into 3 layers.
Divide pudding between layers.
May be frosted with lite Cool Whip just before serving.
In a medium bowl, mix molasses with soda until it foams.
Beat in egg and butter. Add water.
Mix ginger with flour and add to mixture.
Mix well.
Put in greased 9 x 11-inch shallow pan.
Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.
Cut in 12 squares.
Cook rice in beef bouillon.
Saute onion.
Add ground beef and brown.
Add cream of chicken soup and cook slowly for about 30 minutes or until done.
Add sour cream.
Combine cottage cheese, sour cream, egg and salt and pepper. Add Cheddar cheese and mix well. Add macaroni. Stir until coated. Put into 2-1/2 qt. baking dish.
Separate rolls; pat on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 7 to 8 minutes; let cool.
Mix with a mixer the cream cheese, oleo and dry Ranch dressing mix until smooth, then spread mixture on the rolls.
Add the chopped vegetables (whichever are your favorites).
Top with grated carrots and grated cheese.
Cut into bars and enjoy!
Cream shortening and sugar; add egg yolks and jam.
Beat well. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk, beating vigorously. Fold in egg whites, beaten.
Put in greased lined pan.
Use caramel icing on cake.
Bake about 30 minutes at 350°.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease 9-inch glass pie dish.
Place frozen berries in bowl.
Add 1/4 cup brown sugar and 1 tablespoon flour; toss to coat berries.
Spoon mixture into prepared pie dish.
In medium bowl, rub remaining 1 cup flour and butter together with fingertips until coarse meal forms.
Mix in remaining 1/2 cup brown sugar.
Add milk, egg, lemon peel and vanilla; stir to blend.
Pour batter over berry mixture.
Bake pudding until firm in center and top is golden brown, about 55 minutes.
Let cool 10 minutes.
Serve with ice cream, if desired.
Break or cut up broccoli. Mix with other ingredients.

recipes.t: Oatmeal And Sour Cherry Soda Bread
d: Heat oven to 375°.
Grease large baking sheet.

In large bowl, with fork, combine whole wheat and all-purpose flours, 1/2 cup oats, salt, baking powder, baking soda, cherries and caraway seed. In 2 cup glass measuring cup or small bowl, combine yogurt, 3/4 cup skim milk, and the honey until well blended.
Add yogurt mixture to dry ingredients and mix lightly with fork just until mixture clings together and forms a soft dough; do not overmix. Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface.
Knead gently 8 to 10 times or about 30 seconds.
Shape dough into an 8-inch round loaf and place on greased baking sheet.
Brush loaf with remaining tablespoon skim milk and sprinkle top with remaining tablespoon oats.
With knife, score top of loaf into quarters.
Bake bread for 35 to 40 minutes.
Cool completely before slicing.
Brown the hamburger and onion; drain. Add tomato sauce, beans and seasoning.
Cook 5 to 10 minutes.
Put in 2 pie plates.
Let cool.
Spread on top the sour cream and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

Dilute with water or milk if mixture becomes thick.
Season to taste.
